        "text": "# Requirements v2 review\n\n**Date:** 2026-11-12, Asia/Hong_Kong.  \n**Disposition:** Review only; findings and suggested changes are not approved requirements.  \n**Input:** `D:/CityU Things/Msc EEE Year1 sem1/CS5351 Software Engineering/group project/requirements/requirements-draft-v2.md`.  \n**Input SHA-256:** `5742540b7b614487082ba399b7a5b33e17f0d24c7e87a88fa69827a6aa62519f`.  \n**Scope:** All 25 active requirements, definitions, review-response table, drafting principles and appendices. Static document review, informed by the prior v0.7.1 source inspection; no new live model experiment or acceptance suite run.\n\n## 1. Assessment\n\nV2 is substantially more coherent than v1. Research-only scope, withdrawn portfolio invariants, separate outcome/rating/check fields, the three termination categories, explicit handling of free-text fallback, human-visible source dates, and completed-run evaluation denominators resolve major earlier concerns. GUI withdrawal is a valid scope decision; it should not be reclassified as a non-functional requirement.\n\nThe earlier proposals are now substantially incorporated: FR-007 separates model judgments and bans ownership wording; FR-001 includes visible provenance; FR-005/006 address availability and freshness; FR-008 adds confidence checks. Remaining problems concern the precise meaning, coverage and application of those rules. The source draft should not yet be treated as fully executable acceptance criteria.\n\n**Review priority:** High means resolve before implementing the affected contract. Medium means refine before its acceptance tests are finalized. Findings below distinguish actual contradictions, underspecification, and semantic/design risks; not every finding is a logical conflict.\n\nSource line references below are one-based and apply to the hashed input above. Suggested remedies are discussion options, not edits to Member A's baseline.\n\n## 2. Findings that affect core behaviour\n\n### V2-01 — No sentiment data is forced to Neutral\n\n**High; semantic risk.** FR-008 R6 (line 284) requires Neutral when none of the sources is OK. Combined with R4, a model can emit Neutral, score 5, low confidence with all sources unavailable and receive PASSED. This presents unavailable sentiment as an assessment of neutral sentiment. The same condition also applies when sources contain usable data but are coded STALE.\n\n**Suggested decision:** distinguish “not assessed / insufficient data” from neutral evidence, using a separate availability field or nullable band/score. This need not introduce another run outcome or stop reason. If the team intentionally retains Neutral, require a conspicuous unavailable-assessment label and clarify that it is a placeholder rather than observed market sentiment. Add a direct no-data Neutral fixture; the current example only catches an inconsistent Bullish/0 output.\n\n### V2-02 — Confidence correction happens after downstream use\n\n**High; sequencing gap.** FR-008 says its rules are applied by the output check, while ARCH-002 (line 494) runs after the Portfolio Manager. By then the Bull/Bear Researchers, Research Manager, Trader and risk debate may already have consumed the uncorrected High confidence. Correcting the final sentiment header does not undo its influence on the rating or narrative. R4/R6 contradictions can likewise travel through the graph before being flagged.\n\n**Suggested decision:** normalize or validate sentiment before downstream agents consume it, retaining an audit finding for the final output check. Alternatively, explicitly scope corrections to display only and document that downstream reasoning used the original value. Specify which version appears in every saved report, agent context and run record. The existing single owner of final `output_check` can be preserved.\n\n### V2-03 — Twelve-channel coverage cannot express three sentiment source states\n\n**High; contract gap.** RUN-001/FR-005 require one code per FR-004 channel. Channel 11 combines Reddit and StockTwits, but FR-008 R5/R6 require separate states for news, Reddit and StockTwits. A combined social code cannot distinguish “Reddit unavailable, StockTwits OK” from the reverse. Financial statements and macro channels can also contain multiple requests with mixed results.\n\n**Suggested decision:** keep a twelve-channel summary plus per-source/request outcomes. Define aggregation precedence and partial coverage. A successful fallback must not remain UNAVAILABLE merely because the first vendor failed. Specify whether the news source used by sentiment is exactly the ticker-news channel or a separate request window.\n\n### V2-04 — No valid coverage code for a skipped channel on a completed run\n\n**High; incomplete closed vocabulary.** FR-005 lines 217–227 requires every channel to have exactly one code and permits NOT_REACHED only for incomplete runs. Upstream supports selecting only some analysts, and tools need not request all channels. A completed market-only run can have no sentiment/news call without any vendor failure. None of OK, UNAVAILABLE, NO_DATA, STALE or WITHHELD describes that situation truthfully.\n\n**Suggested decision:** add a coverage state such as NOT_REQUESTED, and define NOT_APPLICABLE if needed; or explicitly require all channels to be fetched for every in-scope run. Missing an optional unrequested channel should not silently become an outage. Keep the clean fixture's 12 OK channels only if it deliberately exercises all twelve.\n\n### V2-05 — Required price retrieval is not explicitly guaranteed\n\n**High; missing precondition.** FR-005 says a core code other than OK stops the run. However, NOT_REACHED is defined only after a stop, and no requirement explicitly guarantees that core price history is retrieved regardless of analyst selection or model tool choices. A final rating could otherwise be produced without triggering a core request at all.\n\n**Suggested decision:** require a trusted core-price check before any run can claim completion. Define the minimum usable price series/window and whether a verified market snapshot can satisfy it. This is distinct from adding another discretionary model tool.\n\n### V2-06 — Sentiment absence and free-text fallback are not specified\n\n**High; interface gap.** R4–R6 assume typed band, score and confidence fields. NFR-001 explicitly accepts free-text fallback, and analyst selection may omit sentiment entirely. The draft does not say how to parse missing/ambiguous sentiment fields, whether to skip those rules for an unselected analyst, or how to record such a skip. A general CHECK_ERROR is not a clear intended result for ordinary optional input.\n\n**Suggested decision:** define applicability and typed extraction for each check. Unparseable selected sentiment should produce a named finding, while an intentionally omitted sentiment analyst should follow an explicit not-applicable rule. Add fixtures for omitted analyst, missing score, invalid confidence and conflicting text/structured values.\n\n### V2-07 — Immutable records and resume lifecycle remain ambiguous\n\n**High; lifecycle gap.** Definitions line 50 makes resume the same run. RUN-001 records an interrupted run as INCOMPLETE; FR-003 later resumes it; REPRO-001 promises one immutable record/report per run. Does resume update the existing result, create a second result under the same run ID, or retain a stale incomplete outcome? The statement explicitly protects earlier runs from later runs but does not settle updates to this same logical run.\n\n**Suggested decision:** choose one lifecycle: attempt records linked to a logical run, or a mutable in-progress journal with one immutable final manifest and separately recorded interruptions. Define budgets and elapsed time across resume, checkpoint-to-run identity, and how EVAL-001 counts interruptions and eventual completion. Preserve evidence without duplicating logical runs in the denominator.\n\n### V2-08 — The exact record comparison cannot pass as written\n\n**High; literal contradiction in acceptance.** REPRO-001 criterion (c), line 347, says changing one config key makes two records differ in exactly that key. The same requirement mandates unique run IDs, start/end times and distinct run artifacts. Those records necessarily differ in more than the config key, even when model output is identical.\n\n**Suggested wording:** “The `config` objects differ in exactly that key; run identity, timestamps, measured usage, outputs and findings are outside this comparison.” Keep their independent correctness tests.\n\n### V2-09 — Universal non-null rule conflicts with absent result fields\n\n**High; literal contradiction in acceptance.** REPRO-001 criterion (b), line 347, requires non-null mandatory fields “and the RUN-001 fields.” RUN-001 requires stop_reason only on INCOMPLETE and rating only on COMPLETED. Requiring all of those fields to be non-null on every record would invalidate every result row.\n\n**Suggested wording:** validate RUN-001 fields conditionally against its validity table; specify absent versus explicit null serialization. `check_findings` can be an empty list. Document CHECK_ERROR as an allowed system finding alongside rule IDs R1–R8, including its blocking classification.\n\n### V2-10 — The evaluation comparability rule prevents change studies\n\n**High; over-restrictive evaluation policy.** EVAL-001 rule 5 (line 425) prohibits comparing results unless both config and prompt_hash match. That is appropriate for repeated measurements under fixed conditions, but excludes intentional prompt/model/budget comparisons. GOV-001 can still score a candidate against an absolute threshold; it cannot support a permitted before/after comparison under this wording when the prompt changes.\n\n**Suggested decision:** distinguish repeatability comparisons from controlled change experiments. In the latter, declare the allowed changed factor, keep the other conditions pinned and report that factor. Do not automatically reject every mismatched prompt hash. Keep incomplete and NEEDS_REVIEW counts alongside quality scores as v2 already requires.\n\n### V2-11 — Must output check implicitly requires Should features\n\n**High; prioritization inconsistency.** P2 says requirements depend only on equal/higher priorities. All explicitly listed dependency edges obey it, but ARCH-002 is Must and unconditionally applies R4–R6 owned by Should FR-008 and R8 owned by Should SEC-003. Must FR-005 also uses STALE semantics owned by Should FR-006. Must RUN-001 requires a run record implemented through Should REPRO-001.\n\n**Suggested decision:** promote the minimum required behaviours, or separate mandatory checks from optional/applicable checks with a declared enabled-rule set. Distinguish the minimal mandatory run-result record from optional extended reproducibility fields. Merely omitting these from Dependencies does not eliminate the behavioural dependency.\n\n## 3.       "content": "import re, sys, zlib\n\ndef load(path):\n    data = open(path, 'rb').read()\n    return data\n\ndef objects(data):\n    objs = {}\n    for m in re.finditer(rb'(\\d+)\\s+(\\d+)\\s+obj\\b', data):\n        start = m.end()\n        end = data.find(b'endobj', start)\n        if end == -1:\n            continue\n        objs[int(m.group(1))] = data[start:end]\n    return objs\n\ndef stream_bytes(body):\n    m = re.search(rb'stream\\r?\\n', body)\n    if not m:\n        return None\n    start = m.end()\n    end = body.rfind(b'endstream')\n    raw = body[start:end]\n    if raw.endswith(b'\\n'):\n        raw = raw[:-1]\n    if raw.endswith(b'\\r'):\n        raw = raw[:-1]\n    if b'FlateDecode' in body[:m.start()]:\n        try:\n            return zlib.decompress(raw)\n        except Exception:\n            try:\n                return zlib.decompressobj().decompress(raw)\n            except Exception:\n                return None\n    return raw\n\ndef unescape_pdf_literal(s):\n    out = bytearray()\n    i = 0\n    n = len(s)\n    while i < n:\n        c = s[i]\n        if c == 0x5c and i+1 < n:\n            d = s[i+1]\n            mp = {0x6e:10,0x72:13,0x74:9,0x62:8,0x66:12,0x28:0x28,0x29:0x29,0x5c:0x5c}\n            if d in mp:\n                out.append(mp[d]); i += 2; continue\n            if 0x30 <= d <= 0x37:\n                j = i+1\n                oct_str = bytearray()\n                while j < n and len(oct_str) < 3 and 0x30 <= s[j] <= 0x37:\n                    oct_str.append(s[j]); continue\n            out.append(d); i += 2; continue\n        out.append(c); i += 1\n    return bytes(out)\n\ndef extract_text_from_content(content):\n    out = []\n    i = 0\n    n = len(content)\n    # naive tokenizer for text operators\n    while i < n:\n        c = content[i]\n        if c == 0x28:  # (\n            j = i+1\n            depth = 1\n            buf = bytearray()\n            while j < n:\n                ch = content[j]\n                if ch == 0x5c:\n                    buf.append(ch)\n                    if j+1 < n:\n                        buf.append(content[j+1])\n                    j += 2\n                    continue\n                if ch == 0x28:\n                    depth += 1\n                    buf.append(ch)\n                elif ch == 0x29:\n                    depth -= 1\n                    if depth == 0:\n                        break\n                    buf.append(ch)\n                else:\n                    buf.append(ch)\n                j += 1\n            txt = unescape_pdf_literal(bytes(buf))\n            out.append(txt.decode('latin-1', 'replace'))\n            i = j+1\n            continue\n        if c == 0x5b:  # [ ... ] TJ array\n            i += 1\n            continue\n        i += 1\n    return ''.join(out)\n\ndef extract(path):\n    data = load(path)\n    objs = objects(data)\n    texts = []\n    for num, body in objs.items():\n        if b'stream' in body:\n            s = stream_bytes(body)\n            if not s:\n                continue\n            if b'BT' in s or b'Tj' in s or b'TJ' in s:\n                t = extract_text_from_content(s)\n                if t.strip():\n                    texts.append((num, t))\n    # content streams reference order may be by object number; try page order via /Contents\n    ordered = []\n    page_refs = []\n    for num, body in objs.items():\n        if re.search(rb'/Type\\s*/Page\\b', body):\n            cm = re.search(rb'/Contents\\s+(\\d+)\\s+\\d+\\s+R', body)\n            if cm:\n                page_refs.append((num, int(cm.group(1))))\n            else:\n                carr = re.search(rb'/Contents\\s*\\[([^\\]]*)\\]', body)\n                if carr:\n                    ids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb'(\\d+)\\s+\\d+\\s+R', carr.group(1))]\n                    page_refs.append((num, ids))\n    seen = set()\n    for _, cid in page_refs:\n        ids = cid if isinstance(cid, list) else [cid]\n        for oid in ids:\n            if oid in seen: continue\n            seen.add(oid)\n            body = objs.get(oid)\n            if not body: continue\n            s = stream_bytes(body)\n            if s:\n                ordered.append(extract_text_from_content(s))\n    if not ordered:\n        ordered = [t for _, t in sorted(texts)]\n    return '\\n'.join(ordered)\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    print(extract(sys.argv[1]))\n"

hi = int(mm.group(2),16); dst=int(mm.group(3),16)\n            for i in range(hi-lo+1):\n                try:\n                    m[lo+i] = chr(dst+i)\n                except Exception:\n                    pass\n    return m\n\ndef build_font_maps(d, objs):\n    # map font resource name -> cmap dict, and code byte-length\n    font_maps = {}\n    for num, body in objs.items():\n        if b'/Type0' in body or b'/Font' in body:\n            tu = re.search(rb'/ToUnicode\\s+(\\d+)\\s+\\d+\\s+R', body)\n            # font resource name mapping comes from page resources; handle separately\n    # Build per-font-object cmap\n    font_cmap = {}\n    for num, body in objs.items():\n        if re.search(rb'/Type\\s*/Font', body) or b'/ToUnicode' in body:\n            tu = re.search(rb'/ToUnicode\\s+(\\d+)\\s+\\d+\\s+R', body)\n            if tu:\n                tob = objs.get(int(tu.group(1)))\n                if tob:\n                    s = stream_of(tob)\n                    if s:\n                        font_cmap[num] = parse_cmap(s)\n    # Map resource names (/F4 etc) to font object ids per page resources\n    name_to_obj = {}\n    for num, body in objs.items():\n        for fm in re.finditer(rb'/Font\\s*<<(.*?)>>', body, re.S):\n            for rm in re.finditer(rb'/([A-Za-z0-9]+)\\s+(\\d+)\\s+\\d+\\s+R', fm.group(1)):\n                name_to_obj[rm.group(1).decode()] = int(rm.group(2))\n    return font_cmap, name_to_obj\n\ndef decode_hex_string(hexstr, cmap, nbytes):\n    out = []\n    h = hexstr.decode()\n    step = nbytes*2\n    for i in range(0, len(h), step):\n        code = int(h[i:i+step], 16)\n        if code in cmap:\n            out.append(cmap[code])\n        else:\n            try:\n                out.append(chr(code))\n            except Exception:\n                pass\n    return ''.join(out)\n\ndef extract_page_text(content, font_cmap, name_to_obj):\n    out = []\n    cur_cmap = {}\n    cur_nbytes = 1\n    i = 0; n = len(content)\n    last_y = None\n    while i < n:\n        m = re.compile(rb'/([A-Za-z0-9]+)\\s+[\\d.]+\\s+Tf').match(content, i)\n        if m:\n            name = m.group(1).decode()\n            oid = name_to_obj.get(name)\n            cur_cmap = font_cmap.get(oid, {})\n            # determine byte length: if codes >255 use 2\n            cur_nbytes = 2 if (cur_cmap and max(cur_cmap) > 255) else 1\n            if not cur_cmap:\n                cur_nbytes = 2 if b'Type0' in ' '.join([]) else 1\n            i = m.end(); continue\n        m = re.compile(rb'<([0-9A-Fa-f\\s]+)>\\s*Tj').match(content, i)\n        if m:\n            hx = re.sub(rb'\\s', b'', m.group(1))\n            out.append(decode_hex_string(hx, cur_cmap, cur_nbytes))\n            i = m.end(); continue\n        # Td/Tm to detect line breaks by y movement\n        m = re.compile(rb'([\\d.-]+)\\s+0\\s+Td').match(content, i)\n        if m:\n            i = m.end(); continue\n        m = re.compile(rb'1 0 0 -1 ([\\d.-]+) ([\\d.-]+) Tm').match(content, i)\n        if m:\n            y = float(m.group(2))\n            if last_y is not None and abs(y-last_y) > 1:\n                out.append('\\n')\n            last_y = y\n            i = m.end(); continue\n        i += 1\n    return ''.join(out)\n\ndef extract(path):\n    d = open(path,'rb').read()\n    objs = get_objects(d)\n    font_cmap, name_to_obj = build_font_maps(d, objs)\n    pages = []\n    for num, body in objs.items():\n        if re.search(rb'/Type\\s*/Page\\b', body):\n            cs = []\n            cm = re.search(rb'/Contents\\s+(\\d+)\\s+\\d+\\s+R', body)\n            if cm: cs = [int(cm.group(1))]\n            else:\n                carr = re.search(rb'/Contents\\s*\\[([^\\]]*)\\]', body)\n                if carr: cs = [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb'(\\d+)\\s+\\d+\\s+R', carr.group(1))]\n            pages.append((num, cs))\n    pages.sort()\n    out = []\n    for num, cs in pages:\n        for cid in cs:\n            b = objs.get(cid)\n            if not b: continue\n            s = stream_of(b)\n            if s:\n                out.append(extract_page_text(s, font_cmap, name_to_obj))\n    return '\\n'.join(out)\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    print(extract(sys.argv[1]))\n",

\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000d\u0000e\u0000c\u0000i\u0000s\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000t\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000\u0000p\u0000r\u0000o\u0000c\u0000e\u0000d\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000o\u0000r\u0000\u0000i\u0000m\u0000p\u0000l\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000c\u0000o\u0000d\u0000e\u0000.\u0000M\u0000e\u0000m\u0000b\u0000e\u0000r\u0000\u0000B\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000A\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000-\u0000b\u0000l\u0000u\u0000e\u0000p\u0000r\u0000i\u0000n\u0000t\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000C\u0000o\u0000m\u0000p\u0000o\u0000n\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000s\u0000p\u0000o\u0000n\u0000s\u0000i\u0000b\u0000i\u0000l\u0000i\u0000t\u0000i\u0000e\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000d\u0000a\u0000t\u0000a\u0000\u0000ﬂ\u0000o\u0000w\u0000,\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000p\u0000l\u0000o\u0000y\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000v\u0000i\u0000e\u0000w\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000/\u0000A\u0000D\u0000R\u0000/\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000A\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000\u0000D\u0000e\u0000c\u0000i\u0000s\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000R\u0000e\u0000c\u0000o\u0000r\u0000d\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000o\u0000n\u0000e\u0000\u0000ﬁ\u0000l\u0000e\u0000\u0000p\u0000e\u0000r\u0000\u0000s\u0000i\u0000g\u0000n\u0000i\u0000ﬁ\u0000c\u0000a\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000c\u0000i\u0000s\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000/\u0000i\u0000n\u0000t\u0000e\u0000r\u0000f\u0000a\u0000c\u0000e\u0000-\u0000c\u0000o\u0000n\u0000t\u0000r\u0000a\u0000c\u0000t\u0000s\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000M\u0000o\u0000d\u0000u\u0000l\u0000e\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000e\u0000x\u0000t\u0000e\u0000r\u0000n\u0000a\u0000l\u0000-\u0000s\u0000e\u0000r\u0000v\u0000i\u0000c\u0000e\u0000\u0000c\u0000o\u0000n\u0000t\u0000r\u0000a\u0000c\u0000t\u0000s\u0000,\u0000i\u0000n\u0000c\u0000l\u0000u\u0000d\u0000i\u0000n\u0000g\u0000\u0000i\u0000n\u0000p\u0000u\u0000t\u0000/\u0000o\u0000u\u0000t\u0000p\u0000u\u0000t\u0000\u0000e\u0000x\u0000p\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000s\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000/\u0000i\u0000n\u0000v\u0000a\u0000r\u0000i\u0000a\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000-\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000-\u0000s\u0000a\u0000f\u0000e\u0000t\u0000y\u0000-\u0000b\u0000o\u0000u\u0000n\u0000d\u0000a\u0000r\u0000i\u0000e\u0000s\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000S\u0000y\u0000s\u0000t\u0000e\u0000m\u0000\u0000i\u0000n\u0000v\u0000a\u0000r\u0000i\u0000a\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000s\u0000a\u0000f\u0000e\u0000t\u0000y\u0000-\u0000c\u0000r\u0000i\u0000t\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000l\u0000\u0000b\u0000o\u0000u\u0000n\u0000d\u0000a\u0000r\u0000i\u0000e\u0000s\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000/\u0000m\u0000e\u0000m\u0000o\u0000r\u0000y\u0000-\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000-\u0000s\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000e\u0000-\u0000d\u0000e\u0000s\u0000i\u0000g\u0000n\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000S\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000e\u0000,\u0000\u0000p\u0000e\u0000r\u0000s\u0000i\u0000s\u0000t\u0000e\u0000n\u0000c\u0000e\u0000,\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000m\u0000e\u0000m\u0000o\u0000r\u0000y\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000s\u0000i\u0000g\u0000n\u0000w\u0000h\u0000e\u0000r\u0000e\u0000\u0000a\u0000p\u0000p\u0000l\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000b\u0000l\u0000e\u0000.\u0000B\u0000o\u0000u\u0000n\u0000d\u0000a\u0000r\u0000y\u0000:\u0000\u0000B\u0000\u0000o\u0000w\u0000n\u0000s\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000s\u0000i\u0000g\u0000n\u0000\u0000i\u0000n\u0000t\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000\u0000c\u0000o\u0000n\u0000t\u0000r\u0000a\u0000c\u0000t\u0000s\u0000.\u0000\u0000B\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000e\u0000s\u0000\u0000n\u0000o\u0000t\u0000\u0000d\u0000u\u0000p\u0000l\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000e\u0000\u0000t\u0000h\u0000e\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000u\u0000i\u0000r\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000b\u0000a\u0000s\u0000e\u0000l\u0000i\u0000n\u0000e\u0000\u0000o\u0000r\u0000\u0000w\u0000r\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000\u0000v\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000ﬁ\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000s\u0000u\u0000l\u0000t\u0000s\u0000.\u0000M\u0000e\u0000m\u0000b\u0000e\u0000r\u0000\u0000C\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000V\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000ﬁ\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000Q\u0000u\u0000a\u0000l\u0000i\u0000t\u0000y\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000v\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000f\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000/\u0000t\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000-\u0000p\u0000l\u0000a\u0000n\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000T\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000\u0000l\u0000e\u0000v\u0000e\u0000l\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000s\u0000c\u0000o\u0000p\u0000e\u0000,\u0000\u0000e\u0000n\u0000v\u0000i\u0000r\u0000o\u0000n\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000r\u0000y\u0000/\u0000e\u0000x\u0000i\u0000t\u0000\u0000c\u0000r\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000a\u0000,\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000t\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000s\u0000p\u0000o\u0000n\u0000s\u0000i\u0000b\u0000i\u0000l\u0000i\u0000t\u0000i\u0000e\u0000s\u0000.\u0000\u0000t\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000s\u0000/\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000A\u0000u\u0000t\u0000o\u0000m\u0000a\u0000t\u0000e\u0000d\u0000\u0000u\u0000n\u0000i\u0000t\u0000,\u0000\u0000i\u0000n\u0000t\u0000e\u0000g\u0000r\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000,\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000e\u0000n\u0000d\u0000-\u0000t\u0000o\u0000-\u0000e\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000t\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000s\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000v\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000f\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000/\u0000v\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000f\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000-\u0000r\u0000e\u0000p\u0000o\u0000r\u0000t\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000T\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000\u0000r\u0000u\u0000n\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000o\u0000u\u0000t\u0000c\u0000o\u0000m\u0000e\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000c\u0000o\u0000v\u0000e\u0000r\u0000a\u0000g\u0000e\u0000\u0000e\u0000v\u0000i\u0000d\u0000e\u0000n\u0000c\u0000e\u0000,\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000u\u0000n\u0000r\u0000e\u0000s\u0000o\u0000l\u0000v\u0000e\u0000d\u0000\u0000l\u0000i\u0000m\u0000i\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000s\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000v\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000f\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000/\u0000d\u0000e\u0000f\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000-\u0000l\u0000o\u0000g\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000R\u0000e\u0000p\u0000r\u0000o\u0000d\u0000u\u0000c\u0000i\u0000b\u0000l\u0000e\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000f\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000s\u0000e\u0000v\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000t\u0000y\u0000,\u0000\u0000l\u0000i\u0000n\u0000k\u0000e\u0000d\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000u\u0000i\u0000r\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000I\u0000D\u0000s\u0000,\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000s\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000u\u0000s\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000v\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000f\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000/\u0000s\u0000e\u0000m\u0000a\u0000n\u0000t\u0000i\u0000c\u0000-\u0000e\u0000v\u0000a\u0000l\u0000u\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000E\u0000v\u0000a\u0000l\u0000u\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000c\u0000a\u0000s\u0000e\u0000s\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000s\u0000u\u0000l\u0000t\u0000s\u0000\u0000f\u0000o\u0000r\u0000\u0000o\u0000u\u0000t\u0000p\u0000u\u0000t\u0000v\u0000a\u0000l\u0000i\u0000d\u0000i\u0000t\u0000y\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000q\u0000u\u0000a\u0000l\u0000i\u0000t\u0000y\u0000\u0000c\u0000r\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000a\u0000.\u0000B\u0000o\u0000u\u0000n\u0000d\u0000a\u0000r\u0000y\u0000:\u0000\u0000C\u0000\u0000o\u0000w\u0000n\u0000s\u0000\u0000t\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000s\u0000i\u0000g\u0000n\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000e\u0000v\u0000i\u0000d\u0000e\u0000n\u0000c\u0000e\u0000.\u0000\u0000C\u0000\u0000m\u0000a\u0000y\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000p\u0000o\u0000r\u0000t\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000u\u0000i\u0000r\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000a\u0000m\u0000b\u0000i\u0000g\u0000u\u0000i\u0000t\u0000y\u0000\u0000t\u0000o\u0000\u0000A\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000\u0000i\u0000s\u0000s\u0000u\u0000e\u0000s\u0000\u0000t\u0000o\u0000\u0000B\u0000,\u0000\u0000b\u0000u\u0000t\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000e\u0000s\u0000\u0000n\u0000o\u0000t\u0000\u0000i\u0000n\u0000d\u0000e\u0000p\u0000e\u0000n\u0000d\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000l\u0000y\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000d\u0000e\u0000ﬁ\u0000n\u0000e\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000u\u0000i\u0000r\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000\u0000o\u0000r\u0000\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0 00ﬁ\u0000l\u0000e\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000/\u0000c\u0000h\u0000a\u0000n\u0000g\u0000e\u0000-\u0000l\u0000o\u0000g\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000T\u0000i\u0000m\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000a\u0000m\u0000p\u0000e\u0000d\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000u\u0000i\u0000r\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000c\u0000h\u0000a\u0000n\u0000g\u0000e\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000c\u0000i\u0000s\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000r\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000a\u0000l\u0000e\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000/\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000u\u0000i\u0000r\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000-\u0000s\u0000o\u0000u\u0000r\u0000c\u0000e\u0000-\u0000n\u0000o\u0000t\u0000e\u0000s\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000S\u0000o\u0000u\u0000r\u0000c\u0000e\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000f\u0000e\u0000r\u0000e\u0000n\u0000c\u0000e\u0000s\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000c\u0000o\u0000n\u0000c\u0000i\u0000s\u0000e\u0000\u0000r\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000a\u0000l\u0000e\u0000\u0000f\u0000o\u0000r\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000u\u0000i\u0000r\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000\u0000t\u0000h\u0000a\u0000t\u0000\u0000n\u0000e\u0000e\u0000d\u0000\u0000c\u0000l\u0000a\u0000r\u0000i\u0000ﬁ\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000.\u0000B\u0000o\u0000u\u0000n\u0000d\u0000a\u0000r\u0000y\u0000:\u0000\u0000A\u0000\u0000o\u0000w\u0000n\u0000s\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000u\u0000i\u0000r\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000m\u0000e\u0000a\u0000n\u0000i\u0000n\u0000g\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000a\u0000c\u0000c\u0000e\u0000p\u0000t\u0000a\u0000n\u0000c\u0000e\u0000\u0000c\u0000r\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000a\u0000.\u0000\u0000A\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000e\u0000s\u0000\u0000n\u0000o\u0000t\u0000\u0000a\u0000u\u0000t\u0000h\u0000o\u0000r\u0000\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000d\u0000e\u0000c\u0000i\u0000s\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000t\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000\u0000p\u0000r\u0000o\u0000c\u0000e\u0000d\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000o\u0000r\u0000\u0000i\u0000m\u0000p\u0000l\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000c\u0000o\u0000d\u0000e\u0000.\u0000M\u0000e\u0000m\u0000b\u0000e\u0000r\u0000\u0000B\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000A\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000-\u0000b\u0000l\u0000u\u0000e\u0000p\u0000r\u0000i\u0000n\u0000t\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000C\u0000o\u0000m\u0000p\u0000o\u0000n\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000s\u0000p\u0000o\u0000n\u0000s\u0000i\u0000b\u0000i\u0000l\u0000i\u0000t\u0000i\u0000e\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000d\u0000a\u0000t\u0000a\u0000\u0000ﬂ\u0000o\u0000w\u0000,\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000p\u0000l\u0000o\u0000y\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000v\u0000i\u0000e\u0000w\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000/\u0000A\u0000D\u0000R\u0000/\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000A\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000\u0000D\u0000e\u0000c\u0000i\u0000s\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000R\u0000e\u0000c\u0000o\u0000r\u0000d\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000o\u0000n\u0000e\u0000\u0000ﬁ\u0000l\u0000e\u0000\u0000p\u0000e\u0000r\u0000\u0000s\u0000i\u0000g\u0000n\u0000i\u0000ﬁ\u0000c\u0000a\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000c\u0000i\u0000s\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000/\u0000i\u0000n\u0000t\u0000e\u0000r\u0000f\u0000a\u0000c\u0000e\u0000-\u0000c\u0000o\u0000n\u0000t\u0000r\u0000a\u0000c\u0000t\u0000s\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000M\u0000o\u0000d\u0000u\u0000l\u0000e\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000e\u0000x\u0000t\u0000e\u0000r\u0000n\u0000a\u0000l\u0000-\u0000s\u0000e\u0000r\u0000v\u0000i\u0000c\u0000e\u0000\u0000c\u0000o\u0000n\u0000t\u0000r\u0000a\u0000c\u0000t\u0000s\u0000,\u0000i\u0000n\u0000c\u0000l\u0000u\u0000d\u0000i\u0000n\u0000g\u0000\u0000i\u0000n\u0000p\u0000u\u0000t\u0000/\u0000o\u0000u\u0000t\u0000p\u0000u\u0000t\u0000\u0000e\u0000x\u0000p\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000s\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000/\u0000i\u0000n\u0000v\u0000a\u0000r\u0000i\u0000a\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000-\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000-\u0000s\u0000a\u0000f\u0000e\u0000t\u0000y\u0000-\u0000b\u0000o\u0000u\u0000n\u0000d\u0000a\u0000r\u0000i\u0000e\u0000s\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000S\u0000y\u0000s\u0000t\u0000e\u0000m\u0000\u0000i\u0000n\u0000v\u0000a\u0000r\u0000i\u0000a\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000s\u0000a\u0000f\u0000e\u0000t\u0000y\u0000-\u0000c\u0000r\u0000i\u0000t\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000l\u0000\u0000b\u0000o\u0000u\u0000n\u0000d\u0000a\u0000r\u0000i\u0000e\u0000s\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000/\u0000m\u0000e\u0000m\u0000o\u0000r\u0000y\u0000-\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000-\u0000s\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000e\u0000-\u0000d\u0000e\u0000s\u0000i\u0000g\u0000n\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000S\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000e\u0000,\u0000\u0000p\u0000e\u0000r\u0000s\u0000i\u0000s\u0000t\u0000e\u0000n\u0000c\u0000e\u0000,\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000m\u0000e\u0000m\u0000o\u0000r\u0000y\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000s\u0000i\u0000g\u0000n\u0000w\u0000h\u0000e\u0000r\u0000e\u0000\u0000a\u0000p\u0000p\u0000l\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000b\u0000l\u0000e\u0000.\u0000B\u0000o\u0000u\u0000n\u0000d\u0000a\u0000r\u0000y\u0000:\u0000\u0000B\u0000\u0000o\u0000w\u0000n\u0000s\u0000\u0000d\u0000e\u0000s\u0000i\u0000g\u0000n\u0000\u0000i\u0000n\u0000t\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000a\u0000r\u0000c\u0000h\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000\u0000c\u0000o\u0000n\u0000t\u0000r\u0000a\u0000c\u0000t\u0000s\u0000.\u0000\u0000B\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000e\u0000s\u0000\u0000n\u0000o\u0000t\u0000\u0000d\u0000u\u0000p\u0000l\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000e\u0000\u0000t\u0000h\u0000e\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000q\u0000u\u0000i\u0000r\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000b\u0000a\u0000s\u0000e\u0000l\u0000i\u0000n\u0000e\u0000\u0000o\u0000r\u0000\u0000w\u0000r\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000\u0000v\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000ﬁ\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000r\u0000e\u0000s\u0000u\u0000l\u0000t\u0000s\u0000.\u0000M\u0000e\u0000m\u0000b\u0000e\u0000r\u0000\u0000C\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000V\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000ﬁ\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000Q\u0000u\u0000a\u0000l\u0000i\u0000t\u0000y\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000v\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000f\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000/\u0000t\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000-\u0000p\u0000l\u0000a\u0000n\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000T\u0000e\u0000s\u0000t\u0000\u0000l\u0000e\u0000v\u0000e\u0000l\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000s\u0000c\u0000o\u0000p\u0000e\u0000,\u0000\u0000e\u0000n\u0000v\u0000i\u0000r\u0000o\u0000n\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000r\u0000y\u0000/\u0000e\u0000x\u0000i\u0000t\u0000\u0000c\u0000r\u0000i\u0000t\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000a\u0000,\u0000\u0000a\u0 000e\u0000c\u0000t\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000.\u0000M\u0000e\u0000m\u0000b\u0000e\u0000r\u0000\u0000D\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000I\u0000m\u0000p\u0000l\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000B\u0000a\u0000s\u0000e\u0000l\u0000i\u0000n\u0000e\u0000\u0000s\u0000r\u0000c\u0000/\u0000\u0000\u0000(\u0000o\u0000r\u0000\u0000t\u0000h\u0000e\u0000\u0000a\u0000g\u0000r\u0000e\u0000e\u0000d\u0000\u0000e\u0000x\u0000i\u0000s\u0000t\u0000i\u0000n\u0000g\u0000\u0000s\u0000o\u0000u\u0000r\u0000c\u0000e\u0000\u0000p\u0000a\u0000c\u0000k\u0000a\u0000g\u0000e\u0000)\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000A\u0000p\u0000p\u0000l\u0000i\u0000c\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000i\u0000m\u0000p\u0000l\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000p\u0000r\u0000o\u0000v\u0000i\u0000d\u0000e\u0000r\u0000/\u0000d\u0000a\u0000t\u0000a\u0000-\u0000s\u0000o\u0000u\u0000r\u0000c\u0000e\u0000\u0000i\u0000n\u0000t\u0000e\u0000g\u0000r\u0000a\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000e\u0000x\u0000p\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000s\u0000/\u0000b\u0000a\u0000s\u0000e\u0000l\u0000i\u0000n\u0000e\u0000-\u0000p\u0000r\u0000o\u0000t\u0000o\u0000c\u0000o\u0000l\u0000.\u0000m\u0000d\u0000\u0000\u0000—\u0000\u0000R\u0000e\u0000p\u0000r\u0000o\u0000d\u0000u\u0000c\u0000i\u0000b\u0000l\u0000e\u0000\u0000b\u0000a\u0000s\u0000e\u0000l\u0000i\u0000n\u0000e\u0000\u0000c\u0000o\u0000n\u0000d\u0000i\u0000t\u0000i\u0000o\u0000n\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000w\u0000o\u0000r\u0000k\u0000l\u0000o\u0000a\u0000d\u0000,\u0000l\u0000i\u0000m\u0000i\u0000t\u0000s\u0000,\u0000\u0000a\u0000n\u0000d\u0000\u0000m\u0000e\u0000a\u0000s\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000m\u0000e\u0000n\u0000t\u0000\u0000p\u0000r\u0000o\u0000c\u0000e\u0000d\u0000u\u0000r\u0000e\u0000.\u0000\u0000d\u0000o\u0000c\u0000s\u0000/\u0000e\u0000x\u0000p\u0000e\u0000r\u0000i\u0000m\u0 Status: working selection authorized for architecture exploration by Brian; pending Member A/team approval as a final registry. This is not the final D1 YAML deliverable. IDs `SEL-TA-*` belong to this selection and do not silently modify/reuse the wider v2 IDs.\n4: \n5: ## 1. Scope and baseline\n6: \n7: Target TradingAgents v0.7.1; extend its existing terminal UI, Python/LangGraph workflow, portfolio loader and Markdown/HTML reports. No new web GUI, broker connection, order execution, exposure certification or guaranteed investment outcome. Preserve baseline code/import structure until an approved layout decision.\n8: \n9: This deliberately revises v2's exclusion of portfolio input. Both modes are supported: `NO_PORTFOLIO` (unknown holdings/cash) and `PORTFOLIO_PROVIDED` (explicit user-selected snapshot). An explicitly supplied empty positions list is a flat snapshot, not missing input. Reported holdings are user-supplied context, not independently verified account facts.\n10: \n11: Existing v0.7.1: CLI `--portfolio PATH` calls `tradingagents.portfolio.load_portfolio`; its optional context reaches the graph and decision agents. No option means no context. It does not offer the proposed automatic folder picker/confirmation flow. Relevant sources: `cli/main.py`, `cli/run.py`, `tradingagents/portfolio.py`, `tradingagents/agents/context.py`, `tradingagents/graph/trading_graph.py`.\n12: \n13: ### Fixed working decisions\n14: \n15: - Interface is the current CLI. `PORTFOLIO_DIR` defaults to `<project-root>/portfolios`; do not search the home directory, credentials or arbitrary folders. Interactive discovery is non-recursive and lists regular `.json` files in deterministic filename order; symlinks are excluded from discovery.\n16: - Explicit `--portfolio PATH` remains supported, including a deliberately supplied path outside PORTFOLIO_DIR. Do not silently pick the newest/first file. Explicit paths are not an instruction to scan their parent directory.\n17: - Noninteractive use requires either `--portfolio PATH` or a new explicit `--without-portfolio` flag. Neither means input error; both means input error. The ordinary Python API remains usable with `portfolio=None` and does not prompt. CLI flags express the consent that an unattended process cannot give interactively.\n18: - A run begins only after input selection/validation/confirmation. Cancelled/rejected input starts no graph, makes zero LLM calls and creates no completed run. A fresh invocation creates a fresh run ID. Checkpoint resume, backtest changes, deadlines/token/call budgets and convergence changes are deferred from this selection.\n19: - Snapshot timing: user confirms that selected holdings are intended for analysis date D; record `portfolio_as_of=D` and `as_of_basis=USER_CONFIRMED`. Never infer timing from file modification time or claim historical accuracy was verified. Noninteractive `--portfolio` users must supply `--portfolio-as-of D` matching the requested analysis date. Existing upstream loader schema stays unchanged; these are wrapper metadata.\n20: - Selection reads the chosen file once, validates those bytes and freezes the normalized context for that run. Subsequent file changes cannot silently change the snapshot. Do not persist the full portfolio or other-position list in new report headers/logs/manifests; upstream decision prompts necessarily receive context and the provider disclosure is made before confirmation. Context-dependent generated narrative is still possible.\n21: \n22: ### Result and check contract\n23: \n24: Every started run returns `run_outcome=COMPLETED|INCOMPLETE`. Completed means the workflow returned; its final `rating` is Buy/Overweight/Hold/Underweight/Sell or REVIEW. Incomplete has no final rating and has `stop_reason=MODEL_FAILURE|DATA_FAILURE|INTERNAL_ERROR|PERSISTENCE_ERROR|INTERRUPTED`. Use MODEL_FAILURE only for exhausted model/provider output failures; DATA_FAILURE for an unrecovered raised vendor/data exception; preserve baseline recoverable non-core unavailable-data behaviour. INTERRUPTED covers cooperative cancellation, not an impossible promise to persist through power loss.\n25: \n26: `output_check=PASSED|NEEDS_REVIEW|NOT_RUN`; incomplete always NOT_RUN. A deterministic component owns the check. Rules: Q1 final rating readable, Q2 header matches trusted input snapshot metadata, Q3 disclaimer present, Q4 prohibited guarantee phrases absent. Each broken rule is a blocking finding; checker exception yields blocking CHECK_ERROR. No findings means PASSED. PASSED certifies only these checks, not factual accuracy or account suitability. This selection does not introduce global source-confidence scoring, sentiment correction or twelve-channel availability grading.\n27: \n28: Frozen strings: no-portfolio notice = `Holdings and cash were not provided; no account ownership is assumed.` Disclaimer = `Research output only. User-supplied holdings are unverified. No order is placed and no return is guaranteed.` Q4 checks the model-generated narrative for case-insensitive phrases `guaranteed profit`, `guaranteed returns`, `capital protection is guaranteed`. The trusted disclaimer is excluded. These limited phrase checks are complemented by SEL-TA-GOV-004 semantic evaluation and are not claimed to prove universal absence of paraphrased guarantees.\n29: \n30: ## 2. Functional requirements\n31: \n32: Each criterion below is a proposed acceptance obligation, not an existing test/result. All offline tests use isolated folders, a scripted model and no network. C owns actual test IDs, files and procedures.\n33: \n34: ### SEL-TA-FR-001 Discover and select a portfolio file\n35: \n36: - Type: functional. Priority: Must. Source: Brian's new holdings workflow; extends v2 FR-007 scope.\n37: - Statement: In interactive mode without an explicit input-mode flag, the CLI lists eligible filenames from PORTFOLIO_DIR and offers select one, continue without portfolio, or cancel. A missing/empty directory proceeds to the explicit no-portfolio confirmation; a directory read error is shown and offers retry, explicit no-portfolio confirmation, or cancel. It is never described as an empty directory.\n38: - Fit: With eligible `a.json`, `b.json`, a nested JSON, symlink and text file, exactly a/b appear once in sorted order; selecting b passes only b to validation. Separate empty/missing/unreadable fixtures follow their declared branch; cancelling dispatches zero LLM calls. One invalid selection does not pick a default.\n39: - Baseline: --portfolio exists; picker is new. Tradeoff: an extra interaction prevents silent selection.\n40: \n41: ### SEL-TA-FR-002 Explicit mode confirmation\n42: \n43: - Type: functional. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-001.\n44: - Statement: Interactive no-portfolio choice shows the frozen notice and asks to proceed, default No. File choice shows basename, analysis date, unverified/as-of statement, and that holdings will be sent to the configured model provider; it asks to proceed, default No. Confirming without holdings passes actual None, not an empty PortfolioContext. Automated invocation follows the flag rules above; an explicit flag is consent and prompts are suppressed.\n45: - Fit: Yes/No/EOF fixtures for each mode: only Yes starts one graph. No/EOF starts zero and exits cleanly. Noninteractive neither/both flags produce a readable input error and zero graph/LLM calls; valid --without-portfolio starts once with None.\n46: - Tradeoff: adds confirmation while preserving deliberate unattended use. API calls do not gain interactive prompts.\n47: \n48: ### SEL-TA-FR-003 Validate and freeze the selected snapshot\n49: \n50: - Type: functional. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-001/002.\n51: - Statement: Require top-level JSON object with explicit `positions` list. Each position has ticker and finite numeric quantity; optional average_price and cash are null or finite JSON numbers (booleans and numeric strings are rejected). Optional currency is a string or null. Reuse upstream model validation after these input prechecks. Empty positions is valid; malformed/missing fields, NaN/Infinity, unreadable paths and as-of mismatch stop input before dispatch. Explain filename plus bad field/path without exposing file contents or credentials. Permit reselect/cancel; no silent no-portfolio fallback.\n52: - Fit: Valid populated, explicit empty and null-cash fixtures load; six invalid classes (bad JSON, missing positions, missing quantity, nonfinite number, wrong scalar type, unreadable file) and as-of mismatch each dispatch zero calls with a field/file diagnostic. Editing the file after confirmation does not change the context used or fingerprint recorded.\n53: - Baseline: upstream validates many invalid files; explicit shape/type/as-of and freezing are project extensions. Tradeoff: previously permissive `{}` input is rejected to avoid treating absent data as an intentionally empty book.\n54: \n55: ### SEL-TA-FR-004 Propagate explicit context without inventing holdings\n56: \n57: - Type: functional. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-003.\n58: - Statement: Pass exactly the frozen validated snapshot through the existing portfolio argument to the decision agents. Retain upstream instrument alias matching. Missing cash is not zero; absent context is not a flat book. No-portfolio prompts do not refer to the user's existing position. Portfolio-provided prompts may refer only to explicitly supplied facts, labelled as user-supplied; they do not claim account verification.\n59: - Fit: Capture Trader/Portfolio Manager prompts for no portfolio, explicit flat, held ticker, broker-alias ticker and null-cash fixtures. All five preserve their distinct state; missing cash renders no invented number. Assert selected fixture values occur, another file's unique marker does not, and no-portfolio calls contain the frozen notice.\n60: - Baseline: optional rendering/alias distinctions already exist; unified confirmation-to-report identity and strengthened wording are new. Tradeoff: preserving unknowns limits account-specific conclusions.\n61: \n62: ### SEL-TA-FR-005 Distinguish ratings and actions\n63: \n64: - Type: functional. Priority: Must. Source: v2 FR-007.\n65: - Statement: Label final Portfolio Manager rating, intermediate Research Manager recommendation and intermediate Trader action separately. First two use five-tier research vocabulary; Trader uses three actions. REVIEW means unreadable rating, never Hold. No-portfolio Hold means balanced/insufficient evidence supporting no new directional action, not keeping an assumed position. Portfolio context does not convert research into an executable account instruction.\n66: - Fit: Fixtures cover all five final ratings, all three Trader actions, REVIEW and differing intermediate/final judgments. Each completed report has exactly one final-rating header and all three labelled stages. A REVIEW fixture remains REVIEW; no-portfolio Hold includes the defined meaning and no ownership assertion.\n67: - Tradeoff: stage labels take space but prevent conflating recommendation and proposal.\n68: \n69: ### SEL-TA-FR-006 Deterministic input provenance in every report\n70: \n71: - Type: functional. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-002/003/005.\n72: - Statement: Header is built from trusted state and contains run ID, ticker, D, input mode, selected basename and a full normalized-content SHA-256 fingerprint when supplied, user-confirmed as-of date/basis, outcome/check and disclaimer. No-portfolio uses explicit null for file/fingerprint/as-of and the frozen notice. Partial artifacts say INCOMPLETE and contain no final rating. Basename/fingerprint are provenance, not proof of truthful holdings. Do not automatically export the full portfolio payload in this header.\n73: - Fit: Changing scripted model prose leaves provenance identical. Selecting b yields b's frozen fingerprint in returned result, manifest and report, never a's. None and explicit empty portfolio produce distinct modes/fingerprints. HTML escapes file/model text, including script-like names.\n74: - Tradeoff: adds metadata; holdings fingerprints are privacy-sensitive and remain local by default.\n75: \n76: ### SEL-TA-FR-007 Deterministic output-check authority\n77: \n78: - Type: functional/invariant. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-006.\n79: - Statement: One non-LLM component assigns output_check and findings using Q1-Q4; model text cannot assign, bypass or overwrite them. Header/result/check refer to the same frozen data. On check error retain COMPLETED if the graph returned, but use NEEDS_REVIEW with CHECK_ERROR. Render check meaning next to the result.\n80: - Fit: Positive fixture passes; four single-rule failures each produce its matching finding and NEEDS_REVIEW; injected model claim `OUTPUT CHECK: PASSED` cannot override a failing rule. Check exception fails closed; every incomplete fixture is NOT_RUN. Output check calls no provider.\n81: - Tradeoff: limited deterministic checks do not assess truth. Concrete fallback: mark review-needed, suppress any success badge and retain readable diagnostics for human review.\n82: \n83: ## 3. Non-functional requirements\n84: \n85: ### SEL-TA-NFR-001 Reliable external-failure handling\n86: \n87: - Type: reliability. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-007.\n88: - Statement: Preserve usable free-text fallback after structured-output failure. Exhausted model failures, unrecovered raised data failures and ordinary internal exceptions return typed incomplete results rather than escaping the public CLI/application entry point. A workflow returning unreadable final text completes with REVIEW and NEEDS_REVIEW. Do not reclassify a recoverable optional-data sentinel as a fatal error.\n89: - Fit: Two usable-fallback, two unreadable-final, two exhausted-model and one raised-data fixture all follow the contract; zero exceptions escape. An ordinary injected internal exception returns INTERNAL_ERROR. Diagnostics are redacted. Tradeoff: predictable failure results require preserving causes for debugging.\n90: \n91: ### SEL-TA-NFR-002 Structured observability\n92: \n93: - Type: observability. Priority: Should. Depends: NFR-001/003.\n94: - Statement: The new lifecycle event sink is UTF-8 JSONL. Every event contains run_id, ticker, node (`input`/`engine`/`output` for non-agent events), UTC timestamp, nonnegative monotonic elapsed_ms, event and event_outcome. Progress vocabulary is separate from terminal run_outcome. Console presentation may remain human-readable; raw provider payload logging is disabled by default in this selection.\n95: - Fit: Parse every line from one completed and one incomplete run: 100% parse, required fields non-null and elapsed nonnegative. Exactly one terminal event per run. No full portfolio payload or planted secret appears. Existing upstream state snapshots are not falsely described as JSONL. Tradeoff: machine-readable logs need a human-friendly console view.\n96: \n97: ### SEL-TA-NFR-003 Credential and holdings privacy\n98: \n99: - Type: security/privacy. Priority: Must.\n100: - Statement: Central output/error redaction covers the selected CLI, model/data exception messages, new events, report headers and manifests. Never emit API keys, OAuth access/refresh tokens or bearer [REDACTED] values. Keep portfolio source files read-only. Do not copy raw portfolio bytes into manifests/transcripts or print other-position lists in the selection UI. The confirmed disclosure to the model provider is intentional, not represented as local-only processing.\n101: - Fit: Four planted secret types across each named sink and model/data error path yield zero values; marker for an unrelated holding does not appear in UI/header/events/manifest. Source bytes are unchanged after success/failure. Secret leakage inside arbitrary generated narratives is also scanned; redact before delivery. Tradeoff: diagnostic detail is reduced. C expands the named-path inventory as integrations grow.\n102: \n103: ### SEL-TA-NFR-004 Distinct immutable fresh-run artifacts\n104: \n105: - Type: reproducibility. Priority: Should. Depends: FR-006, NFR-003.\n106: - Statement: Each started fresh run gets a unique ID and its own report directory and final manifest. Write manifest atomically once after artifact/check finalization. Record times, code version/source identifier, prompt hash, safe effective config, input provenance and result fields. Do not serialize secret endpoints; record safe provider identifiers. Failed runs keep available partial artifacts. Durable records during total disk failure/power loss are not promised; return a redacted persistence diagnostic if commit fails.\n107: - Fit: Two same-ticker/date runs produce two directories; first hashes remain unchanged. Config-only comparison of two manifests differing in one selected config key finds exactly that config difference; IDs/timing/results are excluded from that assertion. Prompt edit changes hash. Required result fields are validated conditionally: incomplete has no rating, completed has no stop_reason. Resume is deferred, not implemented by mutating a final record.\n108: - Tradeoff: extra storage; no automatic deletion in this selection.\n109: \n110: ### SEL-TA-NFR-005 Cohesive, compatible integration\n111: \n112: - Type: maintainability. Priority: Should. Depends: FR-003/004.\n113: - Statement: One reusable selection/input service and one shared result/reporting boundary support CLI without putting interactive prompts inside agents or the Python engine API. Reuse the upstream portfolio model/rendering and selected graph contract. Do not replace the baseline or duplicate independent JSON validators in every agent. Preserve upstream tests and explicitly document intentional CLI/type-validation changes.\n114: - Fit: One mocked API call with portfolio=None completes without terminal reads; explicit valid portfolio CLI call invokes selection service once and graph once. Structural check finds zero terminal prompt imports in tradingagents/agents/** and graph/**. Full prior offline suite has zero unapproved regressions. Tradeoff: added adapter boundary in exchange for testability.\n115: \n116: ### SEL-TA-NFR-006 Transparent evaluation population\n117: \n118: - Type: evaluation quality. Priority: Should. Depends: NFR-004.\n119: - Statement: Completion fraction counts all started fresh runs; pre-run rejected/cancelled inputs are counted separately. Quality summaries use completed runs and show count, NEEDS_REVIEW count and incomplete-reason counts alongside scores. Zero completed samples means insufficient evidence, never a passing quality result. Controlled before/after experiments may differ in declared changed factors; repeated fixed-condition benchmarks require matching controls.\n120: - Fit: Ten started records (six completed, two of those review-needed; four incomplete) plus two pre-run cancellations produce completion 6/10, review-needed 2, cancellations 2 and no dropped starts. Zero-completed fixture returns insufficient evidence. Changed prompt experiment is labelled as such, not rejected merely for its hash. Tradeoff: denominators expose unavailable delivery rather than hide it.\n121: \n122: ## 4. Mandatory process requirements (additional to the seven FRs/six NFRs)\n123: \n124: These follow the course brief, not optional v2 startup exemptions. Accountable owners are separate from the implementation designer.\n125: \n126: | ID | Type / priority | Statement and fit criterion | Owner |\n127: |---|---|---|---|\n128: | SEL-TA-GOV-001 | Governance / Must | Before implementation, record attributable approval of the independent test plan. An implementation PR with no prior approval fails its required check. | C plan; E enforcement; human approver |\n129: | SEL-TA-GOV-002 | Governance / Must | Registry validates against its schema. One valid/one invalid registry fixture proves pass/fail. A supplies final YAML/schema; this working Markdown is not substituted for them. | A/E |\n130: | SEL-TA-GOV-003 | Governance / Must | Prior tests run with zero unapproved regression; lint/type/dependency checks run on commits; safety PRs also run contract/security/API/permission checks. Introduced negative fixtures fail the matching required check. | C/E |\n131: | SEL-TA-GOV-004 | Governance / Must | Prompt/model changes replay fixed semantic cases against human-approved quality thresholds before production. Cases cover conditional ownership, rating/action distinction, guarantee language and injection. Below threshold or no valid samples cannot pass. C freezes rubric/population/threshold with A; D measures; E enforces. No unapproved non-blocking startup claim. | C/D/E |\n132: | SEL-TA-GOV-005 | Governance / Must | Code/prompt PR without AI-use log update is blocked. Demonstrate one rejected and one accepted fixture/change. Record real tools/model/session/interventions only. | E/all |\n133: | SEL-TA-GOV-006 | Governance/invariant / Must | Branch protection requires passing checks and human review plus ADR for safety changes; agent file access follows approved default-deny whitelists. A denied write attempt is blocked and logged without changing the file. | E with B permission design |\n134: \n135: ## 5. Test profile, ownership and deferred scope\n136: \n137: Pinned offline workload: isolated temporary directories, fake portfolio files (no real holdings/keys), scripted models following v0.7.1 test seams, no network and no provider billing. A/C turn the acceptance sketches into an approved fixture inventory and executable tests; they must not assert tests exist/pass yet. API/CLI/Markdown/HTML paths are distinct integration obligations. Exact semantic scoring threshold is an open C/A decision and must be fixed before semantic approval, not invented by an architecture agent.\n138: \n139: B designs enforcing components, contracts, invariant fallbacks, state/privacy and permission boundaries. D implements via supervised OpenCode. C owns test code and independent verification. E owns enforcement/packaging; A owns final requirements. All selected runtime requirements are Must or Should with dependencies no lower in priority. Mandatory minimal result persistence belongs to FR-006; optional richer experiment metadata belongs to NFR-004.\n140: \n141: Deferred: web GUI; exposure caps/position validation; automatic broker discovery; order execution; full stable-evidence registry across twelve channels; new historical filtering/freshness rules; global source-confidence grades; R4-R6 sentiment correction; resume/catalogue redesign; aggregate time/token/call limits; debate convergence; analyst plugin redesign. Preserve upstream safeguards while deferring their extension. Do not claim deferred v2 requirements are satisfied by this selection.\n142: \n143: Open items do not authorize silent improvisation: final D1 approval, semantic rubric/threshold, exact source/test layout accepted by instructor and the governance setup are unresolved. They do not prevent design candidate exploration; implementation/production gates remain real. Use the working decisions above for architecture unless a direct contradiction is found.\n144: \n145: Change log: 2026-11-12 +08:00 - Initial seven-FR/six-NFR/six-governance working selection, incorporating explicitly confirmed optional holdings. A missing/empty directory proceeds to the explicit no-portfolio confirmation; a directory read error is shown and offers retry, explicit no-portfolio confirmation, or cancel. It is never described as an empty directory.\n- Fit: With eligible `a.json`, `b.json`, a nested JSON, symlink and text file, exactly a/b appear once in sorted order; selecting b passes only b to validation. Separate empty/missing/unreadable fixtures follow their declared branch; cancelling dispatches zero LLM calls. One invalid selection does not pick a default.\n- Baseline: --portfolio exists; picker is new. Tradeoff: an extra interaction prevents silent selection.\n\n### SEL-TA-FR-002 Explicit mode confirmation\n\n- Type: functional. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-001.\n- Statement: Interactive no-portfolio choice shows the frozen notice and asks to proceed, default No. File choice shows basename, analysis date, unverified/as-of statement, and that holdings will be sent to the configured model provider; it asks to proceed, default No. Confirming without holdings passes actual None, not an empty PortfolioContext. Automated invocation follows the flag rules above; an explicit flag is consent and prompts are suppressed.\n- Fit: Yes/No/EOF fixtures for each mode: only Yes starts one graph. No/EOF starts zero and exits cleanly. Noninteractive neither/both flags produce a readable input error and zero graph/LLM calls; valid --without-portfolio starts once with None.\n- Tradeoff: adds confirmation while preserving deliberate unattended use. API calls do not gain interactive prompts.\n\n### SEL-TA-FR-003 Validate and freeze the selected snapshot\n\n- Type: functional. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-001/002.\n- Statement: Require top-level JSON object with explicit `positions` list. Each position has ticker and finite numeric quantity; optional average_price and cash are null or finite JSON numbers (booleans and numeric strings are rejected). Optional currency is a string or null. Reuse upstream model validation after these input prechecks. Empty positions is valid; malformed/missing fields, NaN/Infinity, unreadable paths and as-of mismatch stop input before dispatch. Explain filename plus bad field/path without exposing file contents or credentials. Permit reselect/cancel; no silent no-portfolio fallback.\n- Fit: Valid populated, explicit empty and null-cash fixtures load; six invalid classes (bad JSON, missing positions, missing quantity, nonfinite number, wrong scalar type, unreadable file) and as-of mismatch each dispatch zero calls with a field/file diagnostic. Editing the file after confirmation does not change the context used or fingerprint recorded.\n- Baseline: upstream validates many invalid files; explicit shape/type/as-of and freezing are project extensions. Tradeoff: previously permissive `{}` input is rejected to avoid treating absent data as an intentionally empty book.\n\n### SEL-TA-FR-004 Propagate explicit context without inventing holdings\n\n- Type: functional. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-003.\n- Statement: Pass exactly the frozen validated snapshot through the existing portfolio argument to the decision agents. Retain upstream instrument alias matching. Missing cash is not zero; absent context is not a flat book. No-portfolio prompts do not refer to the user's existing position. Portfolio-provided prompts may refer only to explicitly supplied facts, labelled as user-supplied; they do not claim account verification.\n- Fit: Capture Trader/Portfolio Manager prompts for no portfolio, explicit flat, held ticker, broker-alias ticker and null-cash fixtures. All five preserve their distinct state; missing cash renders no invented number. Assert selected fixture values occur, another file's unique marker does not, and no-portfolio calls contain the frozen notice.\n- Baseline: optional rendering/alias distinctions already exist; unified confirmation-to-report identity and strengthened wording are new. Tradeoff: preserving unknowns limits account-specific conclusions.\n\n### SEL-TA-FR-005 Distinguish ratings and actions\n\n- Type: functional. Priority: Must. Source: v2 FR-007.\n- Statement: Label final Portfolio Manager rating, intermediate Research Manager recommendation and intermediate Trader action separately. First two use five-tier research vocabulary; Trader uses three actions. REVIEW means unreadable rating, never Hold. No-portfolio Hold means balanced/insufficient evidence supporting no new directional action, not keeping an assumed position. Portfolio context does not convert research into an executable account instruction.\n- Fit: Fixtures cover all five final ratings, all three Trader actions, REVIEW and differing intermediate/final judgments. Each completed report has exactly one final-rating header and all three labelled stages. A REVIEW fixture remains REVIEW; no-portfolio Hold includes the defined meaning and no ownership assertion.\n- Tradeoff: stage labels take space but prevent conflating recommendation and proposal.\n\n### SEL-TA-FR-006 Deterministic input provenance in every report\n\n- Type: functional. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-002/003/005.\n- Statement: Header is built from trusted state and contains run ID, ticker, D, input mode, selected basename and a full normalized-content SHA-256 fingerprint when supplied, user-confirmed as-of date/basis, outcome/check and disclaimer. No-portfolio uses explicit null for file/fingerprint/as-of and the frozen notice. Partial artifacts say INCOMPLETE and contain no final rating. Basename/fingerprint are provenance, not proof of truthful holdings. Do not automatically export the full portfolio payload in this header.\n- Fit: Changing scripted model prose leaves provenance identical. Selecting b yields b's frozen fingerprint in returned result, manifest and report, never a's. None and explicit empty portfolio produce distinct modes/fingerprints. HTML escapes file/model text, including script-like names.\n- Tradeoff: adds metadata; holdings fingerprints are privacy-sensitive and remain local by default.\n\n### SEL-TA-FR-007 Deterministic output-check authority\n\n- Type: functional/invariant. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-006.\n- Statement: One non-LLM component assigns output_check and findings using Q1-Q4; model text cannot assign, bypass or overwrite them. Header/result/check refer to the same frozen data. On check error retain COMPLETED if the graph returned, but use NEEDS_REVIEW with CHECK_ERROR. Render check meaning next to the result.\n- Fit: Positive fixture passes; four single-rule failures each produce its matching finding and NEEDS_REVIEW; injected model claim `OUTPUT CHECK: PASSED` cannot override a failing rule. Check exception fails closed; every incomplete fixture is NOT_RUN. Output check calls no provider.\n- Tradeoff: limited deterministic checks do not assess truth. Concrete fallback: mark review-needed, suppress any success badge and retain readable diagnostics for human review.\n\n## 3. Non-functional requirements\n\n### SEL-TA-NFR-001 Reliable external-failure handling\n\n- Type: reliability. Priority: Must. Depends: FR-007.\n- Statement: Preserve usable free-text fallback after structured-output failure. Exhausted model failures, unrecovered raised data failures and ordinary internal exceptions return typed incomplete results rather than escaping the public CLI/application entry point. A workflow returning unreadable final text completes with REVIEW and NEEDS_REVIEW. Do not reclassify a recoverable optional-data sentinel as a fatal error.\n- Fit: Two usable-fallback, two unreadable-final, two exhausted-model and one raised-data fixture all follow the contract; zero exceptions escape. An ordinary injected internal exception returns INTERNAL_ERROR. Diagnostics are redacted. Tradeoff: predictable failure results require preserving causes for debugging.\n\n### SEL-TA-NFR-002 Structured observability\n\n- Type: observability. Priority: Should. Depends: NFR-001/003.\n- Statement: The new lifecycle event sink is UTF-8 JSONL. Every event contains run_id, ticker, node (`input`/`engine`/`output` for non-agent events), UTC timestamp, nonnegative monotonic elapsed_ms, event and event_outcome. Progress vocabulary is separate from terminal run_outcome. Console presentation may remain human-readable; raw provider payload logging is disabled by default in this selection.\n- Fit: Parse every line from one completed and one incomplete run: 100% parse, required fields non-null and elapsed nonnegative. Exactly one terminal event per run. No full portfolio payload or planted secret appears. Existing upstream state snapshots are not falsely described as JSONL. Tradeoff: machine-readable logs need a human-friendly console view.\n\n### SEL-TA-NFR-003 Credential and holdings privacy\n\n- Type: security/privacy. Priority: Must.\n- Statement: Central output/error redaction covers the selected CLI, model/data exception messages, new events, report headers and manifests. Never emit API keys, OAuth access/refresh tokens or bearer [REDACTED] values. Keep portfolio source files read-only. Do not copy raw portfolio bytes into manifests/transcripts or print other-position lists in the selection UI. The confirmed disclosure to the model provider is intentional, not represented as local-only processing.\n- Fit: Four planted secret types across each named sink and model/data error path yield zero values; marker for an unrelated holding does not appear in UI/header/events/manifest. Source bytes are unchanged after success/failure. Secret leakage inside arbitrary generated narratives is also scanned; redact before delivery. Tradeoff: diagnostic detail is reduced. C expands the named-path inventory as integrations grow.\n\n### SEL-TA-NFR-004 Distinct immutable fresh-run artifacts\n\n- Type: reproducibility. Priority: Should. Depends: FR-006, NFR-003.\n- Statement: Each started fresh run gets a unique ID and its own report directory and final manifest. Write manifest atomically once after artifact/check finalization. Record times, code version/source identifier, prompt hash, safe effective config, input provenance and result fields. Do not serialize secret endpoints; record safe provider identifiers. Failed runs keep available partial artifacts. Durable records during total disk failure/power loss are not promised; return a redacted persistence diagnostic if commit fails.\n- Fit: Two same-ticker/date runs produce two directories; first hashes remain unchanged. Config-only comparison of two manifests differing in one selected config key finds exactly that config difference; IDs/timing/results are excluded from that assertion. Prompt edit changes hash. Required result fields are validated conditionally: incomplete has no rating, completed has no stop_reason. Resume is deferred, not implemented by mutating a final record.\n- Tradeoff: extra storage; no automatic deletion in this selection.\n\n### SEL-TA-NFR-005 Cohesive, compatible integration\n\n- Type: maintainability. Priority: Should. Depends: FR-003/004.\n- Statement: One reusable selection/input service and one shared result/reporting boundary support CLI without putting interactive prompts inside agents or the Python engine API. Reuse the upstream portfolio model/rendering and selected graph contract. Do not replace the baseline or duplicate independent JSON validators in every agent. Preserve upstream tests and explicitly document intentional CLI/type-validation changes.\n- Fit: One mocked API call with portfolio=None completes without terminal reads; explicit valid portfolio CLI call invokes selection service once and graph once. Structural check finds zero terminal prompt imports in tradingagents/agents/** and graph/**. Full prior offline suite has zero unapproved regressions. Tradeoff: added adapter boundary in exchange for testability.\n\n### SEL-TA-NFR-006 Transparent evaluation population\n\n- Type: evaluation quality. Priority: Should. Depends: NFR-004.\n- Statement: Completion fraction counts all started fresh runs; pre-run rejected/cancelled inputs are counted separately. Quality summaries use completed runs and show count, NEEDS_REVIEW count and incomplete-reason counts alongside scores. Zero completed samples means insufficient evidence, never a passing quality result. Controlled before/after experiments may differ in declared changed factors; repeated fixed-condition benchmarks require matching controls.\n- Fit: Ten started records (six completed, two of those review-needed; four incomplete) plus two pre-run cancellations produce completion 6/10, review-needed 2, cancellations 2 and no dropped starts. Zero-completed fixture returns insufficient evidence. Changed prompt experiment is labelled as such, not rejected merely for its hash. Tradeoff: denominators expose unavailable delivery rather than hide it.\n\n## 4.
