        "file": "docs/reviews/remediation-r1-r5-2026-11-21.md",
        "patch": "Index: docs/reviews/remediation-r1-r5-2026-11-21.md\n===================================================================\n--- docs/reviews/remediation-r1-r5-2026-11-21.md\t\n+++ docs/reviews/remediation-r1-r5-2026-11-21.md\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@\n+# R1–R5 remediation — implementation and verification record (2026-11-21)\n+\n+Prepared 2026-11-21, Asia/Hong_Kong. Baseline `9b04330` (tree identical to `9c77b63`). Implemented by an OpenCode repair session under the approval recorded in [the R1–R5 test plan](../verification/proposals/remediation-r1-r5-test-plan-2026-11-21.md) (Brian: “Approve the unchanged plan and proceed.”). This record reports actual offline results only; it is not independent/formal acceptance, not a provider/model semantic PASS, and does not recover F8 historical evidence.\n+\n+Source findings: [follow-up review](remediation-follow-up-review-2026-11-21.md) residual R1–R5.\n+\n+## Scope kept\n+\n+Bounded repairs to the intended contracts. No edits to unsent `docs/planning/`, the final-readiness audit drafts, approved test-plan criteria, canonical requirements/proposals, CI/governance, `.env`, credentials, private live evidence or raw exports. Public contracts preserved: two input modes, five research ratings, Trader's three actions, Q1–Q4 authority, frozen snapshot/fingerprint, report+manifest critical and terminal-append best-effort, unchanged provider/threshold policy. No commits, pushes, live/model calls or dependency changes. Offline tests use fake models, synthetic credentials/portfolios, `tmp_path` and no network.\n+\n+R1–R5 numbering here is distinct from the older F1–F9 review items.\n+\n+## What changed\n+\n+| Item | Production/tooling change | Tests |\n+|---|---|---|\n+| **R1** | `agents/structured.py`: the binding-failure and invocation-fallback warnings pass the exception through the shared `runapi.redact.Redactor` (`_diagnostic`) before logging; free-text fallback preserved; no global logging monkeypatch or circular import (`runapi.redact` imports only `os`/`re`) | `tests/member_b_remediation/test_r1_logging_redaction.py` captures the actual `structured` logger |\n+| **R2** | `tests/member_c_verification/live/score_gov004.py`: added fixed ticker/date controls, the trusted `CASE_PORTFOLIOS`/`expected_case_identity` table (fingerprint recomputed from frozen facts), conditional result-field checks, manifest↔record correspondence, case-identity checks and authoritative report-envelope parsing that ignores quoted/fenced narrative but rejects duplicate/conflicting unquoted header fields | `test_r2_scorer_correspondence.py`, `test_r2_r3_differential_pins.py`; `test_score_gov004_exitcodes.py` positive fixtures upgraded to application-shaped manifests/envelopes |\n+| **R3** | New `tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py` (versioned `gov004_starts.json` schema 2 + per-attempt `gov004_attempt_<run_id>.json`); `test_gov004_live.py` preflights the whole cohort, claims before dispatch and records outcomes independently; `score_gov004.py` ingests retained unresolved starts as noncompleted | `test_r3_replay_durability.py`, differential pin |\n+| **R4** | `agents/managers/research_manager.py`: receives the same protected `get_portfolio_context_from_state` block as Trader/PM, carries a no-nonzero-target instruction (supplied empty/other-only/zero), preserves signed quantities/unknown-cash/aliases, and adds a stage-appropriate instruction to correct conflicting upstream ownership premises. Vocabularies unchanged; no forced rating | `test_r4_research_manager_context.py` captures the actual RM prompt |\n+| **R5** | `runapi/events.py` stages a private tentative terminal and commits it after the single rename (`commit_terminal`/`discard_tentative_terminal`); `runapi/persist.py` stages before the commit and commits only on success; `runapi/execution.py` emits exactly one matching `INCOMPLETE` terminal when a critical publication fails. Terminal-append-only failure still keeps the logical outcome with `durable=false` | `test_r5_terminal_visibility.py` |\n+\n+Docs updated for actual changes: `docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md` (case correspondence + durable accounting), `docs/architecture/invariants.md` (INV-06/11/13), `runtime-policy-catalog.md` (R2/R13c), `interface-contracts.md` (§7.1/§7.3), and ADR 001 (repairs note).\n+\n+## Baseline defect demonstration (before repair)\n+\n+The new negatives failed against the baseline before the fixes, and pass after:\n+\n+- **R1:** with the baseline `structured.py`, capturing the actual warning for `OPENAI_API_KEY=[REDACTED] / bearer [REDACTED] configured-value variants surfaced the full synthetic value (6 failures, 1 pass). After the repair all 7 pass; the usable Hold fallback is preserved.\n+- **R4:** with the baseline RM, the explicit-empty and 40-unit-held prompts were identical and lacked the facts / no-nonzero-target instruction (8 failures, 2 pass). After the repair all 10 pass.\n+- **R5:** through the real `run_analysis_api` with an injected rename or manifest-write failure, the baseline caller sink retained `['COMPLETED']` (3 failures). After the repair a critical failure shows exactly one `INCOMPLETE` terminal; append-only failure keeps `COMPLETED` with `durable=false`.\n+- **R2:** against a copy of the committed baseline scorer (`git show 9b04330:…/score_gov004.py`), an explicit-empty case relabelled `NO_PORTFOLIO` (hashes recomputed) still returned PASS/exit 0; the repaired scorer returns FAIL/exit 1. This is pinned in `test_r2_r3_differential_pins.py` (the baseline import is skipped when the copy is absent).\n+- **R3:** the baseline in-memory batch loop ran the first case but wrote no evidence when the second slot's duplicate check aborted; the repaired `dispatch_slots` persists the first outcome and retains the second start as noncompleted. Pinned in the same file.\n+\n+## Verification (actual results)\n+\n+Environment: project `.venv`, Python 3.14. Commands run offline with the coordinator's `GOV004_LIVE=0`, `PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1`, `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` controls.\n+\n+| Check | Result |\n+|---|---|\n+| `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --tb=short` | **1,611 passed, 2 skipped, 1 deselected; 100 subtests passed; 24 warnings; ≈18.7 s.** Skips: opt-in live replay (`GOV004_LIVE` unset) and optional Bedrock (`langchain_aws` absent). |\n+| `.venv/bin/ruff check --no-cache . --output-format concise` | All checks passed. |\n+| `.venv/bin/python -m pip check` | No broken requirements found. |\n+| `git diff --check` | Passed. |\n+| `git diff --stat` | 13 files (8 code/tooling + test/config + 4 architecture/verification docs) modified; new `tests/member_b_remediation/` and `replay_store.py` |\n+\n+Targeted sets also pass in isolation: `tests/member_b_remediation` (59), `tests/member_c_verification`, `tests/member_d_verification` → 192+ passed, 1 skipped.\n+\n+## Coverage by plan ID\n+\n+- **R1:** R1-01/02/03 captured-logging; R1-04 inventory — inspected callsites: the two `structured.py` warnings (repaired) plus `execution.py`, `agents/context.py`, and dataflow vendor warning paths already route exceptions through the Redactor or contain no credential surface. This is a bounded named-sink check, not a certification of every encoding.\n+- **R2:** R2-01 (complete application-shaped population PASS), R2-02 (explicit-empty↔NO_PORTFOLIO and held-for-empty), R2-03 (fingerprint/basename/as-of/basis/mode), R2-04 (wrong ticker/date, incompatible target), R2-05 (stop reason / invalid enum / passed-with-findings), R2-06 (envelope outcome/check/rating/mode + duplicate header), R2-07 (quoted/fenced narrative not authoritative; forged unquoted header rejected), R2-08 (preserved score/citation/hash/cohort negatives).\n+- **R3:** R3-01 (preflight before dispatch, zero runs), R3-02 (start durable before runner), R3-03 (later failure keeps first + retains later start), R3-04 (unresolved start noncompleted + reuse refused), R3-05 (scorer ingests unresolved start into denominator), R3-06 (same-second unique files + exclusive claim), R3-07 (normal multi-case run saves all).\n+- **R4:** R4-01 (absent/empty/held RM prompts differ; all three stages carry facts), R4-02 (empty/other-only/zero-target instruction; absent≠flat), R4-03 (signed qty, explicit cash zero vs unknown), R4-04 (protected facts survive non-default compaction), R4-05 (RM/Trader/PM sections retained in the report), R4-06 (five-tier/three-action vocabularies retained).\n+- **R5:** R5-01 (rename failure → one INCOMPLETE terminal), R5-02 (manifest-write failure consistent), R5-03 (append-only failure keeps COMPLETED, durable=false), R5-04 (normal completed and engine-incomplete single matching terminal), R5-05 (tentative not exposed before commit), R5-06 (existing event/publication mocks and negative fixtures still pass).\n+\n+## Honest remaining limits\n+\n+- **No independent/formal acceptance.** These are implementer/OpenCode offline results; C's independent evaluation remains separate.\n+- **No live semantic adjudication.** Offline RM prompt tests prove the trusted facts reach the model input, not that live narratives comply. Actual live contextual review (the C2 trim-language defect in the follow-up review) requires the approved provider and is still needed.\n+- **R1 named-sink coverage is bounded.** Repaired the structured-binding/invocation warnings and inspected the nearby callsites; not a proof that every conceivable secret encoding is impossible.\n+- **R2 binds artifacts to the declared case; it cannot prove the authenticity of a human judgment.** Legacy formal evidence lacking the required fields is rejected, not back-filled.\n+- **R3 durability is cooperative**, not a power-loss guarantee. Diagnostics/pilots stay separate from the formal cohort.\n+- **R5** covers a critical report/manifest or rename failure and the append-only failure; it does not promise survival through total disk failure or forced process termination.\n+- **F8** historical evidence and formal provider/model semantic acceptance remain pending and were not manufactured here.\n",

      {
        "file": "docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md",
        "patch": "Index: docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md\n===================================================================\n--- docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md\t\n+++ docs/verification/gov004-evidence-package.md\t\n@@ -1,39 +1,53 @@\n # GOV004 portable evidence and frozen population\n \n The November 18 historical live PASS remains **PENDING independent audit**: the original reports, manifests and score file are not present in this checkout. Repairing the scorer or creating fresh diagnostics cannot recover or approve those historical judgments. Preserve the original review and do not fabricate missing scores, timestamps or approval.\n \n ## Freeze a formal cohort before outcomes\n \n A/C must approve the actual provider/model configuration, applicability and critical-item policy before formal use. The scorer retains the documented fixed `deepseek` configuration; the saved school `openai_compatible` configuration is diagnostic until that difference is explicitly approved. Critical R1/R2/R3/R5/R6/R7 failures conservatively prevent PASS, regardless of optional caller flags. A/C should ratify this explicit policy rather than infer safety from a missing flag.\n \n Create `tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence/cohort.json` with:\n \n - `schema_version`: integer 1.\n - `approved_by`: attributable real approver, never a generated identity.\n - `frozen_at_utc`: actual timezone-aware freeze timestamp, before the recorded run start.\n - `source_revision`: exact revision label, including `+dirty` where applicable.\n - `prompt_hash`: the application's full SHA256 prompt-source hash.\n - `members`: exactly ten objects with `case_id`, `trial` (`1` or `2`) and unique preallocated safe `run_id`. Each fixed case has one slot per trial.\n \n Retain the approval and cohort externally or in version control before execution; editable local timestamps alone cannot prove historical chronology. The application and capture harness record hashes, but that is not a digital signature or a substitute for review.\n \n Set `GOV004_TRIAL=1` or `2` for approved formal replay. The harness reads the cohort, uses its run IDs and refuses to reuse a started slot. A diagnostic run leaves the trial unset. Store diagnostic evidence separately from formal evidence. Every recorded formal start remains in overall completion accounting; retries do not replace failed cohort slots. Completion is reported separately from semantic scores on eligible completed reports.\n \n ## Record evidence and human scores\n \n The capture harness records portable relative report and manifest paths and their SHA256 digests. Manifests must match the run identity, result, source revision, fixed configuration, prompt hash and report path. Each report must contain the corresponding trusted Run ID header. A completed record needs all of this evidence; incomplete/error attempts remain counted even without completed artifacts.\n \n+### Case/provenance/report correspondence (R2)\n+\n+A complete set of score cells is not sufficient. The scorer now validates each completed attempt against the trusted frozen case definition, not against the attempt's own (possibly defective) record:\n+\n+- **Result conditions.** `COMPLETED` requires a valid rating, `stop_reason=null`, and `PASSED`/`NEEDS_REVIEW`; `REVIEW` requires `NEEDS_REVIEW`; `PASSED` carries no findings and `NEEDS_REVIEW` carries at least one valid Q1–Q4/`CHECK_ERROR` finding. A non-completed attempt carries no rating, a known stop reason, `NOT_RUN` and no findings.\n+- **Case identity and analysis controls.** `ticker`, `analysis_date`, `input_mode`, `basename`, `fingerprint_sha256`, `portfolio_as_of` and `as_of_basis` must equal the values derived from the declared fixed case (`score_gov004.CASE_PORTFOLIOS` / `expected_case_identity`). Expected input facts are never inferred from the manifest itself, so a held-target file substituted for the explicit-empty case, or a `NO_PORTFOLIO` label on an explicit-empty case, fails even with recomputed hashes. The fixed ticker/date are `AAPL`/`2026-01-09`.\n+- **Authoritative report envelope.** The contiguous leading header block of `complete_report.md` (title, then the `- Key: value` lines, then `Findings:`) must agree with the manifest/record for run ID, ticker, analysis date, input mode, portfolio file, fingerprint, as-of/basis, run outcome, stop reason, final rating and output check. A missing, duplicate or conflicting authoritative field fails. Quoted or fenced narrative *after* the header (a discussion of a different status) is not treated as the authoritative block; a forged unquoted header-like line inside the header block is rejected rather than silently overwritten.\n+\n+Legacy formal evidence that lacks these fields is rejected rather than having the missing fields fabricated. This binds artifacts to the declared case; it does not cryptographically prove the honesty of a human score.\n+\n+### Durable per-attempt accounting (R3)\n+\n+`tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py` makes every attempt durable on its own. Before dispatch the whole selected cohort is preflighted (unique run IDs, one slot per case/trial, none already started); nothing runs on failure. Each slot is claimed (`STARTED`) in the versioned `gov004_starts.json` (schema 2) *before* `run_case` is called and its outcome is written to its own `gov004_attempt_<run_id>.json`, so two starts in one second cannot overwrite and a later validation/execution/serialization failure cannot discard an earlier attempt. A still-open start is retained by the scorer as a noncompleted attempt (never a fabricated `COMPLETED`); reusing that slot is refused. Diagnostics/pilot populations remain separate from the formal cohort.\n+\n The score JSON contains a real `reviewer` and an `answers` list. Each applicable answer has `case_id`, `run_id`, `trial`, `item`, integer `score` (0 or 1), and a nonempty `citation` found in that run's report. Record rationale and disagreements alongside it. Do not submit N/A rows for inapplicable cells. The scorer derives applicability; missing, duplicate, unknown, incorrectly N/A or unrelated cells fail. Challenge markers and actual exposure must be retained and independently checked. Q1–Q4 NEEDS_REVIEW and human semantic judgments remain separate.\n \n ## Package and verify from a fresh checkout\n \n After sanitization and human review, run from the repository root:\n \n ```sh\n python tests/member_c_verification/live/package_gov004.py tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence /tmp/gov004-package --scores tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence/gov004_scores.json\n GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/gov004-package python tests/member_c_verification/live/score_gov004.py /tmp/gov004-package/gov004_scores.json\n ```\n \n The destination must not already exist. The exporter copies only referenced reports/manifests and the cohort, evidence and scoring files, rewrites paths, and emits `integrity.json`. It refuses detected credential text rather than silently changing scored evidence. Review other sensitive content manually; automatic scanning cannot certify privacy. Move the package to a second path or fresh checkout and repeat scoring. PASS=0, FAIL=1, PENDING=2. PENDING is never acceptance. Compare integrity hashes after transfer; retain the archive in an agreed durable location.\n \n The tracked ignore rules exclude private generated live evidence. Deliberate sanitized packages may be retained outside that tree after owner review. This workflow is not recovery of missing historical evidence and does not itself grant formal approval.\n",

        "file": "tests/member_b_remediation/test_r1_logging_redaction.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_r1_logging_redaction.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_b_remediation/test_r1_logging_redaction.py\t\n+++ tests/member_b_remediation/test_r1_logging_redaction.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,126 @@\n+\"\"\"R1 — structured-binding/invocation warnings must pass through the Redactor.\n+\n+The review found that ``tradingagents/agents/structured.py`` interpolated the raw\n+exception into the logger, so a credential-bearing provider error reached normal\n+logging consumers (stderr handlers) before any report/event redaction. These\n+tests capture the *actual* ``structured`` logger, not just direct calls to\n+``Redactor.diagnostic``. Synthetic canaries only; no provider is contacted.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import logging\n+from unittest.mock import MagicMock\n+\n+import pytest\n+from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage\n+\n+from tradingagents.agents import structured\n+\n+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n+\n+LOGGER_NAME = structured.logger.name\n+\n+\n+class _Capture(logging.Handler):\n+    def __init__(self):\n+        super().__init__()\n+        self.records: list[str] = []\n+\n+    def emit(self, record):\n+        self.records.append(record.getMessage())\n+\n+\n+@pytest.fixture\n+def captured():\n+    handler = _Capture()\n+    logger = logging.getLogger(LOGGER_NAME)\n+    previous = logger.level\n+    logger.addHandler(handler)\n+    logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)\n+    try:\n+        yield handler.records\n+    finally:\n+        logger.removeHandler(handler)\n+        logger.setLevel(previous)\n+\n+\n+def _assert_clean(records, planted):\n+    joined = \"\\n\".join(records)\n+    for value in planted:\n+        assert value not in joined, f\"synthetic credential survived into logging: {value}\"\n+\n+\n+def test_r1_01_binding_failure_warning_is_redacted(captured, monkeypatch):\n+    \"\"\"A provider-prefixed assignment and a configured value in the bind error are scrubbed.\"\"\"\n+    configured = \"configured-synthetic-canary-556677\"\n+    monkeypatch.setenv(\"OPENAI_API_KEY\", configured)\n+\n+    class _Unsupported:\n+        def with_structured_output(self, _schema):\n+            raise NotImplementedError(\n+                f\"provider refused; OPENAI_API_KEY=[REDACTED] bearer {configured}\"\n+            )\n+\n+    assert structured.bind_structured(_Unsupported(), object, \"Research Manager\") is None\n+\n+    # Useful context survives, the planted values do not.\n+    assert captured, \"the binding warning must still be emitted\"\n+    joined = \"\\n\".join(captured)\n+    assert \"Research Manager\" in joined and \"free-text\" in joined\n+    _assert_clean(captured, {configured})\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"error\", [\n+    NotImplementedError(\"boom OPENAI_API_KEY=[REDACTED]\"),\n+    AttributeError(\"no binding API_KEY=[REDACTED]\"),\n+])\n+def test_r1_03_bind_variants_share_the_warning_path(captured, error):\n+    class _Unsupported:\n+        def with_structured_output(self, _schema):\n+            raise error\n+\n+    assert structured.bind_structured(_Unsupported(), object, \"Portfolio Manager\") is None\n+    _assert_clean(captured, {\"synthetic-bind-canary-123456\"})\n+\n+\n+def test_r1_02_invocation_failure_is_redacted_and_fallback_preserved(captured):\n+    canary = \"[REDACTED]\"\n+\n+    structured_llm = MagicMock()\n+    structured_llm.invoke.side_effect = RuntimeError(\n+        f\"structured call failed; Authorization: [REDACTED] {canary}\"\n+    )\n+    plain = MagicMock()\n+    plain.invoke.return_value = AIMessage(content=\"**Recommendation**: Hold\\n\\nUsable fallback.\")\n+\n+    result = structured.invoke_structured_or_freetext(\n+        structured_llm, plain, \"prompt\", render=lambda value: value.recommendation,\n+        agent_name=\"Research Manager\",\n+    )\n+\n+    # The usable free-text fallback is preserved.\n+    assert result == \"**Recommendation**: Hold\\n\\nUsable fallback.\"\n+    assert captured, \"the invocation warning must still be emitted\"\n+    assert \"Research Manager\" in \"\\n\".join(captured)\n+    _assert_clean(captured, {canary})\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"secret_text\", [\n+    'CLIENT_SECRET=[REDACTED]',\n+    \"Authorization: [REDACTED] [REDACTED]\",\n+    \"DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=[REDACTED]\",\n+])\n+def test_r1_03_invocation_variants_are_redacted(captured, secret_text):\n+    structured_llm = MagicMock()\n+    structured_llm.invoke.side_effect = ValueError(f\"provider error: {secret_text}\")\n+    plain = MagicMock()\n+    plain.invoke.return_value = AIMessage(content=\"FALLBACK\")\n+\n+    assert structured.invoke_structured(structured_llm, \"p\", \"Trader\") is None\n+    joined = \"\\n\".join(captured)\n+    for marker in (\"synthetic-multiline-123456\", \"second-line\", \"c3ludGhldGljLWJhc2ljLTEyMzQ1Ng==\"):\n+        assert marker not in joined\n+\n+    # Benign warning context is not over-scrubbed.\n+    assert \"Trader\" in joined and \"free text\" in joined\n",
        "additions": 126,
        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "added"
      },

        "file": "tests/member_b_remediation/test_r1_r5_smoke.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_r1_r5_smoke.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_b_remediation/test_r1_r5_smoke.py\t\n+++ tests/member_b_remediation/test_r1_r5_smoke.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@\n+\"\"\"Cross-cutting R1–R5 sanity: the repaired boundaries share one contract.\n+\n+Small smoke checks that the individual repair regressions rely on a consistent\n+public surface (redaction helper importable, tentative-terminal protocol present,\n+replay store importable, RM helper wired).         "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_r2_r3_differential_pins.py\n===================================================================\n--- rejects what the baseline accepted.\n+\n+These encode the review's exact reproductions as permanent negatives against the\n+*current* scorer/harness, and (when a baseline copy is available at\n+``/tmp/opencode/score_gov004_baseline.py``) show the same defect PASSing there.\n+The baseline path is optional so the suite never depends on a local artifact.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n+        \"diff_exit_fixture\", LIVE_DIR / \"test_score_gov004_exitcodes.py\")\n+    helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n+    sys.modules[spec.name] = helper\n+    spec.loader.exec_module(helper)\n+    return helper\n+\n+\n+def _population(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    helper = _helper()\n+    root = tmp_path / \"evidence\"\n+    scorer = helper._fresh_scorer(root, monkeypatch)\n+    rows = []\n+    for case in helper.FIXED_CASES:\n+        marker = helper.CHALLENGE_MARKERS.get(case)\n+        for label in (\"a\", \"b\"):\n+            rows.append(helper._make_run(root, case, f\"{case}-{label}\",\n+                                         challenge_marker=marker,\n+                                         challenge_reached=True if marker else None))\n+    helper._write_evidence(root, \"1\", rows)\n+    scores = root / \"gov004_scores.json\"\n+    helper._scores_all_pass(scores, [r[\"run_id\"] for r in rows])\n+    return helper, scorer, root, scores, rows\n+\n+\n+def _substitute_no_portfolio(helper, root, scores, rows):\n+    row = next(r for r in rows if r[\"case_id\"] == \"GOV004-C2-explicit-empty\")\n+    path = Path(row[\"manifest_path\"])\n+    data = json.loads(path.read_text())\n+    data.update(input_mode=\"NO_PORTFOLIO\", fingerprint_sha256=None,\n+                portfolio_as_of=None, as_of_basis=None, basename=None)\n+    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    row[\"manifest_sha256\"] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n+    (root / \"gov004_T1.json\").write_text(json.dumps(\n+        {\"gate\": \"GOV-004\", \"kind\": \"formal\", \"trial\": \"1\", \"cases\": rows}))\n+\n+\n+def test_r2_repaired_scorer_rejects_no_portfolio_substitution(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    helper, scorer, root, scores, rows = _population(tmp_path, monkeypatch)\n+    _substitute_no_portfolio(helper, root, scores, rows)\n+    assert scorer.main([\"score\", str(scores)]) == 1\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.skipif(not BASELINE.is_file(), reason=\"baseline scorer copy not available\")\n+def test_r2_baseline_scorer_accepts_the_same_substitution(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    \"\"\"Documents the review's finding against the committed baseline scorer.\"\"\"\n+    helper, _scorer, root, scores, rows = _population(tmp_path, monkeypatch)\n+    _substitute_no_portfolio(helper, root, scores, rows)\n+    monkeypatch.setenv(\"GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR\", str(root))\n+    sys.modules.pop(\"baseline_scorer\", None)\n+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"baseline_scorer\", BASELINE)\n+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n+    sys.modules[\"baseline_scorer\"] = module\n+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n+    assert module.main([\"score\", str(scores)]) == 0\n+\n+\n+def test_r3_fixed_loop_persists_first_start_before_later_abort(tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"The fixed harness keeps the first started attempt when a later case fails.\"\"\"\n+    sys.path.insert(0, str(LIVE_DIR))\n+    import replay_store\n+\n+    store = tmp_path / \"evidence\"\n+    store.mkdir()\n+\n+    def run_fn(slot):\n+        if slot[\"run_id\"] == \"slot-2\":\n+            raise RuntimeError(\"second case aborted\")\n+        return {\"case_id\": slot[\"case_id\"], \"run_id\": slot[\"run_id\"],\n+                \"trial\": slot[\"trial\"], \"outcome\": \"COMPLETED\", \"stop_reason\": None,\n+                \"final_rating\": \"Hold\", \"output_check\": \"PASSED\", \"findings\": [],\n+                \"challenge_marker\": None, \"challenge_reached_model\": None,\n+                \"prompt_capture\": {\"model_calls\": 1, \"calls\": []}, \"model_config\": {},\n+                \"report_path\": None, \"manifest_path\": None, \"run_dir\": None,\n+         "file": "tests/member_b_remediation/test_r3_replay_durability.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_r3_replay_durability.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_b_remediation/test_r3_replay_durability.py\t\n+++ tests/member_b_remediation/test_r3_replay_durability.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,180 @@\n+\"\"\"R3 — durable per-attempt replay accounting so started runs cannot be lost.\n+\n+The review reproduced a batch-level write that discarded an already-started\n+attempt when a later case aborted. These tests drive the reusable\n+``replay_store`` helpers with fake runners (no live fixture, no provider) and\n+the scorer's start ingestion. Synthetic tmp_path only.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import importlib.util\n+import json\n+import sys\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+import pytest\n+\n+LIVE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / \"member_c_verification\" / \"live\"\n+sys.path.insert(0, str(LIVE_DIR))\n+\n+import replay_store  # noqa: E402\n+\n+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n+\n+\n+def _slot(run_id, case=\"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", trial=\"1\"):\n+    return {\"case_id\": case, \"trial\": trial, \"run_id\": run_id}\n+\n+\n+def _completed(slot):\n+    return {\"case_id\": slot[\"case_id\"], \"run_id\": slot[\"run_id\"], \"trial\": slot[\"trial\"],\n+            \"outcome\": \"COMPLETED\", \"stop_reason\": None, \"final_rating\": \"Hold\",\n+            \"output_check\": \"PASSED\", \"findings\": [], \"challenge_marker\": None,\n+            \"challenge_reached_model\": None,\n+            \"prompt_capture\": {\"model_calls\": 1, \"calls\": [{\"prompt_sha256\": \"a\" * 64}]},\n+            \"model_config\": {}, \"report_path\": None, \"manifest_path\": None,\n+            \"run_dir\": None, \"source_revision\": \"git:test\", \"error\": None, \"notes\": []}\n+\n+\n+def test_r3_01_preflight_rejects_whole_cohort_before_dispatch(tmp_path):\n+    store = tmp_path / \"evidence\"\n+    store.mkdir()\n+    replay_store.claim_start(store, case_id=\"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", run_id=\"slot-2\",\n+                             trial=\"2\", started_at_utc=\"2026-11-21T00:00:00Z\")\n+    dispatched = []\n+\n+    def run_fn(slot):\n+        dispatched.append(slot[\"run_id\"])\n+        return _completed(slot)\n+\n+    planned = [\n+        {\"case_id\": \"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", \"trial\": \"1\", \"run_id\": \"slot-1\"},\n+        {\"case_id\": \"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", \"trial\": \"2\", \"run_id\": \"slot-2\"},\n+    ]\n+    with pytest.raises(replay_store.ReplayError):\n+        replay_store.dispatch_slots(store, planned, run_fn, started_at_utc=\"2026-11-21T00:00:01Z\")\n+    assert dispatched == []  # nothing ran\n+    # The pre-existing start and the not-yet-claimed first slot: only slot-2 exists.\n+    starts = replay_store.load_starts(store)\n+    assert [s[\"run_id\"] for s in starts] == [\"slot-2\"]\n+\n+\n+def test_r3_02_start_is_durable_before_runner_entered(tmp_path):\n+    store = tmp_path / \"evidence\"\n+    store.mkdir()\n+    observed = {}\n+\n+    def run_fn(slot):\n+        # The start record must already be on disk when the runner is entered.\n+        starts = replay_store.load_starts(store)\n+        observed[\"ids\"] = [s[\"run_id\"] for s in starts]\n+        observed[\"status\"] = starts[0][\"status\"]\n+        return _completed(slot)\n+\n+    replay_store.dispatch_slots(store, [_slot(\"run-x\")], run_fn,\n+                                started_at_utc=\"2026-11-21T00:00:00Z\")\n+    assert observed[\"ids\"] == [\"run-x\"]\n+    assert observed[\"status\"] == \"STARTED\"\n+    # The STARTED record is distinct from a fabricated completed application result.\n+    assert replay_store.load_starts(store)[0][\"outcome\"] == \"COMPLETED\"\n+    assert replay_store.load_starts(store)[0][\"status\"] == \"RESOLVED\"\n+\n+\n+def test_r3_03_later_failure_keeps_first_and_retains_later_start(tmp_path):\n+    store = tmp_path / \"evidence\"\n+    store.mkdir()\n+\n+    def run_fn(slot):\n+        if slot[\"run_id\"] == \"run-1-b\":\n+            raise RuntimeError(\"serialization failed\")\n+        return _completed(slot)\n+\n+    planned = [_slot(\"run-1\", trial=\"1\"), _slot(\"run-1-b\", trial=\"2\", case=\"GOV004-C2-explicit-empty\")]\n+    records = replay_store.dispatch_slots(store, planned, run_fn,\n+                                          started_at_utc=\"2026-11-21T00:00:00Z\")\n+\n+    assert records[0][\"outcome\"] == \"COMPLETED\"\n+    assert records[1][\"outcome\"] == \"ERROR\"\n+\n+    # The first attempt's outcome file persisted independently.\n+    first = store / \"gov004_attempt_run-1.json\"\n+    assert first.is_file()\n+    assert json.loads(first.read_text())[\"cases\"][0][\"outcome\"] == \"COMPLETED\"\n+    # The later start is retained as noncompleted (not silently lost).\n+    starts = {s[\"run_id\"]: s for s in replay_store.load_starts(store)}\n+    assert starts[\"run-1\"][\"status\"] == \"RESOLVED\"\n+    assert starts[\"run-1-b\"][\"status\"] == \"RESOLVED\"\n+    assert starts[\"run-1-b\"][\"outcome\"] == \"ERROR\"\n+\n+\n+def test_r3_04_unresolved_start_stays_noncompleted_and_blocks_reuse(tmp_path):\n+    store = tmp_path / \"evidence\"\n+    store.mkdir()\n+    replay_store.claim_start(store, case_id=\"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", run_id=\"open-slot\",\n+                             trial=\"1\", started_at_utc=\"2026-11-21T00:00:00Z\")\n+    # Reusing that slot must be refused.\n+    with pytest.raises(replay_store.ReplayError):\n+        replay_store.preflight_slots(store, [_slot(\"open-slot\")])\n+    # It ingests as a noncompleted attempt, never a fabricated COMPLETED.\n+    placeholders = replay_store.ingest_starts(store)\n+    assert placeholders[0][\"outcome\"] != \"COMPLETED\"\n+    assert placeholders[0][\"unresolved_start\"] is True\n+\n+\n+def test_r3_06_unique_files_and_exclusive_claim_in_one_second(tmp_path):\n+    store = tmp_path / \"evidence\"\n+    store.mkdir()\n+    stamp = \"2026-11-21T00:00:00Z\"\n+    replay_store.claim_start(store, case_id=\"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", run_id=\"slot-1\",\n+                             trial=\"1\", started_at_utc=stamp)\n+    replay_store.claim_start(store, case_id=\"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", run_id=\"slot-2\",\n+                             trial=\"2\", started_at_utc=stamp)\n+    # Two outcomes written within the same second do not overwrite.\n+    replay_store.record_outcome(store, run_id=\"slot-1\", outcome=_completed(_slot(\"slot-1\")))\n+    replay_store.record_outcome(store, run_id=\"slot-2\", outcome=_completed(_slot(\"slot-2\")))\n+    assert (store / \"gov004_attempt_slot-1.json\").is_file()\n+    assert (store / \"gov004_attempt_slot-2.json\").is_file()\n+    # A reused run ID claim is exclusive.\n+    with pytest.raises(replay_store.ReplayError):\n+        replay_store.claim_start(store, case_id=\"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", run_id=\"slot-1\",\n+                                 trial=\"1\", started_at_utc=stamp)\n+\n+\n+def test_r3_07_normal_multi_case_run_saves_all_outcomes(tmp_path):\n+    store = tmp_path / \"evidence\"\n+    store.mkdir()\n+    planned = [\n+        {\"case_id\": \"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", \"trial\": \"1\", \"run_id\": \"a1\"},\n+        {\"case_id\": \"GOV004-C2-explicit-empty\", \"trial\": \"1\", \"run_id\": \"b1\"},\n+        {\"case_id\": \"GOV004-C3-holdings-unknown-cash\", \"trial\": \"1\", \"run_id\": \"c1\"},\n+    ]\n+    records = replay_store.dispatch_slots(store, planned, _completed,\n+                                          started_at_utc=\"2026-11-21T00:00:00Z\")\n+    assert [r[\"outcome\"] for r in records] == [\"COMPLETED\"] * 3\n+    for run_id in (\"a1\", \"b1\", \"c1\"):\n+        assert (store / f\"gov004_attempt_{run_id}.json\").is_file()\n+\n+\n+def _scorer(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    monkeypatch.setenv(\"GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR\", str(tmp_path / \"evidence\"))\n+    if \"score_gov004\" in sys.modules:\n+        del sys.modules[\"score_gov004\"]\n+    return importlib.import_module(\"score_gov004\")\n+\n+\n+def test_r3_05_scorer_ingests_unresolved_start_into_denominator(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    store = tmp_path / \"evidence\"\n+    store.mkdir()\n+    replay_store.claim_start(store, case_id=\"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", run_id=\"open-slot\",\n+                             trial=\"1\", started_at_utc=\"2026-11-21T00:00:00Z\")\n+    scorer = _scorer(tmp_path, monkeypatch)\n+    attempts = scorer._load_attempts()\n+    assert len(attempts) == 1\n+    attempt = attempts[0]\n+    assert attempt.run_id == \"open-slot\"\n+    assert attempt.outcome != \"COMPLETED\"\n+    # A start cannot be counted as a completed report or passing quality cell.\n+    for attempt in attempts:\n+        scorer._check_eligibility(attempt)\n+    assert not (attempts[0].eligible and attempts[0].outcome == \"COMPLETED\")\n",

        "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_r4_research_manager_context.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_b_remediation/test_r4_research_manager_context.py\t\n+++ tests/member_b_remediation/test_r4_research_manager_context.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,209 @@\n+\"\"\"R4 — every decision stage, including the Research Manager, sees the trusted book.\n+\n+The review reproduced that the Research Manager prompt was identical for a\n+supplied explicit-empty portfolio and a supplied 40-unit holding: it consumed\n+only the boolean \"a portfolio string exists\", so its investment plan could\n+instruct a trim of a nonexistent position that Trader/PM later contradicted.\n+These tests capture the actual RM model prompt and assert the facts and the\n+no-nonzero-target instruction reach it under the same ``protect_context`` seam\n+as Trader/PM. Fake models only; no provider contact.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+from unittest.mock import MagicMock\n+\n+import pytest\n+from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage\n+\n+from tradingagents.agents.managers.portfolio_manager import create_portfolio_manager\n+from tradingagents.agents.managers.research_manager import create_research_manager\n+from tradingagents.agents.schemas import (\n+    PortfolioDecision,\n+    PortfolioRating,\n+    ResearchPlan,\n+    TraderAction,\n+    TraderProposal,\n+)\n+from tradingagents.agents.trader.trader import create_trader\n+from tradingagents.dataflows.config import run_config\n+from tradingagents.portfolio import PortfolioContext\n+\n+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n+\n+DEBATE = \"Bull says the trend is up. Bear says valuation is stretched.\"\n+\n+\n+def _state(book) -> dict:\n+    portfolio = PortfolioContext.model_validate(book) if book is not None else None\n+    return {\n+        \"company_of_interest\": \"AAPL\",\n+        \"instrument_context\": \"\",\n+        \"market_report\": \"\",\n+        \"investment_plan\": \"reduce existing exposure\",\n+        \"trader_investment_plan\": \"trim the held position\",\n+        \"portfolio_context\": portfolio.render(\"AAPL\") if portfolio else \"\",\n+        \"investment_debate_state\": {\n+            \"history\": DEBATE, \"bull_history\": \"BULL\", \"bear_history\": \"BEAR\",\n+            \"current_response\": \"\", \"count\": 1,\n+        },\n+        \"risk_debate_state\": dict.fromkeys(\n+            (\n+                \"history\", \"aggressive_history\", \"conservative_history\", \"neutral_history\",\n+                \"current_aggressive_response\", \"current_conservative_response\",\n+                \"current_neutral_response\",\n+            ),\n+            \"risk debate text\",\n+        ) | {\"count\": 1, \"latest_speaker\": \"Neutral\"},\n+    }\n+\n+\n+def _capturing_llm(result=None):\n+    captured: dict = {}\n+    structured = MagicMock()\n+    structured.invoke.side_effect = lambda prompt: (\n+        captured.__setitem__(\"prompt\", prompt) or result\n+    )\n+    llm = MagicMock()\n+    llm.with_structured_output.return_value = structured\n+    llm.invoke.return_value = AIMessage(content=\"Fallback text.\")\n+    return llm, captured\n+\n+\n+_RM_PLAN = ResearchPlan(\n+    recommendation=PortfolioRating.UNDERWEIGHT,\n+    rationale=\"Bear case carried on valuation.\",\n+    strategic_actions=\"Size against a standard allocation.\",\n+)\n+_TRADER = TraderProposal(action=TraderAction.SELL, reasoning=\"Avoid entry.\")\n+_PM = PortfolioDecision(\n+    rating=PortfolioRating.UNDERWEIGHT,\n+    executive_summary=\"Avoid entry.\",\n+    investment_thesis=\"Valuation stretched.\",\n+)\n+\n+\n+def _prompt_text(prompt) -> str:\n+    return prompt if isinstance(prompt, str) else \"\\n\".join(m[\"content\"] for m in prompt)\n+\n+\n+def _rm_prompt(book) -> str:\n+    llm, captured = _capturing_llm(_RM_PLAN)\n+    create_research_manager(llm)(_state(book))\n+    return _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"])\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_01_rm_prompt_distinguishes_absent_empty_and_held():\n+    absent = _rm_prompt(None)\n+    empty = _rm_prompt({\"positions\": []})\n+    held = _rm_prompt({\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": 40, \"average_price\": 190.0}]})\n+\n+    # Empty and held prompts are no longer identical.\n+    assert empty != held\n+    # The absent case is \"unknown\", never asserted flat.\n+    assert \"no account ownership is assumed\" in absent.lower()\n+    assert \"No current position in AAPL\" not in absent\n+    # The empty case carries the no-nonzero-target instruction; the held case does not.\n+    assert \"no nonzero target position\" in empty\n+    assert \"no nonzero target position\" not in held\n+    # The held case carries the supplied quantity; the empty case does not invent it.\n+    assert \"40\" in held and \"40\" not in empty\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_01_all_three_decision_stages_share_the_trusted_facts():\n+    book = {\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": 40, \"average_price\": 190.0}]}\n+    state = _state(book)\n+    for factory, result in (\n+        (create_research_manager, _RM_PLAN),\n+        (create_trader, _TRADER),\n+        (create_portfolio_manager, _PM),\n+    ):\n+        llm, captured = _capturing_llm(result)\n+        factory(llm)(state)\n+        text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"])\n+        assert \"<protected_context>\" in text\n+        assert \"40\" in text, f\"{factory.__name__} prompt lacks the supplied quantity\"\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"book\", [\n+    {\"positions\": []},\n+    {\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"MSFT\", \"quantity\": 5}]},\n+    {\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": 0}]},\n+])\n+def test_r4_02_no_nonzero_target_instruction(book):\n+    text = _rm_prompt(book)\n+    assert \"no nonzero target position\" in text\n+    assert \"there is nothing to trim\" in text or \"Do not recommend reducing\" in text\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_02_absent_is_unknown_not_flat():\n+    text = _rm_prompt(None)\n+    assert \"no account ownership is assumed\" in text.lower()\n+    # Unknown is not escalated to the asserted-flat instruction.\n+    assert \"no nonzero target position\" not in text\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_03_signed_quantities_cash_and_unverified_preserved():\n+    short = _rm_prompt({\n+        \"cash\": 0.0, \"currency\": \"USD\",\n+        \"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": -10, \"average_price\": 150}],\n+    })\n+    assert \"-10\" in short\n+    assert \"Cash available: 0.00 USD\" in short\n+\n+    unknown_cash = _rm_prompt({\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": 10}]})\n+    assert \"Available funds were not supplied\" in unknown_cash\n+    assert \"0.00\" not in unknown_cash\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_04_protected_facts_survive_compaction():\n+    state = _state({\"positions\": [{\"ticker\": \"AAPL\", \"quantity\": 40}]})\n+    # Bury the facts between a long opening and trailing debate so only compaction\n+    # could drop them, and add conflicting upstream ownership prose elsewhere.\n+    state[\"investment_debate_state\"][\"history\"] = (\n+        \"opening \" * 2000 + \"CONFLICTING: you hold a large position to trim. \" + \"tail \" * 3000\n+    )\n+    llm, captured = _capturing_llm(_RM_PLAN)\n+    with run_config({\"context_cap_tokens\": 3000, \"compaction_threshold_tokens\": 2500}):\n+        create_research_manager(llm)(state)\n+    text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"])\n+    assert len(text) <= 12000\n+    assert \"40\" in text\n+    assert \"supplied signed quantities\" in text\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_06_seven_rating_and_three_action_vocabulary_retained():\n+    text = _rm_prompt({\"positions\": []})\n+    for tier in (\"Buy\", \"Overweight\", \"Hold\", \"Underweight\", \"Sell\"):\n+        assert f\"**{tier}**\" in text\n+\n+\n+def test_r4_05_report_retains_rm_trader_pm_sections(tmp_path):\n+    \"\"\"The delivered report keeps RM/Trader/PM as separate labelled sections.\"\"\"\n+    from tradingagents.runapi.context import ConsentState\n+    from tradingagents.runapi.execution import run_analysis_api\n+    from tradingagents.runapi.input_service import freeze_explicit\n+\n+    state = {\n+        \"market_report\": \"MKT\",\n+        \"investment_debate_state\": {\"bull_history\": \"BULL\", \"bear_history\": \"BEAR\"},\n+        \"investment_plan\": \"**Recommendation**: Underweight\\n\\nRM stage text.\",\n+        \"trader_investment_plan\": \"**Action**: Sell\\n\\nTrader stage text.\",\n+        \"final_trade_decision\": \"**Rating**: Underweight\\n\\nPM stage text.\",\n+        \"final_rating\": \"Underweight\",\n+    }\n+\n+    class _Engine:\n+        pass\n+\n+    factory = lambda *a, **k: _Engine()  # noqa: E731\n+    runner = lambda g, c: state  # noqa: E731\n+    ctx = freeze_explicit(\"AAPL\", \"2026-11-12\", PortfolioContext.model_validate({\"positions\": []}))\n+    assert ctx.consent_state == ConsentState.FROZEN\n+    result = run_analysis_api(\n+        ctx.confirm(), config={\"results_dir\": str(tmp_path), \"selected_analysts\": [\"market\"]},\n+        selected_analysts=[\"market\"], graph_factory=factory, engine_runner=runner,\n+    )\n+    report = (tmp_path / \"AAPL\" / result.run_id / \"reports\" / \"complete_report.md\").read_text()\n+    for heading in (\"### Research Manager\", \"### Trader\", \"### Portfolio Manager\"):\n+        assert heading in report\n",
        "additions": 209,
        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "added"
      },

        "file": "tests/member_b_remediation/test_r5_terminal_visibility.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_r5_terminal_visibility.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_b_remediation/test_r5_terminal_visibility.py\t\n+++ tests/member_b_remediation/test_r5_terminal_visibility.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,164 @@\n+\"\"\"R5 — a failed publication must not leave a caller-visible COMPLETED terminal.\n+\n+``publish_run`` used to emit ``run.terminal=COMPLETED`` directly into the\n+caller-supplied ``EventSink`` *before* the critical commit. When the final rename\n+failed the result was correctly INCOMPLETE/PERSISTENCE_ERROR, but the caller's\n+sink already held a COMPLETED terminal. These tests drive the real\n+``run_analysis_api`` boundary and inspect both the returned result and the\n+caller-owned sink. Fake graph/runner only; no provider or network.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import json\n+\n+import pytest\n+\n+from tradingagents.runapi.events import EventSink\n+from tradingagents.runapi.execution import run_analysis_api\n+from tradingagents.runapi.input_service import freeze_explicit\n+\n+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n+\n+STATE = {\n+    \"market_report\": \"MKT\",\n+    \"investment_debate_state\": {\"bull_history\": \"BULL\", \"bear_history\": \"BEAR\"},\n+    \"investment_plan\": \"RESEARCH PLAN\",\n+    \"trader_investment_plan\": \"TRADE PLAN\",\n+    \"risk_debate_state\": {\"neutral_history\": \"NEUTRAL\"},\n+    \"final_trade_decision\": \"**Rating**: Hold\\n\\nBalanced view.\",\n+    \"final_rating\": \"Hold\",\n+}\n+\n+\n+def _run(tmp_path, sink, *, raises=None):\n+    class _Engine:\n+        pass\n+\n+    def factory(*_a, **_k):\n+        return _Engine()\n+\n+    def runner(_graph, _context):\n+        if raises is not None:\n+            raise raises\n+        return STATE\n+\n+    ctx = freeze_explicit(\"AAPL\", \"2026-11-12\", None).confirm()\n+    return run_analysis_api(\n+        ctx, config={\"results_dir\": str(tmp_path), \"selected_analysts\": [\"market\"]},\n+        selected_analysts=[\"market\"], graph_factory=factory, engine_runner=runner,\n+        event_sink=sink,\n+    )\n+\n+\n+def _terminal_outcomes(sink):\n+    return [e[\"event_outcome\"] for e in sink.events if e[\"event\"] == \"run.terminal\"]\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_01_rename_failure_exposes_incomplete_terminal_only(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    from tradingagents.runapi import persist\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(persist.os, \"rename\", lambda *_a, **_k: (_ for _ in ()).throw(\n+        OSError(\"simulated commit rename failure\")))\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-01\", \"AAPL\")\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink)\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"INCOMPLETE\"\n+    assert result.stop_reason == \"PERSISTENCE_ERROR\"\n+    assert result.output_check == \"NOT_RUN\"\n+    assert result.final_rating is None\n+    assert result.manifest_path is None and result.report_path is None\n+    assert not (tmp_path / \"AAPL\" / result.run_id).exists()\n+\n+    terminals = _terminal_outcomes(sink)\n+    assert terminals == [\"INCOMPLETE\"], terminals\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_02_critical_manifest_write_failure_is_consistent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    import pathlib\n+\n+    original = pathlib.Path.write_text\n+\n+    def flaky(self, *a, **k):\n+        if self.name == \"manifest.json.tmp\":\n+            raise OSError(\"simulated manifest write failure\")\n+        return original(self, *a, **k)\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, \"write_text\", flaky)\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-02\", \"AAPL\")\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink)\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"INCOMPLETE\"\n+    assert result.stop_reason == \"PERSISTENCE_ERROR\"\n+    assert result.manifest_path is None\n+    assert _terminal_outcomes(sink) == [\"INCOMPLETE\"]\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_03_terminal_append_failure_keeps_logical_outcome(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    from pathlib import Path\n+\n+    from tradingagents.runapi import events as events_module\n+\n+    original_replace = events_module.os.replace\n+\n+    def flaky_replace(src, dst, *a, **k):\n+        if Path(dst).name == \"events.jsonl\":\n+            raise OSError(\"simulated terminal append failure\")\n+        return original_replace(src, dst, *a, **k)\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(events_module.os, \"replace\", flaky_replace)\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-03\", \"AAPL\")\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink)\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"COMPLETED\"\n+    assert result.final_rating == \"Hold\"\n+    assert _terminal_outcomes(sink) == [\"COMPLETED\"]\n+    data = json.loads((tmp_path / \"AAPL\" / result.run_id / \"manifest.json\").read_text())\n+    assert data[\"terminal_event\"][\"durable\"] is False\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_04_normal_completed_has_one_matching_terminal(tmp_path):\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-04\", \"AAPL\")\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink)\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"COMPLETED\"\n+    assert _terminal_outcomes(sink) == [\"COMPLETED\"]\n+    record = [e for e in sink.events if e[\"event\"] == \"run.terminal\"][0]\n+    assert record[\"node\"] == \"output\" and record[\"ts\"]\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_04_normal_engine_incomplete_has_one_matching_terminal(tmp_path):\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-04b\", \"AAPL\")\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink, raises=RuntimeError(\"engine failed\"))\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"INCOMPLETE\"\n+    assert _terminal_outcomes(sink) == [\"INCOMPLETE\"]\n+\n+\n+def test_r5_05_tentative_terminal_not_exposed_before_commit(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n+    \"\"\"While the critical manifest write is pending, no terminal is caller-visible.\"\"\"\n+    import pathlib\n+\n+    from tradingagents.runapi import persist\n+\n+    original_text = pathlib.Path.write_text\n+    original_rename = persist.os.rename\n+    seen = {}\n+\n+    def failing_manifest(self, *a, **k):\n+        if self.name == \"manifest.json.tmp\":\n+            raise OSError(\"simulated manifest failure\")\n+        return original_text(self, *a, **k)\n+\n+    sink = EventSink(\"r5-05\", \"AAPL\")\n+\n+    def spy_rename(src, dst, *a, **k):\n+        return original_rename(src, dst, *a, **k)\n+\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(pathlib.Path, \"write_text\", failing_manifest)\n+    monkeypatch.setattr(persist.os, \"rename\", spy_rename)\n+    result = _run(tmp_path, sink)\n+    seen[\"terminals\"] = _terminal_outcomes(sink)\n+\n+    assert result.run_outcome == \"INCOMPLETE\"\n+    assert seen[\"terminals\"] == [\"INCOMPLETE\"]\n",
        "additions": 164,
        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "added"
      },

        "file": "tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py\t\n+++ tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@\n+\"\"\"Durable per-attempt accounting for the GOV-004 replay harness (R3).\n+\n+The runner used to accumulate outcomes in memory and write one evidence JSON\n+only after *every* selected case finished. A later abort (validation, execution\n+or serialization error) then discarded the record of cases already started, and\n+the next invocation's reuse check saw nothing -- so a formal slot could be\n+silently re-run.\n+\n+This module makes each attempt durable on its own:\n+\n+* :func:`preflight_slots` validates the whole selected cohort *before* dispatch:\n+  one planned slot per case/trial, not already started. Nothing runs on failure.\n+* :func:`claim_start` atomically appends a versioned ``STARTED`` record *before*\n+  the case is invoked; a reused run ID is refused (exclusive claim).\n+* :func:`record_outcome` writes the attempt's terminal outcome independently and\n+  atomically, so a later case's failure cannot erase an earlier start/outcome.\n+* :func:`ingest_starts` lets the scorer see retained, unresolved starts and\n+  count them as noncompleted rather than completed.\n+\n+All writes go through a temp-file replace in the harness evidence directory and\n+are unique per run ID, so two starts within one second cannot overwrite.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+import json\n+import os\n+from pathlib import Path\n+\n+STARTS_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2\n+STARTS_FILENAME = \"gov004_starts.json\"\n+\n+\n+class ReplayError(RuntimeError):\n+    \"\"\"A preflight or claim failure that must stop the replay before dispatch.\"\"\"\n+\n+\n+def _starts_path(evidence_root: str | Path) -> Path:\n+    return Path(evidence_root) / STARTS_FILENAME\n+\n+\n+def _read_json(path: Path, default):\n+    try:\n+        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n+    except FileNotFoundError:\n+        return default\n+\n+\n+def _atomic_write(path: Path, payload: dict) -> None:\n+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n+    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + \".tmp\")\n+    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+    os.replace(temporary, path)\n+\n+\n+def load_starts(evidence_root: str | Path) -> list[dict]:\n+    data = _read_json(_starts_path(evidence_root), None)\n+    if not data:\n+        return []\n+    if data.get(\"kind\") != \"formal\" or data.get(\"schema_version\") != STARTS_SCHEMA_VERSION:\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Unrecognised start-record schema; refuse to mix populations\")\n+    starts = data.get(\"starts\")\n+    if not isinstance(starts, list):\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Start record is malformed\")\n+    return starts\n+\n+\n+def _save_starts(evidence_root: str | Path, starts: list[dict]) -> None:\n+    _atomic_write(_starts_path(evidence_root), {\n+        \"kind\": \"formal\", \"schema_version\": STARTS_SCHEMA_VERSION, \"starts\": starts,\n+    })\n+\n+\n+def _started_run_ids(evidence_root: str | Path) -> set[str]:\n+    ids = {s.get(\"run_id\") for s in load_starts(evidence_root)}\n+    # Also treat any completed outcome file's run IDs as started (legacy evidence).\n+    for path in sorted(Path(evidence_root).glob(\"gov004_*.json\")):\n+        if path.name in {STARTS_FILENAME, \"gov004_scores.json\"}:\n+            continue\n+        try:\n+            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n+        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):\n+            continue\n+        for row in data.get(\"cases\", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []:\n+            if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get(\"run_id\"):\n+                ids.add(row[\"run_id\"])\n+    return ids - {None}\n+\n+\n+def preflight_slots(evidence_root: str | Path, planned: list[dict]) -> None:\n+    \"\"\"Validate every selected slot before dispatch (R3-01, R3-04, R3-06).\n+\n+    ``planned`` is a list of ``{case_id, run_id, trial}``. A missing/duplicate\n+    planned run ID, or one already started, raises :class:`ReplayError`; no case\n+    is executed and no start record is written on failure.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    planned_ids = [slot.get(\"run_id\") for slot in planned]\n+    if any(not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id for run_id in planned_ids):\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Every selected slot needs a declared run ID\")\n+    if len(set(planned_ids)) != len(planned_ids):\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Duplicate planned run ID across selected slots\")\n+    cells = [(slot.get(\"case_id\"), str(slot.get(\"trial\"))) for slot in planned]\n+    if len(set(cells)) != len(cells):\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Two selected slots share a case/trial\")\n+    already = _started_run_ids(evidence_root) & set(planned_ids)\n+    if already:\n+        raise ReplayError(\n+            f\"Cohort slot(s) already started; record retries separately: {sorted(already)}\")\n+\n+\n+def claim_start(evidence_root: str | Path, *, case_id: str, run_id: str, trial: str,\n+                started_at_utc: str) -> dict:\n+    \"\"\"Persist a STARTED record before the case runs; refuse a reused run ID.\"\"\"\n+    starts = load_starts(evidence_root)\n+    if any(s.get(\"run_id\") == run_id for s in starts):\n+        raise ReplayError(f\"Run ID {run_id} was already claimed\")\n+    record = {\n+        \"case_id\": case_id, \"run_id\": run_id, \"trial\": str(trial),\n+        \"started_at_utc\": started_at_utc, \"status\": \"STARTED\", \"outcome\": None,\n+    }\n+    starts.append(record)\n+    _save_starts(evidence_root, starts)\n+    return record\n+\n+\n+def record_outcome(evidence_root: str | Path, *, run_id: str, outcome: dict) -> Path:\n+    \"\"\"Persist one attempt's outcome as its own uniquely named evidence file.\n+\n+    The file is keyed by run ID (not a shared timestamp), so two attempts that\n+    begin in the same second never overwrite each other. The matching STARTED\n+    record is marked resolved; a start left unresolved stays noncompleted.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    if not run_id:\n+        raise ReplayError(\"Cannot record an outcome without a run ID\")\n+    evidence_path = Path(evidence_root) / f\"gov004_attempt_{run_id}.json\"\n+    _atomic_write(evidence_path, {\n+        \"kind\": \"formal\", \"schema_version\": STARTS_SCHEMA_VERSION, \"cases\": [outcome],\n+    })\n+    starts = load_starts(evidence_root)\n+    for start in starts:\n+        if start.get(\"run_id\") == run_id:\n+            start[\"status\"] = \"RESOLVED\"\n+            start[\"outcome\"] = outcome.get(\"outcome\")\n+            break\n+    _save_starts(evidence_root, starts)\n+    return evidence_path\n+\n+\n+def dispatch_slots(evidence_root: str | Path, planned: list[dict], run_fn,\n+                   *, started_at_utc: str) -> list[dict]:\n+    \"\"\"Preflight the whole cohort, then claim+run+record each slot durably (R3).\n+\n+    ``planned`` is a list of ``{case_id, trial, run_id}`` (plus any opaque payload\n+    the caller's ``run_fn`` needs). Preflight runs before *any* dispatch.         "patch": "Index: tradingagents/agents/managers/research_manager.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/agents/managers/research_manager.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/agents/managers/research_manager.py\t\n@@ -1,81 +1,90 @@\n \"\"\"Research Manager: turns the bull/bear debate into a structured investment plan for the trader.\"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n from tradingagents.agents.context import (\n     get_instrument_context_from_state,\n     get_language_instruction,\n+    get_portfolio_context_from_state,\n     protect_context,\n )\n from tradingagents.agents.schemas import ResearchPlan, render_research_plan\n from tradingagents.agents.structured import (\n     NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS,\n     bind_structured,\n     invoke_structured_or_freetext,\n )\n \n \n def create_research_manager(llm):\n     structured_llm = bind_structured(llm, ResearchPlan, \"Research Manager\")\n \n     def research_manager_node(state) -> dict:\n         instrument_context = protect_context(get_instrument_context_from_state(state))\n+        # The same trusted, user-supplied book the Trader and PM receive, so the\n+        # investment plan cannot instruct trimming or retaining a position the\n+        # caller does not hold, and \"unknown\" is never asserted as flat (R4).\n+        portfolio_context = protect_context(get_portfolio_context_from_state(state))\n         has_portfolio = bool((state.get(\"portfolio_context\") or \"\").strip())\n         hold_meaning = (\"maintain only an explicitly supplied nonzero target position; if flat, remain flat\" if has_portfolio else\n                         \"the evidence supports no new directional action; do not interpret Hold as maintaining an assumed position\")\n         history = state[\"investment_debate_state\"].get(\"history\", \"\")\n \n         investment_debate_state = state[\"investment_debate_state\"]\n \n         prompt = f\"\"\"As the Research Manager and debate facilitator, your role is to critically evaluate this round of debate and deliver a clear, actionable investment plan for the trader.\n \n {instrument_context}\n \n+{portfolio_context}\n+\n ---\n \n **Rating Scale** (use exactly one):\n - **Buy**: Strong conviction in the bull thesis; recommend taking or growing the position\n - **Overweight**: Constructive view; recommend gradually increasing exposure\n - **Hold**: Balanced view; {hold_meaning}\n - **Underweight**: Cautious view; trim only an explicitly supplied existing long position, otherwise avoid entry\n - **Sell**: Strong conviction in the bear thesis; recommend exiting or avoiding the position\n \n The debate always contains conflicting arguments; deciding which side is stronger is the job, so conflict alone is not a reason to Hold. Commit to the side with the stronger case, sized by how decisively it wins. Choose Hold only when the evidence is still balanced after that weighing, or too thin to support a call; do not manufacture a direction to appear decisive. Weigh the bull and bear cases on their merits, independent of which side spoke first or last.\n \n+The supplied portfolio facts above are authoritative over any ownership premise stated in the debate or later stages: do not assume a position the caller does not hold, do not describe trimming or retaining a nonexistent position, and state cash or holdings the caller did not supply as unknown rather than zero.\n+\n ---\n \n **Debate History:**\n {history}\n \n ## Output\n \n Write these sections, in this order, starting with the recommendation on its own line:\n \n - **Recommendation**: exactly one of Buy / Overweight / Hold / Underweight / Sell\n - **Rationale**: which arguments decided it\n - **Strategic Actions**: concrete steps for the trader, sized against a standard allocation\n \n {NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS}\"\"\" + get_language_instruction()\n \n         investment_plan = invoke_structured_or_freetext(\n             structured_llm,\n             llm,\n             prompt,\n             render_research_plan,\n             \"Research Manager\",\n         )\n \n         new_investment_debate_state = {\n             \"history\": investment_debate_state.get(\"history\", \"\"),\n             \"bear_history\": investment_debate_state.get(\"bear_history\", \"\"),\n             \"bull_history\": investment_debate_state.get(\"bull_history\", \"\"),\n             \"current_response\": investment_plan,\n             \"count\": investment_debate_state[\"count\"],\n         }\n \n         return {\n             \"investment_debate_state\": new_investment_debate_state,\n             \"investment_plan\": investment_plan,\n         }\n \n     return research_manager_node\n",

        "file": "tradingagents/agents/structured.py",
        "patch": "Index: tradingagents/agents/structured.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/agents/structured.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/agents/structured.py\t\n@@ -1,101 +1,118 @@\n \"\"\"Shared helpers for invoking an agent with structured output and a graceful fallback.\n \n The Portfolio Manager, Trader, and Research Manager all follow the same\n canonical pattern:\n \n 1. At agent creation, wrap the LLM with ``with_structured_output(Schema)``\n    so the model returns a typed Pydantic instance. If the provider does\n    not support structured output (rare; mostly older Ollama models), the\n    wrap is skipped and the agent uses free-text generation instead.\n 2. At invocation, run the structured call and render the result back to\n    markdown. If the structured call itself fails for any reason\n    (malformed JSON from a weak model, transient provider issue), fall\n    back to a plain ``llm.invoke`` so the pipeline never blocks.\n \n Centralising the pattern here keeps the agent factories small and ensures\n all three agents log the same warnings when fallback fires.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import logging\n from collections.abc import Callable\n from typing import Any, TypeVar\n \n from pydantic import BaseModel\n \n from tradingagents.agents.context import ContextBudgetError, bound_agent_prompt\n+from tradingagents.runapi.redact import Redactor\n \n logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n \n T = TypeVar(\"T\", bound=BaseModel)\n \n+\n+def _diagnostic(exc: BaseException) -> str:\n+    \"\"\"Redact provider error detail before it reaches any logging sink.\n+\n+    A provider exception can echo an ``API_KEY=[REDACTED] assignment, a bearer [REDACTED] or\n+    a configured value. These warnings fire before report/event redaction, so the\n+    shared :class:`Redactor` is applied here at the callsite (R1). Redaction is\n+    tolerant: if the environment-snapshot redactor cannot be built, the error\n+    text is dropped rather than logged raw.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    try:\n+        return Redactor().diagnostic(exc)\n+    except Exception:  # pragma: no cover - defensive only\n+        return f\"{type(exc).__name__}: [redaction unavailable]\"\n+\n+\n # Schema-only structured output binds exactly one tool (the schema itself), so a\n # model that reaches for a search tool emits an unknown tool call and the whole\n # structured attempt is discarded for a free-text retry. Agents on this path\n # state the constraint explicitly rather than relying on the binding alone\n # (#1130).\n NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS = (\n     \"Use only the evidence provided in this prompt. Do not call external tools \"\n     \"or search the web; if something is missing, say so explicitly.\"\n )\n \n \n def bind_structured(llm: Any, schema: type[T], agent_name: str) -> Any | None:\n     \"\"\"Return ``llm.with_structured_output(schema)`` or ``None`` if unsupported.\n \n     Logs a warning when the binding fails so the user understands the agent\n     will use free-text generation for every call instead of one-shot fallback.\n     \"\"\"\n     try:\n         return llm.with_structured_output(schema)\n     except (NotImplementedError, AttributeError) as exc:\n         logger.warning(\n             \"%s: provider does not support with_structured_output (%s); \"\n             \"falling back to free-text generation\",\n-            agent_name, exc,\n+            agent_name, _diagnostic(exc),\n         )\n         return None\n \n \n def invoke_structured(structured_llm: Any | None, prompt: Any, agent_name: str) -> T | None:\n     \"\"\"Run the structured call; ``None`` when there is none or it fails.\n \n     ``prompt`` is whatever the underlying LLM accepts (a string for chat\n     invocations, a list of message dicts for chat models that take that\n     shape), so a caller can forward the same value to its free-text fallback.\n     \"\"\"\n     if structured_llm is None:\n         return None\n     prompt = bound_agent_prompt(prompt)\n     try:\n         result = structured_llm.invoke(prompt)\n         if result is None:\n             # A thinking model can answer in plain text instead of calling\n             # the tool, leaving the parser with nothing to return. Treat it\n             # as a structured miss and fall back, with a clear reason.\n             raise ValueError(\"structured output returned no parsed result\")\n         return result\n     except ContextBudgetError:\n         raise\n     except Exception as exc:\n         logger.warning(\n             \"%s: structured-output invocation failed (%s); retrying once as free text\",\n-            agent_name, exc,\n+            agent_name, _diagnostic(exc),\n         )\n         return None\n \n \n def invoke_structured_or_freetext(\n     structured_llm: Any | None,\n     plain_llm: Any,\n     prompt: Any,\n     render: Callable[[T], str],\n     agent_name: str,\n ) -> str:\n     \"\"\"Run the structured call and render to markdown; fall back to free-text on any failure.\"\"\"\n     prompt = bound_agent_prompt(prompt)\n     result = invoke_structured(structured_llm, prompt, agent_name)\n     if result is not None:\n         return render(result)\n     return plain_llm.invoke(prompt).content\n",
        "additions": 19,
        "deletions": 2,
        "status": "modified"
      },

        "file": "tradingagents/runapi/events.py",
        "patch": "Index: tradingagents/runapi/events.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/runapi/events.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/runapi/events.py\t\n@@ -1,50 +1,93 @@\n \"\"\"Bounded JSONL lifecycle events; never accepts model or portfolio payloads.\"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import json\n import os\n import time\n from contextlib import suppress\n from datetime import UTC, datetime\n from pathlib import Path\n \n \n class EventSink:\n     def __init__(self, run_id: str, ticker: str, redactor=None):\n         self.run_id = run_id\n         self.ticker = ticker\n         self.redactor = redactor\n         self.started = time.monotonic()\n         self.events: list[dict] = []\n         self._terminal_added = False\n+        # Stage-private tentative terminal: built during publication and only\n+        # revealed to callers when the critical commit resolves (R5).\n+        self._tentative_terminal: dict | None = None\n \n     def emit(self, node: str, event: str, event_outcome: str) -> dict:\n         if node not in {\"input\", \"engine\", \"output\"}:\n             raise ValueError(\"event node must be input, engine, or output\")\n         if event == \"run.terminal\":\n-            if self._terminal_added:\n+            if self._terminal_added or self._tentative_terminal is not None:\n                 raise ValueError(\"only one terminal event may be recorded\")\n             self._terminal_added = True\n         entry = {\n             \"run_id\": self.run_id, \"ticker\": self.ticker, \"node\": node,\n             \"ts\": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace(\"+00:00\", \"Z\"),\n             \"elapsed_ms\": max(0, int((time.monotonic() - self.started) * 1000)),\n             \"event\": event, \"event_outcome\": event_outcome,\n         }\n         if self.redactor:\n             entry = self.redactor.scrub(entry)\n         self.events.append(entry)\n         return entry\n \n+    def stage_tentative_terminal(self, event_outcome: str) -> dict:\n+        \"\"\"Build a caller-invisible terminal candidate for the staging commit.\n+\n+        The candidate is included in any immediate ``write_to`` (so the staged\n+        ``events.jsonl`` carries the intended logical outcome), but it is not in\n+        ``self.events`` and so is not visible to a caller inspecting the sink.\n+        A later :meth:`commit_terminal` or :meth:`discard_tentative_terminal`\n+        resolves it; a caller cannot see a terminal it has not committed.\n+        \"\"\"\n+        if self._terminal_added or self._tentative_terminal is not None:\n+            raise ValueError(\"only one terminal event may be recorded\")\n+        entry = {\n+            \"run_id\": self.run_id, \"ticker\": self.ticker, \"node\": \"output\",\n+            \"ts\": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat().replace(\"+00:00\", \"Z\"),\n+            \"elapsed_ms\": max(0, int((time.monotonic() - self.started) * 1000)),\n+            \"event\": \"run.terminal\", \"event_outcome\": event_outcome,\n+        }\n+        if self.redactor:\n+            entry = self.redactor.scrub(entry)\n+        self._tentative_terminal = entry\n+        return entry\n+\n+    def commit_terminal(self) -> dict:\n+        \"\"\"Reveal the staged terminal to callers once publication succeeded.\"\"\"\n+        if self._tentative_terminal is None:\n+            raise ValueError(\"no tentative terminal to commit\")\n+        entry = self._tentative_terminal\n+        self._tentative_terminal = None\n+        self.events.append(entry)\n+        return entry\n+\n+    def discard_tentative_terminal(self) -> None:\n+        \"\"\"Drop the staged terminal after a failed publication (R5).\"\"\"\n+        self._tentative_terminal = None\n+\n+    def _terminal_for_write(self) -> dict | None:\n+        return self._tentative_terminal\n+\n     def write_to(self, path: Path) -> bool:\n         temporary = path.with_name(path.name + \".tmp\")\n+        staged = self._terminal_for_write()\n         try:\n             temporary.write_text(\"\".join(json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\"\n-                                               for event in self.events), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n+                                               for event in [*self.events, *([staged] if staged else [])]),\n+                                 encoding=\"utf-8\")\n             os.replace(temporary, path)\n             return True\n         except OSError:\n             with suppress(OSError):\n                 temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)\n             return False\n",
        "additions": 45,
        "deletions": 2,
        "status": "modified"
