        "file": "tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py\t\n+++ tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py\t\n@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@\n+\"\"\"L1 — Trader numerical grounding (bounded prompt correction).\n+\n+Approved by the live-found Trader arithmetic error (C3 `20261121T093733Z-8c832879`:\n+stop 255.33 described as ~1.5xATR/6.6 points below a 258.47 close with ATR 4.39,\n+while the real difference is 3.14 = ~0.715xATR). These tests capture the actual\n+Trader prompt on both the structured and free-text paths. They assert the\n+instruction reaches the model; they cannot prove live model compliance.\n+\"\"\"\n+\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+from unittest.mock import MagicMock\n+\n+import pytest\n+from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage\n+\n+from tradingagents.agents.schemas import TraderAction, TraderProposal\n+from tradingagents.agents.trader.trader import create_trader\n+\n+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n+\n+MARKET_REPORT = (\n+    \"AAPL closed at 258.47. ATR(14) = 4.39. Support 255.33, resistance 262.10. \"\n+    \"The research plan claims the stop is roughly 1.5xATR (6.6 points) below the close.\"\n+)\n+INVESTMENT_PLAN = (\n+    \"**Recommendation**: Underweight\\n\"\n+    \"**Rationale**: momentum faded; the stop at 255.33 sits about 1.5xATR below 258.47.\\n\"\n+    \"**Strategic Actions**: size against a standard allocation.\"\n+)\n+PORTFOLIO_BLOCK = (\n+    \"Portfolio at the analysis date:\\n\"\n+    \"These holdings and cash are user-supplied and unverified; treat them as the caller's \"\n+    \"stated snapshot, not an authenticated account.\\n\"\n+    \"- Current position in AAPL: 40 units, average price 190.00\\n\"\n+    \"Available funds were not supplied; do not invent a balance or affordability.\"\n+)\n+\n+\n+def _state():\n+    return {\n+        \"company_of_interest\": \"AAPL\",\n+        \"instrument_context\": \"\",\n+        \"market_report\": MARKET_REPORT,\n+        \"investment_plan\": INVESTMENT_PLAN,\n+        \"portfolio_context\": PORTFOLIO_BLOCK,\n+    }\n+\n+\n+def _structured_llm(captured):\n+    proposal = TraderProposal(action=TraderAction.SELL, reasoning=\"Fade.\")\n+    structured = MagicMock()\n+    structured.invoke.side_effect = lambda prompt: captured.__setitem__(\"prompt\", prompt) or proposal\n+    llm = MagicMock()\n+    llm.with_structured_output.return_value = structured\n+    return llm\n+\n+\n+def _fallback_llm(captured):\n+    llm = MagicMock()\n+    llm.with_structured_output.side_effect = NotImplementedError(\"no structured output\")\n+    llm.invoke.side_effect = lambda prompt: (captured.__setitem__(\"prompt\", prompt)\n+                                             or AIMessage(content=\"**Action**: Sell\\n\\nFade.\"))\n+    return llm\n+\n+\n+def _prompt_text(prompt) -> str:\n+    return prompt if isinstance(prompt, str) else \"\\n\".join(m[\"content\"] for m in prompt)\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"builder\", [_structured_llm, _fallback_llm], ids=[\"structured\", \"fallback\"])\n+def test_l1_01_numeric_grounding_reaches_model(builder):\n+    captured = {}\n+    create_trader(builder(captured))(_state())\n+    text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"]).lower()\n+\n+    # General instruction to recompute distances/multiples from explicit anchors.\n+    assert \"recompute\" in text or \"compute\" in text\n+    assert \"atr\" in text\n+    # Absolute distance and multiple guidance with the positive-ATR guard.\n+    assert \"absolute\" in text or \"abs(\" in text\n+    assert \"multiple\" in text and (\"positive\" in text or \"nonzero\" in text)\n+    # Correct inconsistent upstream arithmetic rather than repeat it.\n+    assert \"upstream\" in text or \"research\" in text\n+    assert \"do not repeat\" in text or \"not repeat\" in text or \"correct\" in text\n+    # Never assert guaranteed/locked gains.\n+    assert \"guarantee\" in text or \"locked\" in text\n+    # Omit unsupported ratios / say unknown.\n+    assert \"unknown\" in text or \"omit\" in text\n+    # Source values and portfolio facts are preserved.\n+    for anchor in (\"258.47\", \"255.33\", \"4.39\"):\n+        assert anchor in text\n+    assert \"40\" in text\n+    assert \"user-supplied and unverified\" in text\n+\n+\n+def test_l1_01_no_hardcoded_observed_values_in_instruction():\n+    \"\"\"The prompt must be general, not hardcode the observed 3.14/0.715 numbers.\"\"\"\n+    captured = {}\n+    create_trader(_structured_llm(captured))(_state())\n+    system = \"\\n\".join(m[\"content\"] for m in captured[\"prompt\"] if m[\"role\"] == \"system\")\n+    assert \"3.14\" not in system and \"0.715\" not in system\n+    # Absolute-price/action/vocabulary constraints are unchanged.\n+    assert \"absolute price\" in system.lower()\n+    assert \"Buy / Hold / Sell\" in _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"])\n+\n+\n+def test_l1_04_missing_atr_is_not_required_to_fabricate():\n+    captured = {}\n+    state = _state()\n+    state[\"market_report\"] = \"AAPL closed at 258.47. Support 255.33; resistance 262.10.\"\n+    create_trader(_structured_llm(captured))(state)\n+    text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"]).lower()\n+    # The instruction still asks to omit/mark-unknown unsupported ratios.\n+    assert \"unknown\" in text or \"omit\" in text\n+    # No ATR figure is invented into the prompt by our instruction.\n+    assert \"atr(14) = 4.39\" not in text\n",
        "additions": 117,
        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "added"
      },

str(LIVE_DIR))\n \n import runner  # noqa: E402\n \n pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n \n \n # --- #1 isolated evidence root ----------------------------------------------\n \n \n def run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n         (run_dir / \"reports\").mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n         report = run_dir / \"reports\" / \"complete_report.md\"\n         report.write_text(\"# case_id=\"GOV004-C1-no-portfolio\", description=\"d\", portfolio_kind=\"none\",\n         run_id=\"run-1\", source_revision=\"git:test\", model_config={}, outcome=\"COMPLETED\",\n raising=False)\n     monkeypatch.setenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\", \"p\")\n     monkeypatch.setenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_LLM\", \"m\")\n     monkeypatch.setenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\", \"m\")\n     assert runner._model_config_from_env()[\"backend_host\"] is None\n \n \n # --- #2 explicit provider override after safe restore \"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_LLM\": \"saved-deep\",\n         \"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\": \"saved-quick\",\n+        \"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_PROVIDER\": \"other-deep\",\n     }\n     before = assert env[\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\"] == \"CS5351/DeepSeek-V4-Flash\"\n+    # Model IDs are NOT overwritten: saved/caller model IDs must still reach\n+    # strict fixed-config validation (bad IDs must not be silently repaired).\n+    assert env[\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_LLM\"] == \"saved-deep\"\n+    assert env[\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\"] == \"saved-quick\"\n \n \n+def         "file": "tests/member_c_verification/live/conftest.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_c_verification/live/conftest.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_c_verification/live/conftest.py\t\n+++ tests/member_c_verification/live/conftest.py\t\n@@ -1,131 +1,129 @@\n \"\"\"GOV-004 live replay configuration.\n \n This directory now lives under ``tests/`` (the configured ``testpaths``), so the\n upstream ``tests/conftest.py`` applies to it. That upstream conftest blanks every\n ``TRADINGAGENTS_*`` setting and blocks sockets for tests not marked\n ``integration`` — exactly what a live run must NOT do. This conftest neutralises\n those two behaviours for the ``live`` suite while keeping them for everything\n else here.\n \n Two suites live in this directory:\n \n * ``offline`` behaviours and ``test_harness_selfcheck.py`` -- offline, scripted\n   model, no network. Always runnable and collected by the default suite.\n * ``test_gov004_live.py`` -- the real live replay. It runs only when the\n   operator opts in explicitly (``GOV004_LIVE=1``); otherwise it is skipped, so an\n   accidental full-suite invocation never spends provider budget or touches the\n   network.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n import os\n from pathlib import Path\n \n import pytest\n \n _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]\n \n \n def pytest_configure(config):\n     for marker in (\"unit\", \"integration\", \"smoke\", \"live\"):\n         config.addinivalue_line(\"markers\", f\"{marker}: {marker}-level tests\")\n     config.addinivalue_line(\n         \"markers\", \"live: makes real provider calls; requires GOV004_LIVE=1\"\n     )\n \n \n def live_enabled() -> bool:\n     return os.getenv(\"GOV004_LIVE\", \"\").strip() == \"1\"\n \n \n @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\n def _no_network(request, monkeypatch):\n     \"\"\"Override the upstream socket block for ``live`` tests.\n \n     The upstream ``tests/conftest.py`` defines this autouse fixture to refuse all\n     sockets. A live run needs them; a non-live test here keeps the upstream\n     protection. Because this fixture shadows the parent's for this directory, we\n     re-apply the block ourselves for the non-live case.\n     \"\"\"\n     if request.node.get_closest_marker(\"live\") and live_enabled():\n         return  # live, opted in: allow the network\n     if request.node.get_closest_marker(\"integration\"):\n         return\n \n     import socket\n \n     def refuse(*args, **kwargs):\n         raise OSError(f\"test tried to reach the network: {args[1:] or kwargs}\")\n \n     monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, \"connect\", refuse)\n     monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, \"connect_ex\", refuse)\n     monkeypatch.setattr(socket, \"getaddrinfo\", lambda *a, **k: refuse(None, *a))\n     try:\n         from curl_cffi import requests as curl_requests\n \n         monkeypatch.setattr(curl_requests.Session, \"request\", refuse)\n         monkeypatch.setattr(curl_requests.AsyncSession, \"request\", refuse)\n     except Exception:\n         pass\n \n \n def _restore_live_env():\n     \"\"\"Reload the repo ``.env`` into the environment on opt-in.\n \n     The upstream conftest blanks ``TRADINGAGENTS_*`` at import time; a plain\n     ``load_dotenv`` will not override those blanks. Patterns mirror the app Redactor.\n _SECRET_PATTERNS = (\n     re.compile(r\"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_\\-]{8,}\"),\n     re.compile(r\"(?i)bearer\\s+[A-Za-z0-9._\\-]{8,}\"),\n     re.compile(r\"(?i)api[_-]?key['\\\"\\s:=]+[A-Za-z0-9_\\-]{8,}\"),\n )\n \n \n def _scrub(text: str) -> str:\n     from tradingagents.runapi.redact import Redactor\n     return Redactor().scrub(text)\n \n \n class PromptCapture(BaseCallbackHandler):\n     \"\"\"Records the *shape* of each model call, never its body.\n \n     ``on_chat_model_start``/``on_llm_start`` fire once per model invocation.\n     We keep a per-call fingerprint (sha256 of the concatenated prompt), the\n     total character length, the message count, and which challenge markers the\n     prompt contained. This is enough to prove a challenge reached model input\n     without storing the raw prompt.\n     \"\"\"\n \n     def __init__(self, markers: tuple[str, ...] = ()):\n         super().__init__()\n         self.markers = markers\n         self.calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n         self._marker_hits: dict[str, int] = dict.fromkeys(markers, 0)\n \n     def _record(self, texts: list[str]) -> None:\n         joined = \"\\n\\n\".join(texts)\n         digest = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()\n         hits = {marker: joined.count(marker) for marker in self.markers}\n         for marker, count in hits.items():\n             self._marker_hits[marker] += count\n         self.calls.append({\n             \"prompt_sha256\": digest,\n             \"prompt_chars\": len(joined),\n             \"messages\": len(texts),\n             \"marker_hits\": hits,\n         })\n \n     def on_chat_model_start(self, serialized, messages, **kwargs):  # noqa: D401\n         texts: list[str] = []\n         for batch in messages:\n             for message in batch:\n                 content = getattr(message, \"content\", \"\")\n                 if isinstance(content, list):\n                     text = \" \".join(\n                         part.get(\"text\", \"\") if isinstance(part, dict) else str(part)\n                         for part in content\n                     )\n                 else:\n                     text = str(content)\n                 texts.append(text)\n         self._record(texts)\n \n     def on_llm_start(self, serialized, prompts, **kwargs):\n         self._record([str(prompt) for prompt in prompts])\n \n     def summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:\n         return {\n             \"model_calls\": len(self.calls),\n             \"calls\": list(self.calls),\n             \"prompt_chars_total\": sum(call[\"prompt_chars\"] for call in self.calls),\n             # A missing or\n     malformed URL records ``None`` rather than echoing the raw value.\n     \"\"\"\n     if not backend:\n         return None\n     from urllib.parse import urlsplit\n \n     try:\n         host = urlsplit(backend).hostname\n     except ValueError:\n         return None\n     return host or None\n \n \n def _model_config_from_env() -> dict[str, Any]:\n     \"\"\"The supplied live configuration, read from the environment.\n \n     Records only *safe* identifiers (provider, model IDs, the backend hostname)\n     -- never the URL with embedded credentials, query or path, never a key.\n     \"\"\"\n     backend_host = _safe_backend_host(os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_BACKEND_URL\"))\n+    provider = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\")\n     return {\n-        \"llm_provider\": os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\"),\n+        \"llm_provider\": provider,\n+        \"deep_think_provider\": os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_PROVIDER\") or provider,\n+        \"quick_think_provider\": os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_PROVIDER\") or provider,\n         \"deep_think_llm\": os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_LLM\"),\n         \"quick_think_llm\": os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\"),\n         \"backend_host\": backend_host,\n         \"analysts\": [\"market\", \"social\", \"news\", \"fundamentals\"],\n         \"max_debate_rounds\": int(os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_DEBATE_ROUNDS\", \"1\")),\n         \"max_risk_discuss_rounds\": int(os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_MAX_RISK_ROUNDS\", \"1\")),\n     }\n \n \n def _live_config(results_dir: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n     from tradingagents.default_config import DEFAULT_CONFIG\n \n     config = dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG)\n     config[\"llm_provider\"] = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\")\n     config[\"deep_think_llm\"] = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_LLM\")\n     config[\"quick_think_llm\"] = os.getenv(\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_LLM\")\n+    # The\n     original routing is restored on exit, so no application module is edited.\n     \"\"\"\n \n     def __init__(self, news_body: str):\n         self.news_body = news_body\n         self._router = None\n         self._original = None\n \n     def __enter__(self):\n         from tradingagents.dataflows import router as router_module\n         self._router = router_module\n         self._original = router_module.route_to_vendor\n \n         original = self._original\n         body = self.news_body\n \n         def patched(method, *args, **kwargs):\n             if method in (\"get_news\", \"get_global_news\"):\n                 return f\"## Synthetic news item\\n\\n{body}\\n\"\n             return original(method, *args, **kwargs)\n \n         # The tools import the name directly; patch both the module attribute\n         # and the already-bound references in the tools namespace.\n         router_module.route_to_vendor = patched\n         import tradingagents.agents.tools as tools_module\n         self._patched_targets = []\n         for name in (\"route_to_vendor\",):\n             if hasattr(tools_module, name):\n                 self._patched_targets.append((tools_module, name, getattr(tools_module, name)))\n                 setattr(tools_module, name, patched)\n         return self\n \n     def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):\n         self._router.route_to_vendor = self._original\n         for module, name, value in getattr(self, \"_patched_targets\", []):\n             setattr(module, name, value)\n         return False\n \n \n def run_case(case: Case, *, results_dir: str, ticker: str, analysis_date: str, run_id: str | None = None) -> CaseOutcome:\n     \"\"\"Execute one fixed case live and return an auditable record.\"\"\"\n     model_config = _model_config_from_env()\n     revision = _source_revision()\n     capture = PromptCapture(markers=(case.challenge_marker,) if case.challenge_marker else ())\n     config = _live_config(results_dir)\n     analysts = list(model_config[\"analysts\"])\n     config[\"selected_analysts\"] = analysts\n \n     context = freeze_explicit(ticker, analysis_date, case.portfolio).confirm()\n     if run_id is not None:\n         context = replace(context, run_id=run_id)\n     started = time.monotonic()\n     error: str | None = None\n     result = None\n     try:\n         # The vendor override wraps only the engine run inside run_analysis_api.\n         # We achieve that by patching around the call; the analysts fire inside.\n         if case.injected_news:\n             with _InjectedNewsRouter(case.injected_news):\n                 result = run_analysis_api(\n                     context, config=config,\n                     selected_analysts=config[\"selected_analysts\"],\n                     callbacks=[capture],\n                 )\n         else:\n             result = run_analysis_api(\n                 context, config=config,\n                 selected_analysts=config[\"selected_analysts\"],\n                 callbacks=[capture],\n             )\n     except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit):\n         # An operator stop must propagate; it is not a case \"error\" to be retried.\n         raise\n     except BaseException as exc:  # retain exposure/engine failures, never drop them\n         error = _scrub(f\"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}\")\n     wall = time.monotonic() - started\n \n     capture_summary = capture.summary()\n     if result is None:\n         return CaseOutcome(\n             case_id=case.case_id, description=case.description,\n             portfolio_kind=case.portfolio_kind, run_id=context.run_id,\n             source_revision=revision, model_config=model_config,\n             outcome=\"ERROR\", stop_reason=None, final_rating=None, output_check=None,\n             findings=[], report_path=None, manifest_path=None, run_dir=None,\n             challenge_marker=case.challenge_marker,\n             challenge_reached_model=(\n                 capture_summary[\"marker_reached_model\"].get(case.challenge_marker)\n                 if case.challenge_marker else None),\n             prompt_capture=capture_summary, wall_clock_s=round(wall, 1),\n             error=error, notes=[\"Exposure failure: exception escaped the harness call.\"],\n         )\n \n     reached = None\n     if case.challenge_marker:\n         reached = bool(capture_summary[\"marker_reached_model\"].get(case.challenge_marker))\n     run_dir = str(Path(result.manifest_path).parent) if result.manifest_path else None\n     notes: list[str] = []\n     if case.challenge_marker and reached is False:\n         notes.append(\"Challenge text did NOT reach model input; case cannot pass.\")\n     if result.run_outcome != \"COMPLETED\":\n         notes.append(\"Incomplete run retained in the summary.\")\n     return CaseOutcome(\n         case_id=case.case_id, description=case.description,\n         portfolio_kind=case.portfolio_kind, run_id=result.run_id,\n         source_revision=revision, model_config=model_config,\n         outcome=result.run_outcome, stop_reason=result.stop_reason,\n         final_rating=result.final_rating, output_check=result.output_check,\n         findings=[f.as_dict() if hasattr(f, \"as_dict\") else dict(f) for f in result.findings],\n         report_path=result.report_path, manifest_path=result.manifest_path,\n         run_dir=run_dir, challenge_marker=case.challenge_marker,\n         challenge_reached_model=reached, prompt_capture=capture_summary,\n         wall_clock_s=round(wall, 1), error=error, notes=notes,\n     )\n \n \n def _source_revision() -> str:\n     try:\n         import subprocess\n         root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\n         out = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"rev-parse\", \"--short\", \"HEAD\"], cwd=root,\n                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=2, check=True)\n         status = subprocess.run([\"git\", \"status\", \"--porcelain\"], cwd=root,\n                                 capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=2, check=True)\n         dirty = \"+dirty\" if status.stdout.strip() else \"\"\n         return f\"git:{out.stdout.strip()}{dirty}\"\n     except Exception:\n         return \"unknown\"\n \n \n def outcome_to_dict(outcome: CaseOutcome, evidence_root: str | Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:\n     \"\"\"Serialize one outcome with relative artifact paths and integrity hashes.\n \n     ``evidence_root`` selects the directory that relative paths are computed\n     against;         "patch": "Index: tradingagents/agents/trader/trader.py\n===================================================================\n--- tradingagents/agents/trader/trader.py\t\n+++ tradingagents/agents/trader/trader.py\t\n@@ -1,102 +1,109 @@\n \"\"\"Trader: turns the Research Manager's investment plan into a concrete transaction proposal.\"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage\n \n from tradingagents.agents.context import (\n     get_instrument_context_from_state,\n     get_language_instruction,\n     get_portfolio_context_from_state,\n     protect_context,\n )\n from tradingagents.agents.schemas import TraderProposal, render_trader_proposal\n from tradingagents.agents.structured import (\n     NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS,\n     bind_structured,\n     invoke_structured_or_freetext,\n )\n \n \n def create_trader(llm):\n     structured_llm = bind_structured(llm, TraderProposal, \"Trader\")\n \n     def trader_node(state):\n         company_name = state[\"company_of_interest\"]\n         instrument_context = protect_context(get_instrument_context_from_state(state))\n         investment_plan = state[\"investment_plan\"]\n         # The research plan digests the debate but loses exact price structure;\n         # give the Trader the technical market report so entry/stop levels are\n         # grounded in real ATR / support-resistance / current price (#1167). The\n         # report is empty when the user did not select the market analyst, so\n         # only offer it (and the grounding instruction) when it has content.\n         market_report = (state[\"market_report\"] or \"\").strip()\n         portfolio_context = protect_context(get_portfolio_context_from_state(state))\n \n         if market_report:\n             grounding = (\n                 \"Ground concrete price levels (entry, stop-loss, position sizing) in the technical \"\n                 \"market report's price structure -- current price, support/resistance, ATR, and \"\n                 \"volatility -- and use the research plan for direction and strategy. \"\n+                \"When you state a distance or an ATR multiple, compute it yourself from the \"\n+                \"explicit quoted values: distance = abs(anchor price - level) and multiple = \"\n+                \"distance / positive ATR; do not copy an inconsistent figure from the research \"\n+                \"plan or other upstream prose (correct it instead of repeating it). If a needed \"\n+                \"input such as ATR is missing or nonpositive, omit the multiple or say it cannot \"\n+                \"be calculated rather than inventing one. Do not describe unrealised \"\n+                \"mark-to-market gains as locked, guaranteed, or risk-free. \"\n             )\n             report_section = f\"Technical Market Report:\\n{market_report}\\n\\n\"\n         else:\n             grounding = \"\"\n             report_section = \"\"\n \n         messages = [\n             {\n                 \"role\": \"system\",\n                 \"content\": (\n                     \"You are a trading agent analyzing market data to make investment decisions. \"\n                     \"Based on your analysis, provide a specific recommendation to buy, sell, or hold. \"\n                     + grounding\n                     # Entry/stop are numeric price fields. Asking for concrete\n                     # levels invites a percentage (\"15%\"), which is not a price\n                     # and fails the structured parse (#1288).\n                     + \"State entry price and stop-loss as absolute price levels in the \"\n                     \"instrument's quote currency (for example 189.5), never a percentage \"\n                     \"or a range; convert a percentage distance to the price level it \"\n                     \"implies, or omit the field if you cannot state a number. \"\n                     + NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS\n                     + get_language_instruction()\n                 ),\n             },\n             {\n                 \"role\": \"user\",\n                 \"content\": (\n                     f\"Here is the research team's investment plan for {company_name}. \"\n                     f\"{instrument_context}\\n\\n\"\n                     f\"{report_section}\"\n                     f\"{portfolio_context}\\n\\n\"\n                     f\"Proposed Investment Plan:\\n{investment_plan}\\n\\n\"\n                     \"Make an informed, strategic trading decision.\\n\\n\"\n                     \"## Output\\n\\n\"\n                     \"Write these sections, in this order, starting with the action \"\n                     \"on its own line:\\n\\n\"\n                     \"- **Action**: exactly one of Buy / Hold / Sell. A research \"\n                     \"recommendation of Overweight is a Buy and Underweight is a Sell, \"\n                     \"sized by how strong the case is; conflict alone is not a Hold. \"\n                     \"Sell is directional research guidance: without a supplied long position it means \"\n                     \"avoid entry, not liquidate assumed holdings. The supplied portfolio facts override \"\n                     \"ownership assumptions in the investment plan.\\n\"\n                     \"- **Reasoning**: why, against the plan and the price structure\\n\"\n                     \"- **Entry Price**, **Stop Loss**, **Position Sizing**: when you can state them\"\n                 ),\n             },\n         ]\n \n         trader_plan = invoke_structured_or_freetext(\n             structured_llm,\n             llm,\n             messages,\n             render_trader_proposal,\n             \"Trader\",\n         )\n \n         return {\n             \"messages\": [AIMessage(content=trader_plan)],\n             \"trader_investment_plan\": trader_plan,\n         }\n \n     return trader_node\n",

        "text": "\"\"\"Trader: turns the Research Manager's investment plan into a concrete transaction proposal.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom langchain_core.messages import AIMessage\n\nfrom tradingagents.agents.context import (\n    get_instrument_context_from_state,\n    get_language_instruction,\n    get_portfolio_context_from_state,\n    protect_context,\n)\nfrom tradingagents.agents.schemas import TraderProposal, render_trader_proposal\nfrom tradingagents.agents.structured import (\n    NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS,\n    bind_structured,\n    invoke_structured_or_freetext,\n)\n\n\ndef create_trader(llm):\n    structured_llm = bind_structured(llm, TraderProposal, \"Trader\")\n\n    def trader_node(state):\n        company_name = state[\"company_of_interest\"]\n        instrument_context = protect_context(get_instrument_context_from_state(state))\n        investment_plan = state[\"investment_plan\"]\n        # The research plan digests the debate but loses exact price structure;\n        # give the Trader the technical market report so entry/stop levels are\n        # grounded in real ATR / support-resistance / current price (#1167). The\n        # report is empty when the user did not select the market analyst, so\n        # only offer it (and the grounding instruction) when it has content.\n        market_report = (state[\"market_report\"] or \"\").strip()\n        portfolio_context = protect_context(get_portfolio_context_from_state(state))\n\n        if market_report:\n            grounding = (\n                \"Ground concrete price levels (entry, stop-loss, position sizing) in the technical \"\n                \"market report's price structure -- current price, support/resistance, ATR, and \"\n                \"volatility -- and use the research plan for direction and strategy. \"\n            )\n            report_section = f\"Technical Market Report:\\n{market_report}\\n\\n\"\n        else:\n            grounding = \"\"\n            report_section = \"\"\n\n        messages = [\n            {\n                \"role\": \"system\",\n                \"content\": (\n                    \"You are a trading agent analyzing market data to make investment decisions. \"\n                    \"Based on your analysis, provide a specific recommendation to buy, sell, or hold. \"\n                    + grounding\n                    # Entry/stop are numeric price fields. Asking for concrete\n                    # levels invites a percentage (\"15%\"), which is not a price\n                    # and fails the structured parse (#1288).\n                    + \"State entry price and stop-loss as absolute price levels in the \"\n                    \"instrument's quote currency (for example 189.5), never a percentage \"\n                    \"or a range; convert a percentage distance to the price level it \"\n                    \"implies, or omit the field if you cannot state a number. \"\n                    + NO_EXTERNAL_TOOLS\n                    + get_language_instruction()\n                ),\n            },\n            {\n                \"role\": \"user\",\n                \"content\": (\n                    f\"Here is the research team's investment plan for {company_name}. \"\n                    f\"{instrument_context}\\n\\n\"\n                    f\"{report_section}\"\n                    f\"{portfolio_context}\\n\\n\"\n                    f\"Proposed Investment Plan:\\n{investment_plan}\\n\\n\"\n                    \"Make an informed, strategic trading decision.\\n\\n\"\n                    \"## Output\\n\\n\"\n                    \"Write these sections, in this order, starting with the action \"\n                    \"on its own line:\\n\\n\"\n                    \"- **Action**: exactly one of Buy / Hold / Sell. A research \"\n                    \"recommendation of Overweight is a Buy and Underweight is a Sell, \"\n                    \"sized by how strong the case is; conflict alone is not a Hold. \"\n                    \"Sell is directional research guidance: without a supplied long position it means \"\n                    \"avoid entry, not liquidate assumed holdings. The supplied portfolio facts override \"\n                    \"ownership assumptions in the investment plan.\\n\"\n                    \"- **Reasoning**: why, against the plan and the price structure\\n\"\n                    \"- **Entry Price**, **Stop Loss**, **Position Sizing**: when you can state them\"\n                ),\n            },\n        ]\n\n        trader_plan = invoke_structured_or_freetext(\n            structured_llm,\n            llm,\n            messages,\n            render_trader_proposal,\n            \"Trader\",\n        )\n\n        return {\n            \"messages\": [AIMessage(content=trader_plan)],\n            \"trader_investment_plan\": trader_plan,\n        }\n\n    return trader_node",

````text
I now understand. `_live_config` starts from `DEFAULT_CONFIG` (imported before override) and sets provider/models from env but doesn't set `deep_think_provider`/`quick_think_provider`. So stale tier overrides from DEFAULT_CONFIG (env-folded at import) could remain. The fix: override sets base provider and clears/aligns both tier providers; `_live_config` must also set tier providers from env so the effective adapter matches.

First, write tests for both the L1 prompt and the provider-override fix, tests-first. Let me create L1 prompt tests.
````

      "newString": "def _apply_llm_provider_override(environ):\n    \"\"\"Apply ``GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER`` AFTER the saved config is restored.\n\n    A small, explicit harness-only control so a caller can select the live\n    *provider* (e.g. the already-saved school endpoint via the ``deepseek``\n    adapter) without editing ``.env``. It changes the provider only: the base\n    provider is set and both tier overrides are aligned to it so the effective\n    adapter for every tier is the requested provider. It does **not** rewrite the\n    model IDs -- saved or caller-selected IDs still reach the strict fixed-config\n    validation, so a bad ID causes zero dispatch rather than being silently\n    repaired. It never copies/migrates credentials and never lowers thresholds;\n    when unset the saved settings are used unchanged.\n    \"\"\"\n    provider = environ.get(\"GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER\", \"\").strip()\n    if not provider:\n        return\n    environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_LLM_PROVIDER\"] = provider\n    # Align both tier providers explicitly so a stale saved tier override cannot\n    # keep a different adapter while the base provider reports the requested one.\n    environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_DEEP_THINK_PROVIDER\"] = provider\n    environ[\"TRADINGAGENTS_QUICK_THINK_PROVIDER\"] = provider",

Example: `GOV004_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek` selects the `deepseek` provider/adapter for the base and both tiers; the model IDs from the saved/selected config (e.g. `CS5351/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`) are still validated against the fixed formal config.\n \n - **Truthful preflight.** Before any graph call the live runner validates the *entire* frozen cohort: schema 2 controls, safe run IDs, an ISO analysis date, a timezone-aware non-future `frozen_at_utc`, a revision/prompt-hash of the right shape, full slot coverage, the selected ticker/date and the fixed config. It also compares the declared `source_revision`/`prompt_hash` with the actual current source inventory (injectable for offline tests). A missing/malformed/stale/mismatching cohort spends **zero** calls and records no started run. Diagnostics never echo field values. The approval text is attributable caller authorization, separate from C's independent acceptance.\n \n - **Safe backend identifier.** The recorded `backend_host` is the URL's hostname only (via a real parser): `user:password@`, port, path and query are never persisted, and a malformed URL records `None`.\n",

## L1 — Trader numerical grounding (approved bounded repair)

The harness reads the cohort, uses its run IDs and refuses to reuse a started slot. A diagnostic run leaves the trial unset. Store diagnostic evidence separately from formal evidence.\n \n ## Record evidence and human scores\n \n The capture harness records portable relative report and manifest paths and their SHA256 digests. Manifests must match the run identity, result, source revision, fixed configuration, prompt hash and report path. Each report must contain the corresponding trusted Run ID header. A completed record needs all of this evidence; incomplete/error attempts remain counted even without completed artifacts.\n \n ### Case/provenance/report correspondence (R2)\n \n A complete set of score cells is not sufficient. The scorer now validates each completed attempt against the trusted frozen case definition, not against the attempt's own (possibly defective) record:\n \n - **Result conditions.** `COMPLETED` requires a valid rating, `stop_reason=null`, and `PASSED`/`NEEDS_REVIEW`; `REVIEW` requires `NEEDS_REVIEW`; `PASSED` carries no findings and `NEEDS_REVIEW` carries at least one valid Q1–Q4/`CHECK_ERROR` finding. A non-completed attempt carries no rating, a known stop reason, `NOT_RUN` and no findings.\n - **Case identity and analysis controls.** `ticker`, `analysis_date`, `input_mode`, `basename`, `fingerprint_sha256`, `portfolio_as_of` and `as_of_basis` must equal the values derived from the declared fixed case (from the authoritative `cases.py` via `expected_case_identity`, bound to the cohort controls). Expected input facts are never inferred from the manifest itself, so a held-target file substituted for the explicit-empty case, a `NO_PORTFOLIO` label on an explicit-empty case, or a wrong `portfolio_kind` fails even with recomputed hashes. Required manifest keys must be **present** even when their value is legitimately null (missing ≠ explicit null), and the manifest `schema_version` must be the supported application version.\n - **Authoritative report envelope.** The contiguous leading header block of `complete_report.md` (title, then the `- Key: value` lines, then `Findings:`) must agree with the manifest/record for run ID, ticker, analysis date, input mode, portfolio file, fingerprint, as-of/basis, run outcome, stop reason, final rating and output check. A missing, duplicate or conflicting authoritative field fails. Quoted (`>`), fenced (```) or later narrative that references a status is not treated as the authoritative block; a **bare, unquoted** authoritative-looking `- Key: value` line outside the header is rejected by a line/fence/quote-aware rule (not a global substring search).\n - **Durability mirror equality.** A per-attempt `gov004_attempt_<run_id>.json` mirror may repeat a run already counted from a batch file **only** when it is identical after parsing (full-row equality). A conflicting copy fails regardless of filename ordering; two genuinely independent attempts sharing a run ID still fail.\n \n Legacy formal evidence that lacks these fields is rejected rather than having the missing fields fabricated. This binds artifacts to the declared case; it does not cryptographically prove the honesty of a human score.\n \n ### Durable per-attempt accounting (R3)\n \n `tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py` makes every attempt durable on its own. Before dispatch the whole selected cohort is preflighted (unique run IDs, one slot per case/trial, none already started); nothing runs on failure, and the live runner validates the frozen cohort controls/config first. Each slot is claimed (`STARTED`) in the versioned `gov004_starts.json` (schema 2) *before* `run_case` is called, carrying the pre-dispatch `model_config` and `controls` (ticker, analysis date, source revision, prompt hash), and its outcome is written to its own `gov004_attempt_<run_id>.json` (validated and confined to the evidence root), so two starts in one second cannot overwrite and a later failure cannot discard an earlier attempt. Only an **absent** ledger means “no evidence”: an empty/malformed/duplicate/unsafe ledger fails closed. `KeyboardInterrupt`/`SystemExit`, and an application-reported `INTERRUPTED` result, stop further dispatch after the current start/outcome is preserved.\n \n A retained pending start is an **eligible**, noncompleted denominator entry only when its pre-dispatch binding is trusted and complete: a known fixed configuration and captured controls that match the frozen cohort (ticker, analysis date, and — where declared — source revision and prompt hash). A missing, unknown or mismatching binding is **ineligible yet still counted in the denominator**; it is never a completed quality sample, and model settings are never fabricated from a result. Acceptance requires **every** started attempt (completed or pending) to be eligible, so a wrongly-configured pending start blocks a PASS even when all completed rows are excellent (e.g. 10 completed + 1 defective pending → 10/11 ≥ 90% but FAIL). A genuine control-bound 9 completed + 1 pending (9/10 = 90%, ≥9 completed, ≥1 completed per case) passes at the unchanged thresholds. Reusing a started slot is refused. Diagnostics/pilot populations remain separate from the formal cohort.\n \n The score JSON contains a real `reviewer` and an `answers` list. Each applicable answer has `case_id`, `run_id`, `trial`, `item`, integer `score` (0 or 1), and a nonempty `citation` found in that run's report. Record rationale and disagreements alongside it. Do not submit N/A rows for inapplicable cells. The scorer derives applicability; missing, duplicate, unknown, incorrectly N/A or unrelated cells fail. Challenge markers and actual exposure must be retained and independently checked. Q1–Q4 NEEDS_REVIEW and human semantic judgments remain separate.\n \n ## Package and verify from a fresh checkout\n \n After sanitization and human review, run from the repository root:\n \n ```sh\n python tests/member_c_verification/live/package_gov004.py tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence /tmp/gov004-package --scores tests/member_c_verification/live/evidence/gov004_scores.json\n GOV004_EVIDENCE_DIR=/tmp/gov004-package python tests/member_c_verification/live/score_gov004.py /tmp/gov004-package/gov004_scores.json\n ```\n \n The destination must not already exist. The exporter copies only referenced reports/manifests and the cohort, evidence and scoring files, rewrites paths (including for the versioned `gov004_starts.json` start ledger and per-attempt `gov004_attempt_*.json` files), and emits `integrity.json`. Unresolved starts and all denominators survive the export. It refuses detected credential text rather than silently changing scored evidence. Review other sensitive content manually; automatic scanning cannot certify privacy. Move the package to a second path or fresh checkout (a different working directory) and repeat scoring; only relative artifact paths may be relied on. PASS=0, FAIL=1, PENDING=2. PENDING is never acceptance. Compare integrity hashes after transfer; retain the archive in an agreed durable location.\n \n The tracked ignore rules exclude private generated live evidence. Deliberate sanitized packages may be retained outside that tree after owner review. This workflow is not recovery of missing historical evidence and does not itself grant formal approval.\n",

        "file": "tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py",
        "patch": "Index: tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py\n===================================================================\n--- tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py\t\n+++ tests/member_b_remediation/test_l1_trader_numeric.py\t\n@@ -1,117 +1,135 @@\n \"\"\"L1 — Trader numerical grounding (bounded prompt correction).\n \n Approved by the live-found Trader arithmetic error (C3 `20261121T093733Z-8c832879`:\n stop 255.33 described as ~1.5xATR/6.6 points below a 258.47 close with ATR 4.39,\n while the real difference is 3.14 = ~0.715xATR). These tests capture the actual\n Trader prompt on both the structured and free-text paths. They assert the\n instruction reaches the model; they cannot prove live model compliance.\n \"\"\"\n \n from __future__ import annotations\n \n from unittest.mock import MagicMock\n \n import pytest\n from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage\n \n from tradingagents.agents.schemas import TraderAction, TraderProposal\n from tradingagents.agents.trader.trader import create_trader\n \n pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit\n \n MARKET_REPORT = (\n     \"AAPL closed at 258.47. ATR(14) = 4.39. Support 255.33, resistance 262.10. \"\n     \"The research plan claims the stop is roughly 1.5xATR (6.6 points) below the close.\"\n )\n INVESTMENT_PLAN = (\n     \"**Recommendation**: Underweight\\n\"\n     \"**Rationale**: momentum faded; the stop at 255.33 sits about 1.5xATR below 258.47.\\n\"\n     \"**Strategic Actions**: size against a standard allocation.\"\n )\n PORTFOLIO_BLOCK = (\n     \"Portfolio at the analysis date:\\n\"\n     \"These holdings and cash are user-supplied and unverified; treat them as the caller's \"\n     \"stated snapshot, not an authenticated account.\\n\"\n     \"- Current position in AAPL: 40 units, average price 190.00\\n\"\n     \"Available funds were not supplied; do not invent a balance or affordability.\"\n )\n \n \n def _state():\n     return {\n         \"company_of_interest\": \"AAPL\",\n         \"instrument_context\": \"\",\n         \"market_report\": MARKET_REPORT,\n         \"investment_plan\": INVESTMENT_PLAN,\n         \"portfolio_context\": PORTFOLIO_BLOCK,\n     }\n \n \n def _structured_llm(captured):\n     proposal = TraderProposal(action=TraderAction.SELL, reasoning=\"Fade.\")\n     structured = MagicMock()\n     structured.invoke.side_effect = lambda prompt: captured.__setitem__(\"prompt\", prompt) or proposal\n     llm = MagicMock()\n     llm.with_structured_output.return_value = structured\n     return llm\n \n \n def _fallback_llm(captured):\n     llm = MagicMock()\n     llm.with_structured_output.side_effect = NotImplementedError(\"no structured output\")\n     llm.invoke.side_effect = lambda prompt: (captured.__setitem__(\"prompt\", prompt)\n                                              or AIMessage(content=\"**Action**: Sell\\n\\nFade.\"))\n     return llm\n \n \n def _prompt_text(prompt) -> str:\n     return prompt if isinstance(prompt, str) else \"\\n\".join(m[\"content\"] for m in prompt)\n \n \n @pytest.mark.parametrize(\"builder\", [_structured_llm, _fallback_llm], ids=[\"structured\", \"fallback\"])\n def test_l1_01_numeric_grounding_reaches_model(builder):\n     captured = {}\n     create_trader(builder(captured))(_state())\n     text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"]).lower()\n \n     # General instruction to recompute distances/multiples from explicit anchors.\n     assert \"recompute\" in text or \"compute\" in text\n     assert \"atr\" in text\n     # Absolute distance and multiple guidance with the positive-ATR guard.\n     assert \"absolute\" in text or \"abs(\" in text\n     assert \"multiple\" in text and (\"positive\" in text or \"nonzero\" in text)\n     # Correct inconsistent upstream arithmetic rather than repeat it.\n     assert \"upstream\" in text or \"research\" in text\n     assert \"do not repeat\" in text or \"not repeat\" in text or \"correct\" in text\n     # Never assert guaranteed/locked gains.\n     assert \"guarantee\" in text or \"locked\" in text\n     # Omit unsupported ratios / say unknown.\n     assert \"unknown\" in text or \"omit\" in text\n     # Source values and portfolio facts are preserved.\n     for anchor in (\"258.47\", \"255.33\", \"4.39\"):\n         assert anchor in text\n     assert \"40\" in text\n     assert \"user-supplied and unverified\" in text\n \n \n def test_l1_01_no_hardcoded_observed_values_in_instruction():\n     \"\"\"The prompt must be general, not hardcode the observed 3.14/0.715 numbers.\"\"\"\n     captured = {}\n     create_trader(_structured_llm(captured))(_state())\n     system = \"\\n\".join(m[\"content\"] for m in captured[\"prompt\"] if m[\"role\"] == \"system\")\n     assert \"3.14\" not in system and \"0.715\" not in system\n     # Absolute-price/action/vocabulary constraints are unchanged.\n     assert \"absolute price\" in system.lower()\n     assert \"Buy / Hold / Sell\" in _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"])\n \n \n def test_l1_04_missing_atr_is_not_required_to_fabricate():\n     captured = {}\n     state = _state()\n     state[\"market_report\"] = \"AAPL closed at 258.47. Support 255.33; resistance 262.10.\"\n     create_trader(_structured_llm(captured))(state)\n     text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"]).lower()\n     # The instruction still asks to omit/mark-unknown unsupported ratios.\n     assert \"unknown\" in text or \"omit\" in text\n     # No ATR figure is invented into the prompt by our instruction.\n     assert \"atr(14) = 4.39\" not in text\n+\n+\n+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"builder\", [_structured_llm, _fallback_llm], ids=[\"structured\", \"fallback\"])\n+def test_l1_07_direction_instruction_reaches_model(builder):\n+    \"\"\"Compare level vs anchor before calling it above/below; avoid extra claims.\"\"\"\n+    captured = {}\n+    create_trader(builder(captured))(_state())\n+    text = _prompt_text(captured[\"prompt\"]).lower()\n+    # General direction rule: below when level < anchor, above when level > anchor.\n+    assert \"below\" in text and \"above\" in text\n+    assert \"anchor\" in text\n+    # Avoid unnecessary extra derived numeric claims not needed for the proposal.\n+    assert \"unnecessary\" in text or \"not needed\" in text or \"only the numbers\" in text\n+    # The anchors are still present and no observed numbers are hardcoded.\n+    for anchor in (\"258.47\", \"255.33\"):\n+        assert anchor in text\n+    assert \"0.72\" not in text and \"1.21\" not in text\n+\n",

        "deletions": 0,
        "status": "modified"
      },

Narrative that quotes or fences\n     header-like lines later in the document is not treated as the envelope; an\n     unquoted header-like line *inside* the header block that conflicts is a\n     duplicate/inconsistent metadata failure.\n     \"\"\"\n     lines = text.splitlines()\n     header = {}\n     seen_key = False\n     body_started = False\n     for raw in lines:\n         line = raw.rstrip()\n         if body_started:\n             break\n         if line.startswith(\"# \"):\n             continue  # title\n         if line.startswith(\"## \"):\n             body_started = True\n             break\n         if not line.strip():\n             if seen_key:\n                 # A blank line after the header keys ends the contiguous block.\n                 body_started = True\n             continue\n         if not line.startswith(\"- \"):\n             if seen_key:\n                 body_started = True\n                 break\n             continue\n         content = line[2:]\n         if content.startswith(\"Findings:\"):\n             seen_key = True\n             continue\n         if content.startswith(\"  - \"):\n             continue  # finding detail line\n         if \":\" not in content:\n             body_started = True\n             break\n         label, _sep, value = content.partition(\":\")\n         label = label.strip()\n         value = value.strip()\n         if label not in ENVELOPE_HEADER_KEYS:\n             body_started = True\n             break\n         if label in header:\n             raise ValueError(\"Duplicate authoritative envelope field\")\n         header[label] = value\n         seen_key = True\n     return header\n \n \n def _reject_counterfeit_metadata_outside_header(text):\n     \"\"\"Reject a forged authoritative-looking metadata line outside the header.\n \n     The single authoritative envelope is the leading header block. Beyond it, a\n     bare (unquoted, unfenced) ``- <Authoritative Key>: value`` line is counterfeit\n     metadata -- not narrative -- and is rejected. Lines inside fenced code blocks\n     or blockquotes (``>``) are legitimate narrative references and are allowed.\n     This is a line/fence/quote-aware rule, not a global substring search.\n     \"\"\"\n     in_header = True\n     seen_key = False\n     in_fence = False\n     for raw in text.splitlines():\n         line = raw.rstrip()\n         stripped = line.strip()\n         if stripped.startswith(\"```\"):\n             in_fence = not in_fence\n             continue\n         if in_fence:\n             continue\n         if in_header:\n             # Track the leading contiguous header block exactly as the parser.\n             if line.startswith(\"# \") or not stripped:\n                 continue\n             if line.startswith(\"- \"):\n                 content = line[2:]\n                 if content.startswith(\"Findings:\") or content.startswith(\"  - \"):\n                     seen_key = True\n                     continue\n                 label = content.partition(\":\")[0].strip() if \":\" in content else None\n                 if label in ENVELOPE_HEADER_KEYS:\n                     seen_key = True\n                     continue\n             if seen_key:\n                 in_header = False\n             continue\n         # Body region: blockquoted lines are quotes, anything else bare is checked.\n         if stripped.startswith(\">\"):\n             continue\n         candidate = stripped\n         if candidate.startswith(\"- \"):\n             candidate = candidate[2:]\n         if candidate.startswith(\"  - \"):\n             continue\n         if \":\" in candidate:\n             label = candidate.partition(\":\")[0].strip()\n             if label in ENVELOPE_HEADER_KEYS:\n                 raise ValueError(f\"Counterfeit authoritative metadata outside the header: {label}\")\n \n \n def _check_report_envelope(attempt, manifest, report, controls):\n     text = report.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n     header = _parse_envelope_header(text)\n     if not header:\n         raise ValueError(\"Missing authoritative report envelope\")\n     _reject_counterfeit_metadata_outside_header(text)\n     for required in ENVELOPE_HEADER_KEYS:\n         if required not in header:\n             # Stop reason/rating legitimately absent only for their condition.\n             if required == \"Stop reason\" and attempt.stop_reason is None:\n                 continue\n             if required == \"Final Portfolio Manager rating\" and attempt.final_rating is None:\n                 continue\n             raise ValueError(f\"Missing authoritative envelope field: {required}\")\n \n     expected_values = {\n         \"Run ID\": attempt.run_id,\n         \"Ticker\": controls.get(\"ticker\", DEFAULT_TICKER),\n         \"Analysis date\": controls.get(\"analysis_date\", DEFAULT_ANALYSIS_DATE),\n         \"Input mode\": manifest.get(\"input_mode\"),\n         \"Portfolio file\": _nil(manifest.get(\"basename\")),\n         \"Portfolio fingerprint (SHA-256)\": _nil(manifest.get(\"fingerprint_sha256\")),\n         \"Portfolio as-of\": _nil(manifest.get(\"portfolio_as_of\")),\n         \"As-of basis\": _nil(manifest.get(\"as_of_basis\")),\n         \"Run outcome\": attempt.outcome,\n         \"Output check\": attempt.output_check,\n     }\n     # Absent-line fields: present only when the record carries the value; a\n     # present but conflicting line is always an error.\n     optional_values = {\n         \"Stop reason\": attempt.stop_reason,\n         \"Final Portfolio Manager rating\": attempt.final_rating,\n     }\n     for key, value in expected_values.items():\n         if value is None:\n             raise ValueError(f\"Missing expected envelope fact: {key}\")\n         if header.get(key) != value:\n             raise ValueError(f\"Report envelope disagrees with the record: {key}\")\n     for key, value in optional_values.items():\n         if value is None:\n             if header.get(key) not in (None, \"null\", \"\"):\n                 raise ValueError(f\"Report envelope contradicts the record: {key}\")\n         elif header.get(key) != _nil(value):\n             raise ValueError(f\"Report envelope disagrees with the record: {key}\")\n     if header.get(\"Run ID\") != attempt.run_id:\n         raise ValueError(\"Report run identity mismatch\")\n \n \n def _nil(value):\n     return \"null\" if value is None else str(value)\n \n \n \n def _select_attempts(attempts):\n     #    raise ValueError(\"Cohort prompt_hash must be a full lowercase SHA-256\")\n     frozen = cohort.get(\"frozen_at_utc\")\n     if not isinstance(frozen, str):\n         raise ValueError(\"Cohort must preflight failure: nothing dispatched\n             pytest.fail(f\"Cohort preflight rejected the replay: {exc}\")\n     else:\n         outcomes = []\n         for slot in planned:\n             outcomes.append(_run_slot({**slot, \"run_id\": None}))\n \n     for record in outcomes:\n         print(\n             f\"[GOV-004] {record['case_id']} run={record['run_id']} \"\n             f\"outcome={record['outcome']} stop={record['stop_reason']} \"\n             f\"rating={record['final_rating']} check={record['output_check']} \"\n             f\"challenge_reached={record.get('challenge_reached_model')} \"\n             f\"calls={(record.get('prompt_capture') or {}).get('model_calls')} trial={trial}\"\n         )\n \n     evidence = {\n         \"gate\": \"GOV-004\",\n         \"kind\": \"formal\" if trial is not None else \"pilot\",\n         \"trial\": trial,\n         \"timestamp_utc\": stamp,\n         \"ticker\": ticker,\n         \"analysis_date\": analysis_date,\n         \"cases\": outcomes,\n         \"counts\": {\n             \"cases\": len(outcomes),\n             \"completed\": sum(1 for o in outcomes if o[\"outcome\"] == \"COMPLETED\"),\n             \"incomplete\": sum(1 for o in outcomes if o[\"outcome\"] == \"INCOMPLETE\"),\n             \"errors\": sum(1 for o in outcomes if o[\"outcome\"] == \"ERROR\"),\n             \"challenge_cases\": sum(1 for o in outcomes if o[\"challenge_marker\"]),\n             \"challenge_reached\": sum(\n                 1 for o in outcomes if o[\"challenge_marker\"] and o[\"challenge_reached_model\"]\n             ),\n         },\n     }\n     evidence_path = EVIDENCE_ROOT / f\"gov004_{stamp}.json\"\n     evidence_path.write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\",\n                              encoding=\"utf-8\")\n     print(f\"[GOV-004] evidence: {evidence_path}\")\n \n     # ````text
All checks clean. The `AI-log` file remains coordinator-owned and untouched by me. Both corrections are complete with tests-first.

## 1) L1 direction clarification (`tradingagents/agents/trader/trader.py`)

Extended the same bounded numeric-grounding instruction (inside the existing protected system prompt) to: compare a level with the explicit anchor before calling it above/below (`level < anchor` ⇒ below; `level > anchor` ⇒ above), and keep derived numbers to those actually needed (avoid unnecessary extra calculations). The abs-distance, positive-ATR, omit-unknown, no-guaranteed/locked-gains guidance and all absolute-price/rating/action behavior are preserved; no hardcoded fixture prices, no report rewrite, no new validator/Q rule.

Tests (`test_l1_trader_numeric.py`): captured actual-path regression on both the structured and forced free-text-fallback paths asserting the above/below direction rule and the avoid-extra-calculations guidance reach the model (anchors `258.47`/`255.33` present, no `0.72`/`1.21` hardcoding), while the existing supported missing/nonpositive-input tests remain. The observed “1.21% above the close” live failure is retained in the report as the target of this clarification; no live L1 PASS is claimed.

## 2) Tier-provider correspondence (R2, not a policy change)

Added `_tier_providers_match_fixed`: every tier's effective provider `(tier_provider or llm_provider)` must equal the fixed provider. Enforced for the recorded evidence config, the manifest `effective_config`, a pending start's captured binding, and the live preflight (zero calls on mismatch). Missing/`None` tier fields mean “inherit base” (legacy fixtures/normal configs remain valid); an explicit conflicting tier provider fails even with recomputed hashes/full scores.

Tests: wrong deep or quick provider in record, manifest, and pending binding → FAIL; inherited and explicit-`deepseek` tiers → PASS; actual-preflight rule exercised via the same helper before dispatch. Provider/model IDs and thresholds unchanged.

## Verification (actual)
- Focused offline (`member_b` + `member_c` + `member_d`): **314 passed, 1 skipped**.
- Full offline suite (one run after code stable): **1,726 passed, 2 skipped, 1 deselected; 100 subtests**.
- `ruff` clean; `pip check` clean; `git diff --check` clean.
- Docs updated precisely (evidence guide tier-provider paragraph; report L1 direction + observed live follow-up + tier-correspondence section, counts). Coordinator report sections and `AI-log` files untouched.

## Honest limits
Prompt-capture tests cannot prove live compliance; the coordinator will repeat all six real L1 fixture cases and the full fixed replay and inspect context. Historical F8 remains unverified (as Brian requested) and C's independent acceptance remains pending. No live/model calls, secrets, commits/pushes or governance edits from this process.

`READY_FOR_FINAL_LIVE_REPLAY`

Quoted (`>`), fenced (```) or later narrative that references a status is not treated as the authoritative block; a **bare, unquoted** authoritative-looking `- Key: value` line outside the header is rejected by a line/fence/quote-aware rule (not a global substring search).\n - **Durability mirror equality.** A per-attempt `gov004_attempt_<run_id>.json` mirror may repeat a run already counted from a batch file **only** when it is identical after parsing (full-row equality). A conflicting copy fails regardless of filename ordering; two genuinely independent attempts sharing a run ID still fail.\n \n Legacy formal evidence that lacks these fields is rejected rather than having the missing fields fabricated. This binds artifacts to the declared case; it does not cryptographically prove the honesty of a human score.\n \n ### Durable per-attempt accounting (R3)\n \n `tests/member_c_verification/live/replay_store.py` makes every attempt durable on its own. Before dispatch the whole selected cohort is preflighted (unique run IDs, one slot per case/trial, none already started); nothing runs on failure, and the live runner validates the frozen cohort controls/config first. Each slot is claimed (`STARTED`) in the versioned `gov004_starts.json` (schema 2) *before* `run_case` is called, carrying the pre-dispatch `model_config` and `controls` (ticker, analysis date, source revision, prompt hash), and its outcome is written to its own `gov004_attempt_<run_id>.json` (validated and confined to the evidence root), so two starts in one second cannot overwrite and a later failure cannot discard an earlier attempt. Only an **absent** ledger means “no evidence”: an empty/malformed/duplicate/unsafe ledger fails closed. `KeyboardInterrupt`/`SystemExit`, and an application-reported `INTERRUPTED` result, stop further dispatch after the current start/outcome is preserved.\n \n A retained pending start is an **eligible**, noncompleted denominator entry only when its pre-dispatch binding is trusted and complete: a known fixed configuration and captured controls that match the frozen cohort (ticker, analysis date, and — where declared — source revision and prompt hash). A missing, unknown or mismatching binding is **ineligible yet still counted in the denominator**; it is never a completed quality sample, and model settings are never fabricated from a result. Acceptance requires **every** started attempt (completed or pending) to be eligible, so a wrongly-configured pending start blocks a PASS even when all completed rows are excellent (e.g. 10 completed + 1 defective pending → 10/11 ≥ 90% but FAIL). A genuine control-bound 9 completed + 1 pending (9/10 = 90%, ≥9 completed, ≥1 completed per case) passes at the unchanged thresholds. Reusing a started slot is refused. Diagnostics/pilot populations remain separate from the formal cohort.\n \n The score JSON contains a real `reviewer` and an `answers` list. Unresolved starts and all denominators survive the export. It refuses detected credential text rather than silently changing scored evidence. Review other sensitive content manually; automatic scanning cannot certify privacy. Move the package to a second path or fresh checkout (a different working directory) and repeat scoring; only relative artifact paths may be relied on. PASS=0, FAIL=1, PENDING=2. PENDING is never acceptance. Compare integrity hashes after transfer; retain the archive in an agreed durable location.\n \n The tracked ignore rules exclude private generated live evidence.       "newString": "## Live-test fixture: credential/redaction contamination (feedback-8)\n\nThe real opt-in pytest replay exposed a test-fixture bug (not a production defect): `tests/conftest.py::_dummy_api_keys` injects `\"placeholder\"` for every missing provider key, and on a live run that fake value entered the application `Redactor` inventory, so benign sentences like \"the feed returned a placeholder\" became \"[REDACTED]\", and unconfigured auxiliary providers acquired fake keys. The direct production-boundary diagnostic did not show this because it does not run under the shared pytest fixture.\n\nMinimal repair (two-line guard in the parent fixture; explicitly in the allowed write set): `_dummy_api_keys` now skips dummy injection **only** when the test carries the `live` marker **and** `GOV004_LIVE` is exactly `\"1\"`. All ordinary offline/integration/non-opted tests keep the placeholder behavior; real (synthetic) provided keys are preserved; the upstream network block and blank-setting isolation are untouched; no `.env`/credential store is read. Tests (`tests/member_b_remediation/test_live_fixture_keys.py`) exercise the real fixture body with synthetic env: opted-in live leaves missing keys absent and provided keys unchanged; `\"placeholder\"` survives `Redactor` when no fake credential exists; offline/non-opted tests still get placeholders and preserve configured values; the exact `== \"1\"` enabled semantics are pinned. The narrow repair is complete.

## Narrow repair (tests first)

**`tests/conftest.py`** — `_dummy_api_keys` now skips placeholder injection **only** when the test has the `live` marker **and** `GOV004_LIVE == "1"` (matching the live conftest's exact enabled test). Four-line guard, no production code changed.

**Tests** (`tests/member_b_remediation/test_live_fixture_keys.py`, synthetic env only, invoking the real fixture body without reimporting conftest):
- opted-in live leaves missing keys absent and preserves provided synthetic keys;
- `"placeholder"` survives `Redactor` when no fake credential exists (benign-text R1-03);
- live-marker without opt-in, and non-live tests, still get placeholders; configured values preserved;
- exact `== "1"`/`0`/empty/`true` semantics pinned (R3-07 live-configuration criterion).

The three defect assertions failed against the pre-fix fixture (opted-in live still injected `"placeholder"`) and pass after.

## Verification (actual)
- New fixture tests: **7 passed**.
- Focused offline (`member_b` + `member_c` + `member_d`): **321 passed, 1 skipped**.
- Full offline suite (one run after the code change): **1,733 passed, 2 skipped, 1 deselected; 100 subtests**.
- `ruff` clean; `pip check` clean; `git diff --check` clean.
- Docs updated: evidence guide (live-credentials-not-saturated note) and report (new implementer subsection, counts). Coordinator report sections and `AI-log` files untouched; no raw evidence edited.

## Boundaries honored
No production prompts/code changed this turn, no live/model calls, no secrets/.env/auth reads, no commits/pushes, no subagents, no governance/canonical-requirement edits. Historical F8 remains unverified and C's independent acceptance remains pending.

`READY_FOR_CLEAN_LIVE_REPLAY`
