A calculator can check a **relation relative to specified operands**; it cannot certify the truth, semantics or exhaustive extraction of financial prose.\n \n ### 1.1 Proposed (UNAPPROVED) requirement IDs\n \n Separate `NVR-` prefix; not canonical requirements.\n \n-- **NVR-001 — Trusted fact projection.** Selected numeric inputs used by decision stages are captured as a typed, run-bound projection (ticker, analysis date, source, input fingerprint, units, precision) rather than only as prose.\n-- **NVR-002 — Registered computations only.** A deterministic calculator performs only **registered** operations on typed facts (`subtract`, `divide_positive`, `atr_band`, `percent_of`, `notional`, `ratio`), with fixed units, `Decimal` arithmetic and defined rounding. No `eval`, no model-authored expected values.\n-- **NVR-003 — Bounded name-class coverage.** The first release covers named classes only: absolute price distance and direction; ATR-scaled distance/bands; percentages with an explicit denominator; position notional from supplied quantities; risk/reward with explicit anchors. Out-of-scope financial definitions (tax-rate from net/operating income, weighted-EPS derivation) are reported as **unsupported**, never “verified” merely because a formula runs.\n-- **NVR-004 — Coverage-honest status.** Each evaluated claim is `VERIFIED`, `MISMATCH`, `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (missing/unknown/nonfinite inputs) or `UNSUPPORTED` (unregistered class). A run-level coverage status is reported; partial coverage never yields a “numeric PASS” for the whole narrative.\n-- **NVR-005 — Audit-only first.** The extension first runs as a sidecar producing an audit artifact with **no** change to `output_check`, `run_outcome`, Q1–Q4, public result enums or report rendering. Any runtime gating or controlled rendering requires a separately approved contract/schema/quality-rule change (A/C).\n-- **NVR-006 — Provenance and immutability.** Facts and claims bind to run id, ticker, analysis date, source reference, input fingerprint and unit; unknown is never `0`; raw stage evidence is retained and finalized artifacts are immutable (existing invariants preserved).\n+- **NVR-001 — Typed supplied facts first.** Numeric inputs are supplied to the auditor as a typed, run-bound fact bundle (ticker, analysis date, source identifier and availability date, period, units, declared precision) rather than parsed from prose. Automatic typed extraction from the graph/snapshot is a **later** change (§7), not part of the first slice.\n+- **NVR-002 — Registered relations only.** A deterministic calculator evaluates only **registered** relations (see §4.2 roles) over `Decimal` (precision 28), with fixed units and defined rounding. No `eval`, no model-authored expected values. It verifies a relation against the **specified operands**; it does not certify the operands' truth or that the operand set is complete.\n+- **NVR-003 — Bounded relation-class coverage.** The first slice covers only price distance, price direction and ATR band; the broader roadmap adds percentages with an explicit denominator, position notional from supplied quantities, and risk/reward with explicit anchors. Out-of-scope financial definitions (tax-rate from net/operating income, weighted-EPS derivation) are **`UNSUPPORTED`**, never “verified” merely because a formula runs.\n+- **NVR-004 — Coverage-honest status.** Each **detected, registered** claim gets a status from `{VERIFIED, MISMATCH, NOT_VERIFIABLE, UNSUPPORTED}` (§4.3); there is **no** fifth per-claim `UNVERIFIED` status. Prose spans that are not detected/registered are counted separately, not scored. The denominator is only the **detected registered claims**, not every statement in the report. Partial coverage never yields a whole-narrative “verified” claim.\n+- **NVR-005 — Standalone audit first.** The first slice runs **outside** the live run: a standalone post-run tool reads saved artifacts and a separately supplied typed fixture, and writes its own audit file (not into the finalized run directory). It changes **no** `output_check`, `run_outcome`, Q1–Q4, public enum, manifest or rendered report. Any staging integration, render/gating or public status change is separately unapproved.\n+- **NVR-006 — Provenance and immutability.** Facts and claims bind to run id, ticker, analysis date, source identifier, source availability date, period, input fingerprint, unit and stage text hash+offset; unknown is never `0`; saved run artifacts are read-only. The audit's own retention/integrity is distinct from the authoritative report/manifest (which it never alters).\n \n ### 1.2 Preserved decisions (not reopened)\n \n-Two input modes; five research ratings and three Trader actions; Q1–Q4 unchanged; user-supplied/unverified holdings/cash; no orders; source-date constraints (no post-cutoff data); report+manifest critical, terminal-append best-effort; the frozen `RunContext`/fingerprint; no reliance on the raw low-level primitive. Candidate approaches (design comparison; ESTIMATE, no measurements)\n \n Estimates are design judgements labelled **ESTIMATE**. No measured latency/cost/accuracy is claimed.\n \n ### 2.1 A — Expanded prompts only (status quo + more instructions)\n \n-- **Rationale:** cheapest to ship; no new modules. L1/L2 already show prompt wording changes behaviour.\n-- **Coverage:** cannot certify any arithmetic; dimensional/definition errors (the `1.5–8.8 points` example) persist; no machine-readable coverage.\n-- **Cost:** ESTIMATE ~0.2–0.5 day; no new test surface worth much because it cannot prove correctness.\n+- **Rationale:** cheapest; no new modules. L1/L2 already show prompt wording changes behaviour.\n+- **Coverage:** cannot certify arithmetic; unit/definition wording (e.g. the PM band, C2 multiple) can recur; no machine-readable coverage.\n+- **Cost:** ESTIMATE ~0.2–0.5 day; low value as a correctness claim.\n - **Verdict:** necessary but insufficient; keep L1/L2, do not extend as the solution.\n \n-### 2.2 B — Trusted typed-fact/derived-claim ledger + deterministic calculator + controlled rendering (recommended)\n+### 2.2 B — Typed supplied-fact bundle + deterministic relation calculator + claim ledger (recommended)\n \n-- **Rationale:** separates *facts* (typed, run-bound) from *claims* (what the text asserts) from *computed results* (deterministic). A claim about a registered class is checked against the calculator; unregistered classes are `UNSUPPORTED`; missing inputs are `NOT_VERIFIABLE`. This is the only approach that can truthfully mark specific claims verified or mismatched.\n-- **Coverage gaps:** prose that cannot be parsed into a registered claim stays `UNVERIFIED` (reported, not hidden); semantic financial definitions remain `UNSUPPORTED`; coverage is bounded to the registered classes.\n-- **Integration cost:** new trusted-fact projection, calculator, claim extractor, sidecar artifact and tests; ESTIMATE ~4–7 days for the audit-only first release, plus review for any later runtime gating.\n-- **Verdict:** recommended bounded design.\n+- **Rationale:** separates *facts* (typed, run-bound, supplied or later projected), *claims* (detected relations) and *computed results* (deterministic). A claim is checked **against the specified operands**; unregistered relations are `UNSUPPORTED`; missing/unknown/ambiguous inputs are `NOT_VERIFIABLE`.\n+- **Coverage gaps:** undetected prose stays uncounted; semantic financial definitions remain `UNSUPPORTED`; coverage is bounded to the registered relations.\n+- **Integration cost:** first slice (standalone, supplied fixture, three relations) small; automatic extraction, more classes and any staging/gating are later.\n+- **Verdict:** recommended bounded design; do **not** restart C1/C2/C3.\n \n ### 2.3 C — Prose parsing / second-LLM critique\n \n - **Rationale:** flexible; can “explain” arithmetic in arbitrary prose.\n-- **Coverage:** a regex cannot universally verify financial prose; a second LLM is non-deterministic, addable cost/latency, may hallucinate agreement, and is itself unverifiable — it cannot certify. It can at most triage which sentences look numeric for human review.\n+- **Coverage:** a regex cannot universally verify financial prose; a second LLM is non-deterministic, adds cost/latency, can hallucinate agreement, and is itself unverifiable. It can at most **triage or extract candidate claims**, never certify.\n - **Cost:** ESTIMATE ~2–4 days plus per-call cost/latency; weak auditability.\n-- **Verdict:** acceptable only as a *claim-extraction aid* feeding B, never as the authority. Never claim a regex or a second LLM universally verifies arbitrary financial prose.\n+- **Verdict:** acceptable only as a *detection aid*; its output is always an `UNSUPPORTED`/`NOT_VERIFIABLE`-until-confirmed suggestion and never yields `VERIFIED` by itself (wrong operands/formula that happen to compute must not certify the prose).\n \n-**Recommendation:** **B**, with an optional LLM-assisted *extraction hint* that is itself unverified and always confirmed by the deterministic calculator before any `VERIFIED` status. Problem statement\n10: \n11: Prompt instructions alone (L1/L2) reduce but cannot certify free-text financial arithmetic. Concretely observed on the current frozen source (not re-run here; recorded by the coordinator):\n12: \n13: - L1 fixtures now correctly report `258.47 − 255.33 = 3.14` points and about `0.72×ATR` (ATR `4.39`), including forced free-text and unknown/nonpositive-ATR cases, and describe the level as **below** the close.\n14: - Yet full C1 `20261121T101520Z-52544e6d` (deepseek profile) PM prose says a `1.5–2×ATR` stop is “~6.6–8.8 points (ATR 4.39)” and later writes **“anchor the stop 1.5–8.8 points below the fill.”** The second phrase mixes a **multiplier** with a **price-point** quantity — a dimensional/definition error that is not caught by prompt wording, and is not a price-arithmetic error the existing prose constraints can prove or disprove.\n15: \n16: Broader financial definitions also matter and are **not** trivially certifiable: EPS is not generally safely additive across quarters; an effective tax rate cannot be certified from net income / operating income when pretax income and tax expense are absent. These are coverage examples motivating the design boundary; this plan does **not** assert that every claim in any report was independently audited.\n17: \n18: Prompt-only mitigation is now insufficient for a claim of “verified numbers”. This proposal defines a **bounded, deterministic numeric-validation extension** that can mark specific, named, checkable quantities as verified/mismatch/not-verifiable/unsupported — **without** claiming universal arithmetic correctness of arbitrary prose.\n19: \n20: ### 1.1 Proposed (UNAPPROVED) requirement IDs\n21: \n22: Separate `NVR-` prefix; not canonical requirements.\n23: \n24: - **NVR-001 — Trusted fact projection.** Selected numeric inputs used by decision stages are captured as a typed, run-bound projection (ticker, analysis date, source, input fingerprint, units, precision) rather than only as prose.\n25: - **NVR-002 — Registered computations only.** A deterministic calculator performs only **registered** operations on typed facts (`subtract`, `divide_positive`, `atr_band`, `percent_of`, `notional`, `ratio`), with fixed units, `Decimal` arithmetic and defined rounding. No `eval`, no model-authored expected values.\n26: - **NVR-003 — Bounded name-class coverage.** The first release covers named classes only: absolute price distance and direction; ATR-scaled distance/bands; percentages with an explicit denominator; position notional from supplied quantities; risk/reward with explicit anchors. Out-of-scope financial definitions (tax-rate from net/operating income, weighted-EPS derivation) are reported as **unsupported**, never “verified” merely because a formula runs.\n27: - **NVR-004 — Coverage-honest status.** Each evaluated claim is `VERIFIED`, `MISMATCH`, `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (missing/unknown/nonfinite inputs) or `UNSUPPORTED` (unregistered class). A run-level coverage status is reported; partial coverage never yields a “numeric PASS” for the whole narrative.\n28: - **NVR-005 — Audit-only first.** The extension first runs as a sidecar producing an audit artifact with **no** change to `output_check`, `run_outcome`, Q1–Q4, public result enums or report rendering. Any runtime gating or controlled rendering requires a separately approved contract/schema/quality-rule change (A/C).\n29: - **NVR-006 — Provenance and immutability.** Facts and claims bind to run id, ticker, analysis date, source reference, input fingerprint and unit; unknown is never `0`; raw stage evidence is retained and finalized artifacts are immutable (existing invariants preserved).\n30: \n31: ### 1.2 Preserved decisions (not reopened)\n32: \n33: Two input modes; five research ratings and three Trader actions; Q1–Q4 unchanged; user-supplied/unverified holdings/cash; no orders; source-date constraints (no post-cutoff data); report+manifest critical, terminal-append best-effort; the frozen `RunContext`/fingerprint; no reliance on the raw low-level primitive. This plan does **not** restart the ADR 001 C1/C2/C3 architecture decision.\n34: \n35: ---\n36: \n37: ## 2. Candidate approaches (design comparison; ESTIMATE, no measurements)\n38: \n39: Estimates are design judgements labelled **ESTIMATE**. No measured latency/cost/accuracy is claimed.\n40: \n41: ### 2.1 A — Expanded prompts only (status quo + more instructions)\n42: \n43: - **Rationale:** cheapest to ship; no new modules. L1/L2 already show prompt wording changes behaviour.\n44: - **Coverage:** cannot certify any arithmetic; dimensional/definition errors (the `1.5–8.8 points` example) persist; no machine-readable coverage.\n45: - **Cost:** ESTIMATE ~0.2–0.5 day; no new test surface worth much because it cannot prove correctness.\n46: - **Verdict:** necessary but insufficient; keep L1/L2, do not extend as the solution.\n47: \n48: ### 2.2 B — Trusted typed-fact/derived-claim ledger + deterministic calculator + controlled rendering (recommended)\n49: \n50: - **Rationale:** separates *facts* (typed, run-bound) from *claims* (what the text asserts) from *computed results* (deterministic). A claim about a registered class is checked against the calculator; unregistered classes are `UNSUPPORTED`; missing inputs are `NOT_VERIFIABLE`. This is the only approach that can truthfully mark specific claims verified or mismatched.\n51: - **Coverage gaps:** prose that cannot be parsed into a registered claim stays `UNVERIFIED` (reported, not hidden); semantic financial definitions remain `UNSUPPORTED`; coverage is bounded to the registered classes.\n52: - **Integration cost:** new trusted-fact projection, calculator, claim extractor, sidecar artifact and tests; ESTIMATE ~4–7 days for the audit-only first release, plus review for any later runtime gating.\n53: - **Verdict:** recommended bounded design.\n54: \n55: ### 2.3 C — Prose parsing / second-LLM critique\n56: \n57: - **Rationale:** flexible; can “explain” arithmetic in arbitrary prose.\n58: - **Coverage:** a regex cannot universally verify financial prose; a second LLM is non-deterministic, addable cost/latency, may hallucinate agreement, and is itself unverifiable — it cannot certify. It can at most triage which sentences look numeric for human review.\n59: - **Cost:** ESTIMATE ~2–4 days plus per-call cost/latency; weak auditability.\n60: - **Verdict:** acceptable only as a *claim-extraction aid* feeding B, never as the authority. Never claim a regex or a second LLM universally verifies arbitrary financial prose.\n61: \n62: **Recommendation:** **B**, with an optional LLM-assisted *extraction hint* that is itself unverified and always confirmed by the deterministic calculator before any `VERIFIED` status. Do not restart C1/C2/C3.\n63: \n64: ---\n65: \n66: ## 3. Actual code seams inspected (read-only)\n67: \n68: Facts about the current tree, so the plan names real interfaces and marks new ones clearly.\n69: \n70: - **Graph state holds prose, not structured numbers.** `tradingagents/agents/state.py` (`AgentState`) carries `market_report`, `fundamentals_report`, `investment_plan`, `trader_investment_plan`, `final_trade_decision`, `final_rating` and a rendered `portfolio_context` string. There is **no** typed numeric-facts field.\n71: - **The verified market snapshot is rendered text, computed transiently.** `tradingagents/dataflows/vendors/yahoo/snapshot.py::build_verified_market_snapshot` computes latest OHLCV + indicators deterministically but **returns a markdown string**; the structured values are not exposed as a projection to state. The tool is `tradingagents/agents/tools.py::get_verified_market_snapshot`.\n72: - **Some structured numeric fields exist for the Trader only.** `tradingagents/agents/schemas.py::TraderProposal` has `entry_price`, `stop_loss` (`float | None` coerced) and free-text `position_sizing`; `render_trader_proposal` turns them into prose. PM `PortfolioDecision.price_target` is similar. The PM/RM decision prose is otherwise unstructured.\n73: - **Portfolio facts are caller input, not market data.** `tradingagents/portfolio.py::PortfolioContext` (user-supplied, unverified) and the frozen `RunContext`/`FrozenSnapshot` in `tradingagents/runapi/context.py` (fingerprint, as-of) are the only canonical account snapshot. `agents/context.py::get_portfolio_context_from_state` renders it as text.\n74: - **Checks and result enums.** `tradingagents/runapi/checks.py::OutputChecker` implements Q1–Q4 only; `tradingagents/runapi/result.py` defines `Finding` rules `Q1|Q2|Q3|Q4|CHECK_ERROR`, `OutputCheck = PASSED|NEEDS_REVIEW|NOT_RUN`, `StopReason`, `RunOutcome`, `Rating`.\n75: - **Envelope/report assembly.** `tradingagents/runapi/reporting.py` builds the trusted envelope (provenance, outcome, check, findings) and, in `execution.py`, the final markdown/HTML; `tradingagents/reporting.py::_report_parts` selects prose sections.\n76: \n77: **Consequence:** the code does **not** already expose a trusted structured numeric projection for price/ATR/position facts. A **new** trusted fact projection is **REQUIRED**; this plan must not invent an existing canonical numeric snapshot. The deterministic snapshot logic in `snapshot.py` is a good *source* for typed values but currently returns text.\n78: \n79: ---\n80: \n81: ## 4. Trusted facts, claims and results — proposed schema/interface (NEW; UNAPPROVED)\n82: \n83: New modules (paths are proposals; ownership marked new):\n84: \n85: - `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/__init__.py` — package (NEW, owner: D implements, B contract, C tests, E wiring).\n86: - `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/facts.py` — `TrustedFact`/`FactBundle` projection and unit/precision policy (NEW).\n87: - `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/calculator.py` — registered ops over `Decimal` (NEW).\n88: - `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/claims.py` — claim model + extractor for registered classes (NEW).\n89: - `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/audit.py` — sidecar evaluation + artifact writer (NEW; audit-only).\n90: \n91: No existing production module is modified in the audit-only first release (a later gated stage would touch `runapi/execution.py`/`reporting.py`/`checks.py` only with approval).\n92: \n93: ### 4.1 `TrustedFact` / `FactBundle`\n94: \n95: ```\n96: FactSource = Literal[\"verified_market_snapshot\",\"portfolio_snapshot\",\"trader_structured\",\"fundamentals_statement\"]\n97: \n98: TrustedFact {\n99:   name: str                      # e.g. \"close\", \"atr\", \"stop_loss\", \"fill\", \"target\", \"quantity\", \"cash\"\n100:   value: Decimal | None          # None = unknown (never coerced to 0)\n101:   unit: Literal[\"price\",\"points\",\"shares\",\"currency\",\"multiple\",\"percent\",\"ratio\"]\n102:   source: FactSource\n103:   as_of: str                     # ISO analysis date the fact is valid for\n104:   period: str | None             # explicit period end/label if a statement fact\n105:   precision: int                 # display decimals this fact was sourced at\n106: }\n107: \n108: FactBundle {\n109:   run_id: str; ticker: str; analysis_date: str\n110:   fingerprint_sha256: str | None # frozen portfolio fingerprint when portfolio-derived (else None)\n111:   source_revision: str; prompt_hash: str\n112:   facts: list[TrustedFact]\n113:   # coverage: which classes have complete inputs\n114: }\n115: ```\n116: \n117: Rules: unknown `value` is `None` (never `0`); `as_of` must equal the run's analysis date (or earlier for statements); a fact with a post-cutoff `as_of`/`period` is excluded; the bundle binds to the frozen `RunContext` (provenance per [INV-04/05](../invariants.md)).\n118: \n119: ### 4.2 `NumericClaim` (what the prose asserts)\n120: \n121: ```\n122: ClaimClass = Literal[\n123:   \"price_distance\",\"price_direction\",\"atr_distance\",\"atr_band\",\n124:   \"percent_with_denominator\",\"position_notional\",\"risk_reward\"\n125: ]\n126: \n127: NumericClaim {\n128:   claim_id: str\n129:   class: ClaimClass\n130:   operands: list[str]            # fact names, resolved against the FactBundle\n131:   asserted_value: Decimal | None # number the prose states (or None for a range/omitted)\n132:   asserted_unit: \"price|points|currency|percent|ratio\"\n133:   asserted_range: tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None\n134:   anchor: str | None             # explicit anchor fact the distance/direction is relative to\n135:   text_span: tuple[int,int]      # offsets into the stage prose (evidence; not rewritten)\n136:   stage: str                     # \"trader\" | \"portfolio_manager\" | \"research_manager\" | ...\n137: }\n138: ```\n139: \n140: A claim with a unit/definition the calculator cannot bind is `UNSUPPORTED`, never silently reinterpreted.\n141: \n142: ### 4.3 `ComputedResult` / `Finding` (proposal; NOT Q1–Q4)\n143: \n144: ```\n145: CoverageStatus = Literal[\"VERIFIED\",\"MISMATCH\",\"NOT_VERIFIABLE\",\"UNSUPPORTED\"]\n146: \n147: ComputedResult {\n148:   claim_id: str\n149:   computed_value: Decimal | None\n150:   computed_unit: ...\n151:   tolerance: Decimal             # absolute or relative per policy below\n152:   status: CoverageStatus\n153:   source_facts: list[str]\n154:   notes: str                     # e.g. \"missing atr\" / \"unit multiplier vs points\"\n155: }\n156: ```\n157: \n158: **Do not reuse `CHECK_ERROR`** to mean a numerical semantic mismatch and **do not create a Q5 silently.** A later, A/C-approved change may add a **proposal-only** finding type (e.g. `NumericFinding { rule: \"NUMERIC\", ... }`) with explicit compatibility notes; until then results live only in the sidecar artifact.\n159: \n160: ### 4.4 Precision / tolerance / units policy (proposed, exact)\n161: \n162: - **Arithmetic:** `Decimal` with a fixed context precision (e.g. 28 significant digits); no binary float in the calculator.\n163: - **Rounding for display:** half-up to the **sourced precision** of the weakest operand, or a class default (prices/points: 2 dp; multiples/ratios: 4 dp; percentages: 2 dp). Rounding is explicit and recorded.\n164: - **Tolerance:** prices/points: `±0.01` (2 dp); multiples/ratios: `±0.005` relative after 4 dp; percentages: `±0.05` percentage points. A claim inside tolerance is `VERIFIED`; outside is `MISMATCH`.\n165: - **Units:** the calculator refuses to combine a `multiple` operand with a `price/points` asserted unit — that is `MISMATCH` (dimensional/definition), reported to review, **not** a run failure and **not** auto-rewritten.\n166: \n167: ### 4.5 Exact worked examples (deterministic; document examples)\n168: \n169: - Distance/direction: `close=258.47`, `stop=255.33` → `abs(258.47 − 255.33) = 3.14` points; `stop < close` ⇒ **below**. `VERIFIED` if prose says ≈`3.14` points below.\n170: - ATR multiple: `distance=3.14`, `atr=4.39` (positive) → `3.14 / 4.39 ≈ 0.71526196`; display 4 dp `0.7153`, tolerance ±0.005 relative ⇒ prose “≈0.72×ATR” `VERIFIED`.\n171: - ATR band: `1.5 × 4.39 = 6.585`, `2 × 4.39 = 8.78` points → band `6.585–8.78` points; display 2 dp `6.59–8.78` (half-up) or keep `6.585–8.78`. Prose “1.5–2×ATR is ~6.6–8.8 points” `VERIFIED` within ±0.01/±0.1 display tolerance as configured.\n172: - **Observed failure:** prose “anchor the stop **1.5–8.8 points** below the fill” mixes a multiplier (`1.5×`) with a point quantity (`8.8 points`) → operands/units inconsistent ⇒ `MISMATCH` (dimensional), surfaced for review; the number is **not** silently rewritten and the run is **not** failed by the audit sidecar.\n173: - Unsupported: effective tax rate from `net_income / operating_income` when `pretax_income`/`tax_expense` absent ⇒ `UNSUPPORTED` (definition) — never `VERIFIED`.\n174: - Not verifiable: ATR missing or `≤ 0` ⇒ any ATR multiple/band claim ⇒ `NOT_VERIFIABLE`; unknown cash ⇒ any affordability claim ⇒ `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (no `0`).\n175: \n176: ---\n177: \n178: ## 5. Integration stages\n179: \n180: **Stage 0 — audit sidecar (no public change).** New `numeric/*` modules run after the engine returns `final_state` (and after a new trusted fact projection is built), producing `numeric_audit.json` under the run's staging dir alongside existing best-effort sinks. It writes **no** `Finding`, changes **no** `output_check`/`run_outcome`, and does not alter rendered text. Q1–Q4 unchanged. This is the first (and only immediately reviewable) release; ESTIMATE ~4–7 days.\n181: \n182: **Stage 1 — optional runtime gating / controlled rendering (needs approval).** Only if A/C approve a schema/interface/quality-rule change: surface coverage status in the report and/or map `MISMATCH` on a **registered** class to `NEEDS_REVIEW` via a **new, named** finding type (never a reused `CHECK_ERROR`, never a silent Q5). Requires review/edits to:\n183: \n184: | File / contract | Why it would change (Stage 1 only) |\n185: |---|---|\n186: | `docs/architecture/interface-contracts.md` §3.1–3.6, §6 | new finding/coverage type, check ordering, envelope fields |\n187: | `docs/architecture/invariants.md` INV-03, INV-04, INV-08, INV-11 | check authority vs numeric coverage; provenance binding |\n188: | `docs/architecture/runtime-policy-catalog.md` | a policy row for numeric mismatch vs unsupported vs not-verifiable |\n189: | `tradingagents/runapi/checks.py`, `result.py`, `reporting.py`, `execution.py` | emit/finding/render only with approval |\n190: | `tradingagents/reporting.py`, `report_html.py` | how coverage is communicated without implying whole-narrative certification |\n191: | `tradingagents/runapi/execution.py::_prompt_hash` inventory | include any new prompt-affecting module in source hashing |\n192: | `docs/architecture/memory-design.md`, `permission-model.md` | retention/privacy of the audit artifact and fact projection |\n193: | test registry / evaluation docs (`docs/verification/*`) | register the new acceptance scenarios |\n194: \n195: **Q1–Q4 remains unchanged until such approval.** Unclassified numerical prose remains **unverified**; the report/UI must state coverage as “N of M registered claims checked” and never imply the whole narrative is certified.\n196: \n197: ---\n198: \n199: ## 6. Staged acceptance plan (~13 scenarios; fixtures + expected; seam)\n200: \n201: Each row names the anticipated code seam. Offline/synthetic unless marked live. No universal arithmetic-PASS threshold is invented; verdicts are per-claim status + coverage honesty, with human/C scoring where semantic judgement is required.\n202: \n203: | ID | Fixture | Expected | Seam |\n204: |---|---|---|---|\n205: | NVA-01 | close 258.47, stop 255.33, ATR 4.39; prose “≈3.14 points below, ~0.72×ATR” | both claims `VERIFIED`; direction below | calculator+claims |\n206: | NVA-02 | same anchors; prose stop **above** close | direction `MISMATCH` | claims/calculator |\n207: | NVA-03 | same anchors; prose stop below (both direction cases) | direction correct both ways | claims |\n208: | NVA-04 | prose “1.5–8.8 points below the fill” (observed) | `MISMATCH` (dimension: multiplier vs points), review-needed, not run-failure | calculator units |\n209: | NVA-05 | ATR missing | ATR multiple/band `NOT_VERIFIABLE`; no `0`/division | facts/calculator |\n210: | NVA-06 | ATR = 0 / nonfinite | `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (positive-ATR guard), no divide-by-zero | calculator |\n211: | NVA-07 | NO_PORTFOLIO unknown cash | affordability/notional claim `NOT_VERIFIABLE`; never `0` cash | facts/portfolio |\n212: | NVA-08 | explicit-empty vs NO_PORTFOLIO | distinct; flat not asserted where unknown | facts/portfolio |\n213: | NVA-09 | wrong ticker/date/source/fingerprint binding | claim `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (or excluded), never `VERIFIED` | facts run-binding |\n214: | NVA-10 | unregistered formula (tax rate from net/operating income; weighted EPS) | `UNSUPPORTED`, never `VERIFIED` | claims/calculator registry |\n215: | NVA-11 | precision/rounding: 6.585 vs “6.6”, 0.71526196 vs “0.72” | within defined tolerance `VERIFIED`; outside `MISMATCH` | calculator precision policy |\n216: | NVA-12 | raw evidence retention + finalized-artifact immutability | `numeric_audit.json` written; report/manifest bytes unchanged; one terminal | audit stage 0 + [INV-12/14](../invariants.md) |\n217: | NVA-13 | partial coverage (some `UNSUPPORTED`/`NOT_VERIFIABLE`) | run reports partial coverage; **no** false “PASSED/verified” whole narrative | audit summary |\n218: | NVA-L | after any Stage-1 interface change: live fixed replay | registered claims evaluated against real facts; coverage reported; independent human/C review where semantic judgement needed | integration |\n219: \n220: **Independent human review / C scoring is still required** for: whether a `VERIFIED` claim is the *right* claim to make, narrative quality, ownership/challenge semantics, and any staged promotion from audit-only to gating. No numeric PASS threshold constitutes C acceptance or F8 recovery.\n221: \n222: ---\n223: \n224: ## 7. Work split, prerequisites, estimates, migration, risks\n225: \n226: ### 7.1 Handoff (recorded team allocation; not universal course roles)\n227: \n228: - **B (architecture):** approve `NVR-` scope, the `TrustedFact`/`NumericClaim`/`CoverageStatus` contract, units/precision/tolerance policy, and the Stage-1 contract deltas (§5).\n229: - **D (implementation):** build `numeric/*`, the trusted fact projection from existing deterministic sources, the registered calculator and claim extractor; wire the audit sidecar best-effort.\n230: - **C (independent tests/evaluation):** own NVA acceptance, a real cohort, and semantic judgement; no threshold invented by D.\n231: - **E (integration/governance):** prompt-hash/source-inventory updates, sidecar sink/privacy wiring, report and registry edits — only after approval.\n232: - **A (requirements):** decide whether any `NVR-` item becomes a canonical requirement and whether Stage-1 gating is adopted.\n233: \n234: ### 7.2 Prerequisites and genuinely pending choices\n235: \n236: Pending (do not assume): whether to adopt B vs B+LLM-extraction; whether Stage 1 gating is wanted at all; the exact tolerance/rounding table; where facts come from (extend `snapshot.py` to also expose typed values vs a new projector); whether the audit artifact is a new best-effort sink or lives outside the published run; who owns semantic acceptance.\n237: \n238: ### 7.3 Estimates (ESTIMATE; no measurements)\n239: \n240: - Stage 0 (audit sidecar + registered classes + tests): **≈ 4–7 working days**.\n241: - Stage 1 (gating/rendering + contract review + live replay): **≈ 3–6 working days**, plus A/C review.\n242: - LLM-assisted extraction hint (optional): **≈ 1–2 working days** + per-call cost/latency.\n243: - Maintenance: registry/units policy edits per new metric class.\n244: \n245: ### 7.4 Migration / rollback\n246: \n247: - **Migration:** additive, audit-only first; no public enum/signature change; the sidecar is opt-in under a feature flag and failure to validate is best-effort (must never flip `run_outcome`).\n248: - **Rollback:** remove the sidecar invocation and flag; the report/manifest remain byte-identical to pre-extension (NVA-12 proves immutability), so rollback is a code-path disable, not a data migration.\n249: \n250: ### 7.5 Risks\n251: \n252: - **False assurance:** users may read `VERIFIED` as “whole report is correct”. Mitigation: coverage counts, explicit `UNSUPPORTED`/`NOT_VERIFIABLE`, no whole-narrative badge.\n253: - **Bounded coverage:** only registered classes checked; unclassified numeric prose stays unverified (stated, not hidden).\n254: - **Fact-source disputes:** typed facts must come from deterministic sources, not from model text; otherwise verification is circular.\n255: - **LLM extraction errors:** extraction hints are unverified; only the deterministic calculator can set `VERIFIED`.\n256: - **Integration cost/scope creep:** Stage-1 gating touches check authority and contracts; keep it separately approved.\n257: \n258: ---\n259: \n260: ## 8. Status and next step\n261: \n262: This is a **plan for review**, not an implementation, not an approval, and not a claim that current reports pass any numeric check. Brian authorized only drafting it. Implementation, tests, canonical-requirement adoption and any Stage-1 gating wait for A/B/C/D/E scope, design and test approval. Problem statement\n\nPrompt instructions alone (L1/L2) reduce but cannot certify free-text financial arithmetic. Concretely observed on the current frozen source (not re-run here; recorded by the coordinator):\n\n- L1 fixtures now correctly report `258.47 − 255.33 = 3.14` points and about `0.72×ATR` (ATR `4.39`), including forced free-text and unknown/nonpositive-ATR cases, and describe the level as **below** the close.\n- Yet full C1 `20261121T101520Z-52544e6d` (deepseek profile) PM prose says a `1.5–2×ATR` stop is “~6.6–8.8 points (ATR 4.39)” and later writes **“anchor the stop 1.5–8.8 points below the fill.”** The second phrase mixes a **multiplier** with a **price-point** quantity — a dimensional/definition error that is not caught by prompt wording, and is not a price-arithmetic error the existing prose constraints can prove or disprove.\n\nBroader financial definitions also matter and are **not** trivially certifiable: EPS is not generally safely additive across quarters; an effective tax rate cannot be certified from net income / operating income when pretax income and tax expense are absent. These are coverage examples motivating the design boundary; this plan does **not** assert that every claim in any report was independently audited.\n\nPrompt-only mitigation is now insufficient for a claim of “verified numbers”. This proposal defines a **bounded, deterministic numeric-validation extension** that can mark specific, named, checkable quantities as verified/mismatch/not-verifiable/unsupported — **without** claiming universal arithmetic correctness of arbitrary prose.\n\n### 1.1 Proposed (UNAPPROVED) requirement IDs\n\nSeparate `NVR-` prefix; not canonical requirements.\n\n- **NVR-001 — Trusted fact projection.** Selected numeric inputs used by decision stages are captured as a typed, run-bound projection (ticker, analysis date, source, input fingerprint, units, precision) rather than only as prose.\n- **NVR-002 — Registered computations only.** A deterministic calculator performs only **registered** operations on typed facts (`subtract`, `divide_positive`, `atr_band`, `percent_of`, `notional`, `ratio`), with fixed units, `Decimal` arithmetic and defined rounding. No `eval`, no model-authored expected values.\n- **NVR-003 — Bounded name-class coverage.** The first release covers named classes only: absolute price distance and direction; ATR-scaled distance/bands; percentages with an explicit denominator; position notional from supplied quantities; risk/reward with explicit anchors. Out-of-scope financial definitions (tax-rate from net/operating income, weighted-EPS derivation) are reported as **unsupported**, never “verified” merely because a formula runs.\n- **NVR-004 — Coverage-honest status.** Each evaluated claim is `VERIFIED`, `MISMATCH`, `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (missing/unknown/nonfinite inputs) or `UNSUPPORTED` (unregistered class). A run-level coverage status is reported; partial coverage never yields a “numeric PASS” for the whole narrative.\n- **NVR-005 — Audit-only first.** The extension first runs as a sidecar producing an audit artifact with **no** change to `output_check`, `run_outcome`, Q1–Q4, public result enums or report rendering. Any runtime gating or controlled rendering requires a separately approved contract/schema/quality-rule change (A/C).\n- **NVR-006 — Provenance and immutability.** Facts and claims bind to run id, ticker, analysis date, source reference, input fingerprint and unit; unknown is never `0`; raw stage evidence is retained and finalized artifacts are immutable (existing invariants preserved).\n\n### 1.2 Preserved decisions (not reopened)\n\nTwo input modes; five research ratings and three Trader actions; Q1–Q4 unchanged; user-supplied/unverified holdings/cash; no orders; source-date constraints (no post-cutoff data); report+manifest critical, terminal-append best-effort; the frozen `RunContext`/fingerprint; no reliance on the raw low-level primitive. This plan does **not** restart the ADR 001 C1/C2/C3 architecture decision.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Candidate approaches (design comparison; ESTIMATE, no measurements)\n\nEstimates are design judgements labelled **ESTIMATE**. No measured latency/cost/accuracy is claimed.\n\n### 2.1 A — Expanded prompts only (status quo + more instructions)\n\n- **Rationale:** cheapest to ship; no new modules. L1/L2 already show prompt wording changes behaviour.\n- **Coverage:** cannot certify any arithmetic; dimensional/definition errors (the `1.5–8.8 points` example) persist; no machine-readable coverage.\n- **Cost:** ESTIMATE ~0.2–0.5 day; no new test surface worth much because it cannot prove correctness.\n- **Verdict:** necessary but insufficient; keep L1/L2, do not extend as the solution.\n\n### 2.2 B — Trusted typed-fact/derived-claim ledger + deterministic calculator + controlled rendering (recommended)\n\n- **Rationale:** separates *facts* (typed, run-bound) from *claims* (what the text asserts) from *computed results* (deterministic). A claim about a registered class is checked against the calculator; unregistered classes are `UNSUPPORTED`; missing inputs are `NOT_VERIFIABLE`. This is the only approach that can truthfully mark specific claims verified or mismatched.\n- **Coverage gaps:** prose that cannot be parsed into a registered claim stays `UNVERIFIED` (reported, not hidden); semantic financial definitions remain `UNSUPPORTED`; coverage is bounded to the registered classes.\n- **Integration cost:** new trusted-fact projection, calculator, claim extractor, sidecar artifact and tests; ESTIMATE ~4–7 days for the audit-only first release, plus review for any later runtime gating.\n- **Verdict:** recommended bounded design.\n\n### 2.3 C — Prose parsing / second-LLM critique\n\n- **Rationale:** flexible; can “explain” arithmetic in arbitrary prose.\n- **Coverage:** a regex cannot universally verify financial prose; a second LLM is non-deterministic, addable cost/latency, may hallucinate agreement, and is itself unverifiable — it cannot certify. It can at most triage which sentences look numeric for human review.\n- **Cost:** ESTIMATE ~2–4 days plus per-call cost/latency; weak auditability.\n- **Verdict:** acceptable only as a *claim-extraction aid* feeding B, never as the authority. Never claim a regex or a second LLM universally verifies arbitrary financial prose.\n\n**Recommendation:** **B**, with an optional LLM-assisted *extraction hint* that is itself unverified and always confirmed by the deterministic calculator before any `VERIFIED` status. Do not restart C1/C2/C3.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Actual code seams inspected (read-only)\n\nFacts about the current tree, so the plan names real interfaces and marks new ones clearly.\n\n- **Graph state holds prose, not structured numbers.** `tradingagents/agents/state.py` (`AgentState`) carries `market_report`, `fundamentals_report`, `investment_plan`, `trader_investment_plan`, `final_trade_decision`, `final_rating` and a rendered `portfolio_context` string. There is **no** typed numeric-facts field.\n- **The verified market snapshot is rendered text, computed transiently.** `tradingagents/dataflows/vendors/yahoo/snapshot.py::build_verified_market_snapshot` computes latest OHLCV + indicators deterministically but **returns a markdown string**; the structured values are not exposed as a projection to state. The tool is `tradingagents/agents/tools.py::get_verified_market_snapshot`.\n- **Some structured numeric fields exist for the Trader only.** `tradingagents/agents/schemas.py::TraderProposal` has `entry_price`, `stop_loss` (`float | None` coerced) and free-text `position_sizing`; `render_trader_proposal` turns them into prose. PM `PortfolioDecision.price_target` is similar. The PM/RM decision prose is otherwise unstructured.\n- **Portfolio facts are caller input, not market data.** `tradingagents/portfolio.py::PortfolioContext` (user-supplied, unverified) and the frozen `RunContext`/`FrozenSnapshot` in `tradingagents/runapi/context.py` (fingerprint, as-of) are the only canonical account snapshot. `agents/context.py::get_portfolio_context_from_state` renders it as text.\n- **Checks and result enums.** `tradingagents/runapi/checks.py::OutputChecker` implements Q1–Q4 only; `tradingagents/runapi/result.py` defines `Finding` rules `Q1|Q2|Q3|Q4|CHECK_ERROR`, `OutputCheck = PASSED|NEEDS_REVIEW|NOT_RUN`, `StopReason`, `RunOutcome`, `Rating`.\n- **Envelope/report assembly.** `tradingagents/runapi/reporting.py` builds the trusted envelope (provenance, outcome, check, findings) and, in `execution.py`, the final markdown/HTML; `tradingagents/reporting.py::_report_parts` selects prose sections.\n\n**Consequence:** the code does **not** already expose a trusted structured numeric projection for price/ATR/position facts. The deterministic snapshot logic in `snapshot.py` is a good *source* for typed values but currently returns text.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Trusted facts, claims and results — proposed schema/interface (NEW; UNAPPROVED)\n\nNew modules (paths are proposals; ownership marked new):\n\n- `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/__init__.py` — package (NEW, owner: D implements, B contract, C tests, E wiring).\n- `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/facts.py` — `TrustedFact`/`FactBundle` projection and unit/precision policy (NEW).\n- `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/calculator.py` — registered ops over `Decimal` (NEW).\n- `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/claims.py` — claim model + extractor for registered classes (NEW).\n- `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/audit.py` — sidecar evaluation + artifact writer (NEW; audit-only).\n\nNo existing production module is modified in the audit-only first release (a later gated stage would touch `runapi/execution.py`/`reporting.py`/`checks.py` only with approval).\n\n### 4.1 `TrustedFact` / `FactBundle`\n\n```\nFactSource = Literal[\"verified_market_snapshot\",\"portfolio_snapshot\",\"trader_structured\",\"fundamentals_statement\"]\n\nTrustedFact {\n  name: str                      # e.g. \"close\", \"atr\", \"stop_loss\", \"fill\", \"target\", \"quantity\", \"cash\"\n  value: Decimal | None          # None = unknown (never coerced to 0)\n  unit: Literal[\"price\",\"points\",\"shares\",\"currency\",\"multiple\",\"percent\",\"ratio\"]\n  source: FactSource\n  as_of: str                     # ISO analysis date the fact is valid for\n  period: str | None             # explicit period end/label if a statement fact\n  precision: int                 # display decimals this fact was sourced at\n}\n\nFactBundle {\n  run_id: str; ticker: str; analysis_date: str\n  fingerprint_sha256: str | None # frozen portfolio fingerprint when portfolio-derived (else None)\n  source_revision: str; prompt_hash: str\n  facts: list[TrustedFact]\n  # coverage: which classes have complete inputs\n}\n```\n\nRules: unknown `value` is `None` (never `0`); `as_of` must equal the run's analysis date (or earlier for statements); a fact with a post-cutoff `as_of`/`period` is excluded; the bundle binds to the frozen `RunContext` (provenance per [INV-04/05](../invariants.md)).\n\n### 4.2 `NumericClaim` (what the prose asserts)\n\n```\nClaimClass = Literal[\n  \"price_distance\",\"price_direction\",\"atr_distance\",\"atr_band\",\n  \"percent_with_denominator\",\"position_notional\",\"risk_reward\"\n]\n\nNumericClaim {\n  claim_id: str\n  class: ClaimClass\n  operands: list[str]            # fact names, resolved against the FactBundle\n  asserted_value: Decimal | None # number the prose states (or None for a range/omitted)\n  asserted_unit: \"price|points|currency|percent|ratio\"\n  asserted_range: tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None\n  anchor: str | None             # explicit anchor fact the distance/direction is relative to\n  text_span: tuple[int,int]      # offsets into the stage prose (evidence; not rewritten)\n  stage: str                     # \"trader\" | \"portfolio_manager\" | \"research_manager\" | ...\n}\n```\n\nA claim with a unit/definition the calculator cannot bind is `UNSUPPORTED`, never silently reinterpreted.\n\n### 4.3 `ComputedResult` / `Finding` (proposal; NOT Q1–Q4)\n\n```\nCoverageStatus = Literal[\"VERIFIED\",\"MISMATCH\",\"NOT_VERIFIABLE\",\"UNSUPPORTED\"]\n\nComputedResult {\n  claim_id: str\n  computed_value: Decimal | None\n  computed_unit: ...\n  tolerance: Decimal             # absolute or relative per policy below\n  status: CoverageStatus\n  source_facts: list[str]\n  notes: str                     # e.g. \"missing atr\" / \"unit multiplier vs points\"\n}\n```\n\n**Do not reuse `CHECK_ERROR`** to mean a numerical semantic mismatch and **do not create a Q5 silently.** A later, A/C-approved change may add a **proposal-only** finding type (e.g. `NumericFinding { rule: \"NUMERIC\", ... }`) with explicit compatibility notes; until then results live only in the sidecar artifact.\n\n### 4.4 Precision / tolerance / units policy (proposed, exact)\n\n- **Arithmetic:** `Decimal` with a fixed context precision (e.g. 28 significant digits); no binary float in the calculator.\n- **Rounding for display:** half-up to the **sourced precision** of the weakest operand, or a class default (prices/points: 2 dp; multiples/ratios: 4 dp; percentages: 2 dp). Rounding is explicit and recorded.\n- **Tolerance:** prices/points: `±0.01` (2 dp); multiples/ratios: `±0.005` relative after 4 dp; percentages: `±0.05` percentage points. A claim inside tolerance is `VERIFIED`; outside is `MISMATCH`.\n- **Units:** the calculator refuses to combine a `multiple` operand with a `price/points` asserted unit — that is `MISMATCH` (dimensional/definition), reported to review, **not** a run failure and **not** auto-rewritten.\n\n### 4.5 Exact worked examples (deterministic; document examples)\n\n- Distance/direction: `close=258.47`, `stop=255.33` → `abs(258.47 − 255.33) = 3.14` points; `stop < close` ⇒ **below**. `VERIFIED` if prose says ≈`3.14` points below.\n- ATR multiple: `distance=3.14`, `atr=4.39` (positive) → `3.14 / 4.39 ≈ 0.71526196`; display 4 dp `0.7153`, tolerance ±0.005 relative ⇒ prose “≈0.72×ATR” `VERIFIED`.\n- ATR band: `1.5 × 4.39 = 6.585`, `2 × 4.39 = 8.78` points → band `6.585–8.78` points; display 2 dp `6.59–8.78` (half-up) or keep `6.585–8.78`. Prose “1.5–2×ATR is ~6.6–8.8 points” `VERIFIED` within ±0.01/±0.1 display tolerance as configured.\n- **Observed failure:** prose “anchor the stop **1.5–8.8 points** below the fill” mixes a multiplier (`1.5×`) with a point quantity (`8.8 points`) → operands/units inconsistent ⇒ `MISMATCH` (dimensional), surfaced for review; the number is **not** silently rewritten and the run is **not** failed by the audit sidecar.\n- Unsupported: effective tax rate from `net_income / operating_income` when `pretax_income`/`tax_expense` absent ⇒ `UNSUPPORTED` (definition) — never `VERIFIED`.\n- Not verifiable: ATR missing or `≤ 0` ⇒ any ATR multiple/band claim ⇒ `NOT_VERIFIABLE`; unknown cash ⇒ any affordability claim ⇒ `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (no `0`).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Integration stages\n\n**Stage 0 — audit sidecar (no public change).** New `numeric/*` modules run after the engine returns `final_state` (and after a new trusted fact projection is built), producing `numeric_audit.json` under the run's staging dir alongside existing best-effort sinks. It writes **no** `Finding`, changes **no** `output_check`/`run_outcome`, and does not alter rendered text. Q1–Q4 unchanged. This is the first (and only immediately reviewable) release; ESTIMATE ~4–7 days.\n\n**Stage 1 — optional runtime gating / controlled rendering (needs approval).** Only if A/C approve a schema/interface/quality-rule change: surface coverage status in the report and/or map `MISMATCH` on a **registered** class to `NEEDS_REVIEW` via a **new, named** finding type (never a reused `CHECK_ERROR`, never a silent Q5). Work split, prerequisites, estimates, migration, risks\n\n### 7.1 Handoff (recorded team allocation; not universal course roles)\n\n- **B (architecture):** approve `NVR-` scope, the `TrustedFact`/`NumericClaim`/`CoverageStatus` contract, units/precision/tolerance policy, and the Stage-1 contract deltas (§5).\n- **D (implementation):** build `numeric/*`, the trusted fact projection from existing deterministic sources, the registered calculator and claim extractor; A separate post-run audit can read the **saved** prose artifacts without touching the live path.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Proposed schema/interface (NEW; UNAPPROVED)\n\nFirst slice modules (out-of-tree standalone acceptable; paths proposed):\n\n- `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/__init__.py` — package (NEW; D implements, B contract, C tests, E wiring).\n- `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/facts.py` — `TrustedFact`/`FactBundle` + precision/unit policy (NEW).\n- `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/calculator.py` — registered relations over `Decimal` (NEW).\n- `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/claims.py` — claim model + (fixture-supplied) claim set (NEW).\n- `tradingagents/runapi/numeric/audit.py` — standalone audit over saved artifacts + supplied fixture (NEW).\n\nNo existing production module is modified by the first slice.\n\n### 4.1 `TrustedFact` / `FactBundle`\n\n```\nFactSource = Literal[\n  \"supplied_run_fixture\",        # explicitly supplied, run-bound typed inputs (first slice)\n  \"verified_market_snapshot\",    # later: typed values derived from snapshot.py\n  \"fundamentals_statement\",      # later: statement facts with period/availability date\n  \"trader_proposed_level\",       # later: the Trader's *proposed* level (NOT verified market truth)\n  \"portfolio_user_supplied\",     # user-supplied holdings/cash (unverified)\n]\n\nTrustedFact {\n  name: str\n  value: Decimal | None          # None = unknown (never coerced to 0)\n  unit: Literal[\"price\",\"points\",\"shares\",\"currency\",\"multiple\",\"percent\",\"ratio\"]\n  source: FactSource\n  source_id: str                 # e.g. snapshot row id / statement ref / \"user_input\"\n  availability_date: str         # ISO date the fact became knowable (must be <= run analysis date)\n  period: str | None             # explicit statement period end/label (not the run date)\n  run_analysis_date: str         # the run's analysis date\n  declared_precision: int        # digits after decimal the claim may rely on\n  verified: bool                 # True only for externally-verifiable sources; user/model inputs are False\n}\n\nFactBundle {\n  run_id: str; ticker: str; analysis_date: str\n  fingerprint_sha256: str | None # frozen portfolio fingerprint when portfolio-derived (else None)\n  source_revision: str; prompt_hash: str\n  facts: list[TrustedFact]\n}\n```\n\nRules: unknown `value` is `None` (never `0`); `availability_date` must be `<=` the run analysis date (a post-cutoff fact is excluded); `period` and `availability_date` are distinct from the run date; `verified=False` for user-supplied holdings and for model-proposed levels. Portfolio **quantity is user-supplied/unverified**. The bundle binds to the frozen `RunContext` (provenance per [INV-04/05](../invariants.md)).\n\n### 4.2 `NumericClaim` (a detected relation) and calculator operations\n\n```\nClaimClass = Literal[\n  \"price_distance\",\"price_direction\",\"atr_distance\",\"atr_band\",\n  \"percent_with_denominator\",\"position_notional\",\"risk_reward\"\n]\n\nOperandRef {\n  fact: str                      # fact name in the bundle\n  role: Literal[\"anchor\",\"level\",\"atr\",\"minuend\",\"subtrahend\",\"numerator\",\n                \"denominator\",\"factor_min\",\"factor_max\",\"quantity\",\"price\"]\n}\n\nNumericClaim {\n  claim_id: str\n  class: ClaimClass\n  operands: list[OperandRef]     # roles make the relation explicit\n  asserted_unit: \"price|points|currency|percent|ratio|multiple\"\n  asserted_value: Decimal | None # single stated number, or...\n  asserted_range: tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None\n  asserted_direction: \"above|below|none\"   # for distance/direction claims\n  claim_precision: int           # digits after decimal the *claim* was stated at\n  anchor_evidence: str | None    # trusted reference linking a claim to its anchor claim, if any\n  stage: str                     # \"trader\" | \"portfolio_manager\" | \"research_manager\" | ...\n  stage_text_sha256: str         # hash of the stage prose the span indexes into\n  text_span: tuple[int,int]      # offsets into that stage prose (evidence; never rewritten)\n  extraction_provenance: \"supplied\" | \"deterministic\" | \"llm_assisted\"\n}\n```\n\nA relation whose class is not registered, or whose operands cannot be bound, is `UNSUPPORTED` (the class exists as a typed marker even if the *specific* relation is unregistered; no impossible enum value). A claim with ambiguous extraction, unknown `claim_precision`, or missing `anchor_evidence` for an associated band is `NOT_VERIFIABLE`.\n\n**Operations (fixed registry):** `subtract(minuend, subtrahend)`, `abs_distance(anchor, level)`, `direction(anchor, level)`, `divide_positive(numerator, denominator)` (denominator must be `> 0`), `scaled_band(factor_min, factor_max, atr)`. Each op declares its operand roles and result unit. The calculator **verifies the relation relative to the specified operands**; it does not assert that those operands are the true or complete facts.\n\n### 4.3 `ComputedResult` (proposal; NOT Q1–Q4)\n\n```\nCoverageStatus = Literal[\"VERIFIED\",\"MISMATCH\",\"NOT_VERIFIABLE\",\"UNSUPPORTED\"]\n\nComputedResult {\n  claim_id: str\n  computed_value: Decimal | None\n  computed_range: tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None\n  computed_unit: ...\n  expected_at_claim_precision: Decimal | tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None  # round-half-up of computed at claim_precision\n  status: CoverageStatus\n  source_facts: list[str]\n  notes: str     # e.g. \"missing atr\" / \"ambiguous 1.5 role\" / \"unregistered relation\"\n}\n```\n\n**Do not reuse `CHECK_ERROR`** for a numerical semantic mismatch and **do not create a Q5 silently.** A later, A/C-approved change may add a proposal-only finding type (`NumericFinding { rule: \"NUMERIC\", ... }`); until then results live only in the standalone audit file.\n\n### 4.4 Precision / rounding / tolerance policy (exact for the first slice)\n\n- **Arithmetic:** Python `Decimal` at **context precision 28**; no binary float in the calculator.\n- **Comparison rule (first slice): NO tolerance.** Compute exactly, **round half-up to the claim's declared `claim_precision`**, and require **equality** with the asserted value/range endpoints. A different rounded value is `MISMATCH`.\n- **Precision bounds per class (frozen; a claim outside its bound is rejected as `NOT_VERIFIABLE`):**\n  - `price_distance`, `atr_band` → allow `claim_precision` in `{0,1,2}`.\n  - `atr_distance` (multiple) → allow `claim_precision` in `{1,2,3,4}`.\n  - `price_direction` → no numeric precision (boolean).\n- **Unknown/ambiguous precision** (the prose does not state enough digits to pin `claim_precision`) → `NOT_VERIFIABLE`.\n- **Units:** the calculator refuses to combine operands of incompatible unit roles (e.g. a `factor_*` (multiple) with a `points` asserted unit) → `NOT_VERIFIABLE` unless trusted `anchor_evidence` explicitly links them as the same range claim, in which case they are compared as that claim (§4.5).\n- No caller-chosen wide tolerances are permitted in the first slice.\n\n### 4.5 Worked examples under this policy (document examples, exact)\n\n- **Distance/direction (positive):** `anchor=258.47`, `level=255.33`, ATR `4.39`. `abs(258.47 − 255.33) = 3.14`; direction: `255.33 < 258.47` ⇒ **below**. Prose “≈3.14 points below” at `claim_precision=2` → expected `3.14` → `VERIFIED`.\n- **Direction (negative):** same anchors, prose says “above” → computed **below** ⇒ `asserted_direction` mismatch ⇒ `MISMATCH`.\n- **ATR multiple (positive at 2 dp):** `3.14 / 4.39 = 0.7152619576…`; round half-up to `claim_precision=2` → `0.72`. Prose “0.72×ATR” → `VERIFIED`.\n- **ATR multiple (boundary negative):** same, but prose “0.7153×ATR” at `claim_precision=4` → expected `0.7153` (round-half-up of `0.71526195…`) → `VERIFIED`; prose “0.72×ATR” is only valid at `claim_precision=2`. A prose that states `0.72` but declares precision 4 is inconsistent → `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (ambiguous precision), **not** silently accepted. This resolves the earlier `0.7153` vs `0.72` contradiction: the two are **different declared precisions**, compared by equality only at each claim's own precision.\n- **ATR band (positive):** `factor_min=1.5`, `factor_max=2`, `atr=4.39` → `1.5 × 4.39 = 6.585`, `2 × 4.39 = 8.78`. At `claim_precision=2`, round-half-up → expected band `(6.59, 8.78)`. Prose “6.59–8.78 points” → `VERIFIED`; prose “6.585–8.78” at precision 3 is outside the frozen bound for `atr_band` (max 2) → `NOT_VERIFIABLE`.\n- **ATR band (boundary negative):** prose “6.6–8.8 points” at `claim_precision=1`: expected (round-half-up) `(6.6, 8.8)` → `VERIFIED`; the **same** numbers claimed at precision 2 → expected `(6.59, 8.78)` ≠ `(6.60, 8.80)` → `MISMATCH`. Precision is part of the claim.\n- **PM band “1.5–8.8 points below the fill” (observed):** parsed literally, both endpoints are `points`, giving range `(1.5, 8.8)` points. If trusted `anchor_evidence` links it to the preceding `1.5–2×ATR` claim, compare against the expected band `(6.59, 8.78)` at precision 2 → `MISMATCH` (lower endpoint `1.5` ≠ `6.59`). If no trusted association exists, the first endpoint's role is ambiguous (`1.5` could be a factor) ⇒ `NOT_VERIFIABLE`. It is **not** universally a dimensional error; the auditor reports `MISMATCH`/`NOT_VERIFIABLE` for review and never rewrites the text or fails the run.\n- **C2 ATR multiple (observed):** `anchor=258.47`, `level=250.94`, `atr=4.39` → `7.53`; `7.53 / 4.39 = 1.71526195…`; at `claim_precision=1` round-half-up → `1.7`. Prose “roughly 1×ATR” ⇒ `MISMATCH` (also outside any integer rounding), surfaced for review.\n- **Unsupported:** effective tax rate from `net_income / operating_income` when `pretax_income`/`tax_expense` absent ⇒ `UNSUPPORTED`.\n- **Not verifiable:** ATR missing or `≤ 0` ⇒ ATR multiple/band `NOT_VERIFIABLE`; unknown cash ⇒ any affordability/notional claim needing cash `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (no `0`).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Integration stages\n\n**Stage 0 — standalone post-run audit (first slice; no live-path change).** A separate tool reads **saved** stage artifacts plus an **explicitly supplied, run-bound typed fact fixture**, evaluates only the first-slice relations, and writes its **own** audit file at a caller-chosen location **outside** the finalized run directory. It does **not** modify saved artifacts, the manifest or its hashes, and its retention/integrity (`audit.json` + its own checksum) is **distinct** from the authoritative report/manifest. It changes no `Finding`/`output_check`/`run_outcome`/rendering. Coverage is reported **inside the audit file only**, never in the published report/UI.\n\n**Stage 1 — later: automatic typed fact projection + staging integration (needs named seams and approval).** Extracting typed facts directly from `snapshot.py`/graph, writing the audit into the staging area, or surfacing coverage in the report requires touching these existing modules, with separate review:\n`tradingagents/dataflows/vendors/yahoo/snapshot.py`, `tradingagents/agents/state.py`, `tradingagents/runapi/execution.py`, `tradingagents/runapi/persist.py`, `tradingagents/runapi/reporting.py`, `tradingagents/reporting.py`, `tradingagents/runapi/execution.py::_prompt_hash` (source inventory).\n\n**Stage 2 — optional render/gating (separately unapproved).** Only if A/C approve a schema/interface/quality-rule change: map a `MISMATCH` on a registered relation to `NEEDS_REVIEW` via a **new, named** finding type (never a reused `CHECK_ERROR`, never a silent Q5) and/or communicate coverage in the report without implying whole-narrative certification. Would also require edits to `docs/architecture/interface-contracts.md` §3.1–3.6/§6, `docs/architecture/invariants.md` INV-03/04/08/11, `docs/architecture/runtime-policy-catalog.md`, `docs/architecture/memory-design.md`, `permission-model.md`, and the `docs/verification/*` registry.\n\n**Q1–Q4 remains unchanged until such approval.** Undetected/unregistered numerical prose remains uncounted; the audit states coverage as “N of M **detected registered** claims checked”, never a whole-narrative certification.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Acceptance plan\n\n### 6.0 Optional small first slice (price distance/direction + ATR band only)\n\nFixture: a supplied typed fact packet for one saved run (e.g. `close=258.47`, `stop=255.33`, `atr=4.39`, `as_of=2026-01-09`) and a small set of supplied claims with roles/precision. Scenarios:\n\n| ID | Fixture | Expected | Seam |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| NVA-01 | prose “≈3.14 points below” | `VERIFIED` (distance+direction) | calculator `abs_distance`/`direction` |\n| NVA-02 | same anchors; prose says “above” | `MISMATCH` (direction) | `direction` |\n| NVA-03 | same anchors; prose correctly says “below” (reverse of NVA-02) | `VERIFIED` (direction) | `direction` |\n| NVA-04 | prose “6.59–8.78 points” at precision 2 | `VERIFIED` (ATR band) | `scaled_band` |\n| NVA-05 | prose “0.72×ATR” at precision 2 and “0.7153×ATR” at precision 4 | both `VERIFIED`; a `0.72` claim declared at precision 4 | `NOT_VERIFIABLE` | `divide_positive` + precision policy |\n| NVA-06 | ATR missing / `0` / nonfinite | `NOT_VERIFIABLE`, no `0`, no divide-by-zero | `divide_positive`/`scaled_band` |\n\nThe slice stops there; it does **not** validate any frozen report. ESTIMATE for this slice: **~1–2 working days** for a standalone tool + fixture + these scenarios, **if** the team wants it before the deadline; otherwise it should be deferred. This estimate is not a promise.\n\n### 6.1 Full roadmap scenarios (beyond the first slice, needing later approval)\n\n| ID | Fixture | Expected | Seam |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| NVA-07 | notional: supplied quantity `40` and supplied price `258.47` → `10338.80`; separately, an “affordability” claim needing **cash** (unknown) | notional `VERIFIED` (from supplied qty×price); affordability `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (cash unknown, not `0`) | `position_notional` vs affordability inputs |\n| NVA-08 | explicit-empty vs NO_PORTFOLIO portfolios | distinct; flat not asserted where unknown | fact bundle |\n| NVA-09 | wrong ticker/date/source/fingerprint binding | claim `NOT_VERIFIABLE`/excluded, never `VERIFIED` | fact run-binding |\n| NVA-10 | unregistered relation (tax rate from net/operating income; weighted EPS) | `UNSUPPORTED`, never `VERIFIED` | registry |\n| NVA-11 | precision boundaries (6.585 vs “6.6”; 0.7153 vs “0.72”; declared vs claimed precision) | exact per §4.4; wrong precision `NOT_VERIFIABLE`, wrong rounded value `MISMATCH` | calculator precision |\n| NVA-12 | standalone run over saved artifacts | audit file written **outside** the run dir; saved report/manifest bytes and hashes unchanged | Stage 0 standalone |\n| NVA-13 | partial coverage (some `UNSUPPORTED`/`NOT_VERIFIABLE`) | audit summary reports counts; **no** published report/UI coverage and **no** whole-narrative verified claim | audit summary only |\n| NVA-14 | PM band “1.5–8.8 points” with and without trusted anchor linkage | `MISMATCH` (linked) / `NOT_VERIFIABLE` (unlinked); review-needed, never auto-rewritten | claims `anchor_evidence` |\n| NVA-L | after any Stage-1/2 change: live fixed replay | registered relations evaluated against real facts; coverage internal; independent human/C review | integration |\n\nWhere a class is unregistered or a relation's operands cannot be bound, the result is `UNSUPPORTED` (represented via `extraction_provenance`/notes), never an impossible `ClaimClass` value.\n\n**Independent human review / C scoring is still required** for: whether a `VERIFIED` relation is the *right* claim to make, narrative quality, ownership/challenge semantics, and any promotion from audit-only to gating. No numeric threshold constitutes C acceptance or F8 recovery.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Work split, prerequisites, estimates, migration, risks\n\n### 7.1 Handoff (recorded team allocation; not universal course roles)\n\n- **B (architecture):** propose `NVR-` scope, the fact/claim/status contract, units/precision policy and Stage-1/2 deltas.\n- **A (requirements):** adopt (or not) any `NVR-` item and any Stage-2 gating; A owns requirement adoption.\n- **C (independent tests/evaluation):** own NVA acceptance, a real cohort and semantic judgement. C owns acceptance; D does not define it.\n- **D (implementation):** build the standalone first slice; later, the typed projection, calculator and claim extraction.\n- **E (integration/governance):** prompt-hash/source-inventory, staging/sink/privacy, report and registry edits — only after approval.\n\nNo approvals are asserted or invented here.\n\n### 7.2 Prerequisites and genuinely pending choices\n\nPending: whether to do the optional first slice before the deadline or defer; adopt B (vs B+detection aid); exact precision bounds if more classes are added; where trusted facts come from (supplied fixture now; `snapshot.py`-derived projection later); whether/when any render/gating is wanted; who owns semantic acceptance.\n\n### 7.3 Estimates (ESTIMATE; no measurements, no promise)\n\n- Optional first slice (standalone, supplied fixture, 3 relations, §6.0): **~1–2 working days**.\n- Full Stage-0/1 typed projection + more classes + tests: **~4–7 working days** (beyond the immediate deadline; not proposed as a necessary immediate fix).\n- Stage-2 render/gating + contract review + live replay: **~3–6 working days**, plus A/C review.\n\n### 7.4 Migration / rollback\n\n- **Migration:** the first slice is fully standalone and additive; no live-path, enum, manifest or rendering change; it reads saved artifacts and writes its own file.\n- **Rollback:** delete/ignore the standalone tool and its audit file; saved run artifacts and manifest hashes are untouched, so rollback is simply not running the tool.\n\n### 7.5 Risks\n\n- **False assurance:** `VERIFIED` must not read as “whole report correct”. Mitigation: coverage counts of detected registered claims only; no whole-narrative badge; explicit `UNSUPPORTED`/`NOT_VERIFIABLE`.\n- **Bounded coverage / detection:** only registered detected relations are scored; undetected prose is uncounted and stated.\n- **Fact provenance:** facts must be from a supplied or externally-verifiable source; model-proposed levels and user-supplied holdings are unverified inputs, never “truth”.\n- **Detection aid errors:** LLM/regex extraction is unverified; it cannot yield `VERIFIED` and must not include clearly different relations that happen to compute.\n- **Scope creep:** Stage-1/2 touches check authority and contracts; keep separately approved and beyond the immediate deadline.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Status and next step\n\nThis is a **plan for review**, not implementation, not approval, and not a claim that any current report is validated. Brian authorized only drafting it. Implementation, tests, canonical-requirement adoption and any render/gating wait for A/B/C/D/E scope, design and test approval. The coordinator-observed examples (L1 historical arithmetic, the PM band wording, the C2 ATR multiple) are retained as design evidence; they are not reclassified as passed, and the optional first slice does not rescue them before review.
````text
The plan is now an honest, coherent proposal. Only `docs/architecture/proposals/numeric-validation-extension-plan-2026-11-21.md` was edited this turn; no product/harness/tests/other docs touched.

## Corrections applied (per review)

1. **Stage 0 made honest.** It is now a **standalone post-run audit** over **saved** artifacts + an **explicitly supplied, run-bound typed fact fixture**, writing its **own** audit file **outside** the finalized run directory; it does not modify saved artifacts, the manifest or its hashes, and its retention/integrity is **distinct** from the authoritative report/manifest. Automatic typed extraction from `snapshot.py`/graph and staging integration are moved to **Stage 1** with **named existing-module seams**; render/gating remains **Stage 2, separately unapproved**.
2. **Precision made exact and non-contradictory.** `Decimal` context precision **28**; **no tolerance** in the first slice — compute, **round half-up to the claim's declared precision, compare equality**. Frozen min/max precision per class; unknown/ambiguous precision → `NOT_VERIFIABLE`; no caller-chosen wide tolerance. The `0.7153` vs `0.72` issue is resolved as *different declared precisions*, with positive and negative boundary examples (incl. `6.585` vs `6.6`, and `6.6` vs `6.59` at precision 1 vs 2).
3. **PM band reinterpreted correctly.** “1.5–8.8 points” is a **range mismatch against the anchored preceding 1.5–2×ATR claim only when trusted association exists**, otherwise `NOT_VERIFIABLE` — not a universal dimensional error. Added the **C2 `258.47→250.94` “roughly 1×ATR” vs actual `7.53/4.39≈1.7153`** example.
4. **Schema supports the cases.** Added `asserted_direction`, `asserted_range` endpoints, `OperandRef` roles (incl. `factor_min/max`), per-claim `claim_precision`, `source_id`/`availability_date`/**`period`**/`run_analysis_date` separation, and `stage_text_sha256`+`text_span` + `extraction_provenance`. `trader_proposed_level` and `portfolio_user_supplied` are marked **unverified** inputs; the calculator verifies a **relation relative to specified operands** only; LLM extraction cannot yield whole-prose `VERIFIED`.
5. **Coverage fixed.** Removed the fifth per-claim `UNVERIFIED`; unclassified spans counted separately; denominator = **detected registered claims**; Stage-0 coverage only **inside the audit**. Fixed NVA-03 to truly reverse the stop/anchor; split NVA-07 notional (qty×price) vs affordability (needs cash, unknown); NVA-13 is audit-summary-only; unsupported relations represented without an impossible `ClaimClass`.
6. **Deadline-aware.** Noted the 26 Nov 23:59 HK deadline; the broad programme is explicitly **not** an immediate necessary fix. Added an **optional small first slice** (standalone, supplied fixture, only price distance/direction + ATR band; no LLM extraction/gating) with an honest **~1–2 day ESTIMATE** and deferral option; corrected the closing “three observed failures” to the **enumerated** L1-historical / PM-band / C2-ATR examples; B proposes architecture, A adopts requirements, C owns acceptance — no fictitious approvals.

Links resolve to real existing files; `git diff --check` clean. No test suite run (prose-only change). The final frozen cohort source inventory and all frozen source remain untouched.

`PLAN_READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW` — `/home/brian/projects/CS5351/docs/architecture/proposals/numeric-validation-extension-plan-2026-11-21.md`
````

not one of a fixed literal set\n   operands: list[OperandRef]     # roles make the relation explicit\n   asserted_unit: \"price|points|currency|percent|ratio|multiple\"\n   asserted_value: Decimal | None # single stated number, or...\n   asserted_range: tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None\n   asserted_direction: \"above|below|none\"   # for distance/direction claims\n-  claim_precision: int           # digits after decimal the *claim* was stated at\n+  claim_precision: int | None    # digits after decimal the *claim* states; no impossible enum value). A claim whose operands cannot be bound, whose extraction is ambiguous, whose `claim_precision` is `None`, or which needs a missing `anchor_evidence` for an associated band is `NOT_VERIFIABLE`.\n \n-**Operations (fixed registry):** `subtract(minuend, subtrahend)`, `abs_distance(anchor, level)`, `direction(anchor, level)`, `divide_positive(numerator, denominator)` (denominator must be `> 0`), `scaled_band(factor_min, factor_max, atr)`. Each op declares its operand roles and result unit. The calculator **verifies the relation relative to the specified operands**; it does not assert that those operands are the true or complete facts.\n+**Operations (fixed registry) with named unit algebra:**\n+- `subtract(minuend: price, subtrahend: price) -> points` (prices in one quote currency).\n+- `abs_distance(anchor: price, level: price) -> points`.\n+- `direction(anchor: price, level: price) -> above|below|equal`.\n+- `divide_positive(numerator: points, denominator: atr(>0, points)) -> multiple` (dimensionless).\n+- `scaled_band(factor_min: multiple, factor_max: multiple, atr: points) -> points` — this **multiplies** dimensionless factors by ATR-in-points to yield points; it is valid and must not be rejected as a unit incompatibility.\n \n+The calculator verifies the relation **relative to the specified operands**; it does not assert that those operands are the true or complete facts. A band whose factors are *claimed as points* (rather than dimensionless multipliers) without the registered `scaled_band` multiplication is `NOT_VERIFIABLE`; an ambiguous operand/anchor unit is `NOT_VERIFIABLE`.\n+\n ### 4.3 `ComputedResult` (proposal; NOT Q1–Q4)\n \n ```\n CoverageStatus = Literal[\"VERIFIED\",\"MISMATCH\",\"NOT_VERIFIABLE\",\"UNSUPPORTED\"]\n \n ComputedResult {\n   claim_id: str\n   computed_value: Decimal | None\n   computed_range: tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None\n   computed_unit: ...\n   expected_at_claim_precision: Decimal | tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None  # round-half-up of computed at claim_precision\n   status: CoverageStatus\n   source_facts: list[str]\n   notes: str     # e.g. \"missing atr\" / \"ambiguous 1.5 role\" / \"unregistered relation\"\n }\n ```\n \n **Do not reuse `CHECK_ERROR`** for a numerical semantic mismatch and **do not create a Q5 silently.** A later, A/C-approved change may add a proposal-only finding type (`NumericFinding { rule: \"NUMERIC\", ... }`); until then results live only in the standalone audit file.\n \n-### 4.4 Precision / rounding / tolerance policy (exact for the first slice)\n+### 4.4 Precision / rounding / tolerance policy (exact)\n \n - **Arithmetic:** Python `Decimal` at **context precision 28**; no binary float in the calculator.\n-- **Comparison rule (first slice): NO tolerance.** Compute exactly, **round half-up to the claim's declared `claim_precision`**, and require **equality** with the asserted value/range endpoints. A different rounded value is `MISMATCH`.\n-- **Precision bounds per class (frozen; a claim outside its bound is rejected as `NOT_VERIFIABLE`):**\n-  - `price_distance`, `atr_band` → allow `claim_precision` in `{0,1,2}`.\n-  - `atr_distance` (multiple) → allow `claim_precision` in `{1,2,3,4}`.\n-  - `price_direction` → no numeric precision (boolean).\n-- **Unknown/ambiguous precision** (the prose does not state enough digits to pin `claim_precision`) → `NOT_VERIFIABLE`.\n-- **Units:** the calculator refuses to combine operands of incompatible unit roles (e.g. a `factor_*` (multiple) with a `points` asserted unit) → `NOT_VERIFIABLE` unless trusted `anchor_evidence` explicitly links them as the same range claim, in which case they are compared as that claim (§4.5).\n-- No caller-chosen wide tolerances are permitted in the first slice.\n+- **Comparison rule: NO tolerance.** Compute exactly, **round half-up to the claim's declared `claim_precision`**, and require **equality** with the asserted value/range endpoints. The **same source text cannot declare an arbitrary precision**; the stated form fixes it (a `6.6` written claim cannot be re-declared as precision 2).\n+- **Units:** each operation declares its unit algebra (§4.2). Work split, prerequisites, estimates, migration, risks\n \n ### 7.1 Handoff (recorded team allocation; not universal course roles)\n \n - **B (architecture):** propose `NVR-` scope, the fact/claim/status contract, units/precision policy and Stage-1/2 deltas.\n - **A (requirements):** adopt (or not) any `NVR-` item and any Stage-2 gating; A owns requirement adoption.\n - **C (independent tests/evaluation):** own NVA acceptance, a real cohort and semantic judgement.
